issues.title: Desktop app: context-usage ring missing from composer despite being bundled in every desktop release (model metadata not reaching the client)

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/ui
labels.description: User interface and display

labels.name: scope/macos
labels.description: macOS specific issues

issues.body:
## What happened?

In the Qwen Code desktop app (macOS), the composer toolbar never renders the context-usage ring (the percentage ring between the width-mode and voice buttons), and the model chip shows no reasoning-effort suffix. The reporter observes the ring in the Web Shell with the same internal provider model (`[qwen-code] qwen3.8-max`), where it renders with the hover popover (used / context window / remaining); the Web Shell chip also shows the effort suffix for this model once session context arrives (cf. #9595).

![desktop composer without the context-usage ring](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/desktop-context-ring-missing.png)

The desktop session in the screenshot had completed a turn with real token usage (composer footer stats: ↑1.1k ↓59 27.6k, 20.5s), so this is not an empty state or a pre-session-creation state (cf. #9595, which was about lazy session creation and was fixed on 2026-08-23).

## What did you expect to happen?

The desktop composer renders the context-usage ring exactly like the Web Shell once `contextWindow > 0 && tokenCount > 0`.

## Why this does not look like version lag or a desktop-side switch (static analysis against repo code)

- The desktop has no UI of its own: `packages/desktop` bundles `dist/web-shell` verbatim (`scripts/prepare-runtime.js`), `bootstrap/bootstrap.js` is a launcher page that injects no toolbar/header config, and the Tauri runtime only sets `QWEN_CODE_DESKTOP=1` + `QWEN_SERVER_TOKEN` for the spawned daemon (`src-tauri/src/runtime.rs:62-63`).
- The ring feature (the `data-web-shell-context-usage` button + `ContextUsagePopover`) is present in **every** desktop release tree checked — desktop-v0.2.2 (2026-08-26) through desktop-v0.25.1 (2026-10-11). `ContextUsagePopover.tsx` at desktop-v0.25.1 is byte-identical to `origin/main`, and `DEFAULT_COMPOSER_TOOLBAR_ACTIONS` includes `contextUsage` in all of them.
- Daemon-side emission of contextWindow/tokenCount (`packages/cli/src/nonInteractive`, `packages/cli/src/serve`) is identical between desktop-v0.25.1 and origin/main, and the `DaemonSessionProvider` drift between them does not touch the tokenCount/contextWindow/providers/effort mappings.
- The only gate that can hide the ring is the data gate in `ChatEditor.tsx`: `contextWindow > 0 && tokenCount > 0` (`contextUsageAlwaysVisible` defaults to false).
- The missing effort suffix (`hasEffortOptions = reasoning.efforts.length > 0`) is data-driven the same way. Both symptoms together suggest the provider/model metadata (contextWindow, reasoning efforts) and/or the turn token count are not reaching the client's connection state in the desktop app.

## Client information

- macOS desktop app; exact version to be confirmed (the bootstrap splash shows `Desktop x.y.z`). Latest desktop release: desktop-v0.25.1, bundling qwen-code c1a8218f38.
- Model: internal provider entry `[qwen-code] qwen3.8-max`. The Web Shell shows the ring + effort suffix with the same model family.

## Next steps

- Reproduce locally: run a daemon from a desktop-release bundle (with `QWEN_CODE_DESKTOP=1`), open its Web Shell, complete a turn, and inspect `connection.contextWindow` / `tokenCount` / `reasoning.efforts` plus the providers status response.
- Check whether the desktop runtime environment (isolated runtime dir, `QWEN_CODE_DESKTOP` branches) suppresses model-metadata reporting.

Define a staged Managed Agent architecture that keeps the existing TypeScript agent loop, runs model inference independently of tool-environment provisioning, and gives Sessions durable ownership, Workspace bindings, recoverable tool executions, and a stable WebShell/API surface.

This proposal consolidates the integration design and release gates. It does not request one large PR or declare the architecture shipped. Detailed contracts stay in **code_agent v1.13, pinned at `6891216`**: [architecture overview][architecture], [HTML diagrams][html], and [design index][index]. ### Architecture and ownership

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    UI[WebShell / product client] -->|Product REST and SSE| J[Java control plane]
    J -->|Session / Prompt / Resume| Q[qwen serve]
    Q --> L[Legacy engine / ACP]
    Q --> H[Managed TS Harness]
    H --> M[Model service]
    H -->|Tool requests and results| B[Embedded Runtime Broker]
    B -->|Java-initiated HTTP and SSE| R[On-demand Tool Runtime]
```

The Broker is embedded in the Java service in the hosted reference deployment. `qwen serve` keeps the common Session protocol and hosts the Legacy/Managed engines; the Harness owns the single model loop, context, compaction, and tool orchestration. The Runtime owns files, Shell, and admitted tool-side effects. It receives neither the user Prompt nor model credentials. Local Managed uses a local Runtime provider and does not require Java.

Hosted deployment starts with one Java instance plus a `qwen serve` sidecar and a Session-exclusive Runtime process/Pod. Model inference uses a pre-published immutable AgentBundle while Runtime provisioning proceeds in parallel; only tool execution waits for readiness. Multiple Sessions may share the Harness process without sharing their model context or permission view.

### Acceptance criteria

- The adopted staged path-independence matrix is a release gate: Hosted proves its bounded scope with ordinary local-only state unreachable; local remains deferred until M6; shared dependencies are inventoried before the run. No existing component or recovery report substitutes for this gate.
- With Runtime startup delayed by 15 seconds, published-configuration model output starts first; a no-tool Turn can finish, and a tool Turn waits and continues in the same model context.
- Sessions retain their engines after restore; a Managed failure causes no Legacy replay. Ordinary-host Legacy/Managed coexistence is an acceptance gate for the deferred local engine, not the first Hosted slice.
- Lost create/Prompt/execute/ACK responses resolve through original identities without duplicating side effects. Unknown outcomes remain explicitly blocked.
- Two Workspaces and different child directories execute Read/Write/Shell in the intended locations. A retry after changing defaults keeps the original binding; missing mounts or revoked access never fall back to another directory.
- Java restart and clean Runtime reclamation retain the Session binding; physical identity is verified before reuse, and old writers cannot mutate a newer binding.
- Committed SSE replay and Snapshot-plus-tail recovery preserve order without duplicate content. MQ delay cannot block local post-commit SSE; SQL unavailability is surfaced with bounded backpressure.
- Large output can be read/downloaded after Runtime cleanup. WebShell distinguishes tool outcome, partial/missing capture, delivery failure, and truncated preview; storage failure never causes tool re-execution.
- Cancellation settles admitted tools and descendant processes. Production enablement additionally requires actor/tenant isolation, capacity limits, and the fault gates for the selected deployment profile.

## Why is this needed?

Hosted execution should not make the first model response wait for a tool container. Splitting the model loop from tools, however, creates ownership and recovery boundaries: a selected directory must survive process changes, an ambiguous tool call must not run twice, and a browser reconnect must recover committed progress. Permanent per-fragment storage also grows without a retention/materialization plan, while Runtime-local output disappears when the environment is reclaimed.

This proposal joins those boundaries into one implementable contract while preserving Qwen's existing agent semantics and local deployment. It gives reviewers a scoped rollout and observable exit gates instead of treating an experimental branch or a passing component test as the finished product.

### 架构与职责

链路为：产品前端 → Java 控制面 → qwen serve → Legacy 或 Managed Harness；Managed Harness 调用模型，并通过 Java 内嵌 Runtime Broker 调用按需 Tool Runtime。Java 主动发起到 Runtime 的 HTTP/SSE。上方架构图展示同一链路。

Java 内嵌 Broker；qwen serve 保留统一会话协议与双引擎；Harness 负责唯一模型循环、上下文、压缩及工具编排；Runtime 负责文件、Shell 和已准入的工具副作用，不接收用户 Prompt 或模型凭据。本地 Managed 使用本地 Runtime provider，不依赖 Java。

托管首版采用单 Java + qwen serve Sidecar + Session 独占 Runtime 进程/Pod。模型使用预发布不可变 AgentBundle，与环境启动并行；只有工具执行等待环境就绪。多个 Session 可共享 Harness 进程，但不共享模型上下文或权限视图。

### 首版范围

首版采用单实例、预发布不可变配置、Session 独占 Runtime，验收 Read/Write/Edit/前台 Shell。成员协作不作为该首版交付前置；board #13928 与成员消息 #13955 已在上游合入，部署开放与其余计划审批 #13974 继续可选并后置于核心验收；审批、结果/文件历史持久保存、取消清理、干净回收后的续轮仍是必需项。可复用既有产品 SSE/历史；完整公共 API、多实例接管和扩展迁移各有独立门槛。

W0 支持创建时选择 Workspace 并固定 cwd；W1 补完整恢复、存量回填及可验证的挂载迁移；W2 补同 Workspace 内受控切换目录。W0 不提供任意服务器路径注册、clone/worktree 创建或已有 Session 目录编辑。同 Workspace 的会话共享文件，工具轮次需要遵守 Workspace 租约与结算规则。

首版已接受的恢复/支持策略为单 Java 控制面、同一可信 Linux 主机，仅在已支持且验收的状态下顺序替换兼容 Hosted Harness。公开 CSI/Pod 资格、两个存活控制面与跨主机接管保留独立门禁。Java server/Broker 按实验性分发，打包与正式支持仍后续。父关闭主动取消 child 与心跳/独立等待预算已采纳，实现/参数验收待完成。

### 验收标准

- 已采纳的分阶段路径独立性矩阵是交付门禁：Hosted 在普通本地专属状态不可达时证明限定范围，本地路径在 M6 前延期，运行前列出共享依赖；既有组件或恢复报告不能替代该门禁。
- Runtime 延迟 15 秒时，使用预发布配置的模型输出先返回；无工具轮次可完成，有工具轮次等待后继续同一模型上下文。
- 会话恢复后引擎不变，Managed 失败不经 Legacy 重放。普通宿主的 Legacy/Managed 共存属于后置本地引擎的验收门槛，不是首个 Hosted 闭环的前置条件。
- 创建、Prompt、执行或 ACK 响应丢失时按原身份查询，不重复副作用；未知结果明确 blocked。
- 两个工作区和不同子目录的 Read/Write/Shell 位置正确；改变默认值后的重试仍保持原绑定，目录失效/撤权不回退其他目录。
- Java 重启与 Runtime 干净回收后保持 Session 绑定，复用前验证物理身份，旧 writer 不能修改新绑定。
- 已提交 SSE 与 Snapshot+tail 恢复保持顺序且不重复内容；MQ 延迟不阻塞本机提交后推送；SQL 不可用时有界背压并呈现失败。
- Runtime 清理后大输出仍可读取/下载；工具结果、部分/缺失捕获、交付失败及预览裁剪分别展示，存储失败不触发工具重跑。
- 取消能结算已准入工具并清理后代进程；生产开放前另验收 actor/tenant 隔离、容量限制及所选部署的故障门槛。

## 为什么需要

托管工具容器的启动不应阻塞模型首输出，但分离模型与工具后，目录归属、执行恢复和客户端续传必须有清晰边界：所选目录要跨进程保留，不确定的工具不能重复执行，断线客户端要找回已提交进度。永久逐片段保存会持续膨胀，Runtime 本地输出也会随回收丢失。

本提案在保留现有 Agent 语义和本地部署的基础上，把这些边界整理为可实施契约，并提供分阶段开放及可观察的验收门槛，避免把实验分支或单项测试当作完整产品。

固定的 [v1.13 清单][inventory]保留历史定位。Hosted 是活跃核心路径，本地 M6 后置。Main API1.44/FlywayV68 现包括 board/peer session_command、已启用 workflow child、Monitor auto-stop 与标准 Managed WebShell UI。Plan 审批仍可选/开放/关闭。L4 已合入/默认关闭，重启后 drain 需最终 head 收敛；child 恢复 #14020 与私有 CSI authority #13996 开放。MQ2a 已合入，MQ2b–d/PostgreSQL 与其余 CSI lifecycle/物理资格独立。Stage H #12827、Stage G #12952 保持开放，实现、代码准入、部署默认值与运行时验收继续区分。

### 评审决策与待定部署参数

**2026-10-12 已采纳；实现与实测部署参数继续独立跟踪。** 详见 [分发决定](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12380#issuecomment-6117059631) 与 [其余决策记录](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12380#issuecomment-6117130998)。

1. **Java 分发——已采纳：** `qwen-managed-agent-server` 与 `qwen-managed-runtime-broker` 按实验性参考部署产物独立于 npm CLI 发布，明确源码/版本、已验证范围、兼容性与升级迁移说明。`packages/sdk-java` 的位置和独立 Java CI 已定。现有流程仍仅发布 `qwencode-sdk`，server/Broker 打包与正式支持提升仍为后续实现/评估。Broker 保持嵌入式。
2. **首版与生命周期——已采纳：** 保留普通工具首版、W0 固定绑定、既有 Harness-confirmed 产品准入与各能力门禁。Hosted 恢复先限定单 Java 控制面/同一可信 Linux 主机，两个存活控制面与跨主机 HA 保留独立 binding/物理门禁，#12952 Q2 继续开放。父 CLOSE/DELETE 采用 [方案 B](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13875#issuecomment-6117109379)：生命周期级联按原键取消 child Turn、递归停止消息/子任务、恰好一次结算并要求物理/清理证据，保留已自然完成的结果。#13875 实现仍开放，#13923 或 L4 #13931 未提供该实现。
3. **部署策略——已采纳，具体数值待定：** GC 或扩大流量前形成事件/快照/输出留存、task/Session/tenant 字节与并发配额、恢复目标及有界模型/工具/Turn 等待的部署配置表。回收始终受 reference/reader/snapshot 和 ownership 检查约束。采用 [连接心跳加独立操作预算](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13302#issuecomment-6117110640)，实现与实测默认值待完成。#13654 已合入/默认关闭，其 250 ms 首次轮询吞吐问题是另一个未决时序选择，不因心跳策略采纳而解决。MQ 按已记录决定保持可选。
4. **路径独立性——已纳入验收要求，尚未认证通过：** 采用以下分阶段矩阵，保留固定 engine owner/不跨引擎回退，不要求跨引擎迁移 Session：

| 路径 | 门禁与当前状态 |
| --- | --- |
| Hosted Managed | 让普通本地双引擎宿主机制及仅本地 Managed 状态不可达，验证已开放 Hosted 范围内的创建及有界 Turn/恢复路径，仍需验收证据。 |
| 普通本地 Managed | M6 前保持“延期 / 尚不可通过”；其后在 Hosted 专属控制面调用不可达时，验证本地选择/创建、有界执行及重启恢复。 |
| 共享依赖 | 门禁运行前列出有意共享的身份/认证、配置发布、推理、Workspace/Runtime 供应、Session/transcript 权威、结果/产物存储与恢复/迁移；共享依赖失败预期在声明层级影响两条路径。 |

5. **任务面板 v1——已采纳：** 仅 `child_agent`，桌面右侧常驻/窄屏弹层展示状态/时间线、取消和已有公开产物；#13936 已随 API 1.44 合入该限定切片。最终文本公开发布/读取作为具有持久引用/鉴权契约的独立后续，完整 child transcript/tool trace 不纳入 v1。取消 command 完成不等于 task 终态或物理停止。

</details>

issues.body:
Four Suggestion findings from the round-1 review of #13902 are deferred here instead of being fixed in that PR.

**Scope note.** #13902 ("feat: project agent identity and Agent Team delivery onto the client surface") sits at **+3611/−235 across 34 files**, well past the point where review-driven growth belongs in that PR. Each item below was independently re-verified by reading the code at head `8d243a8672fd66a4db32fec8e8ba36362b99ad8f` on 2026-10-14 before being deferred. Resolving the source threads records this deferral, **not** a fix.

**Not included here.** The four Criticals from the same review round (R1-1 … R1-4). The author dispositioned each as REAL at head `8d243a86` and deliberately left those threads unresolved pending a decision. They stay on #13902 and must not be folded into this list as if they were scheduled work.

Source review: #13902, `qwen-code-review-bot` CR submitted 2026-10-13T23:17Z bound to head `8d243a8672fd66a4db32fec8e8ba36362b99ad8f`.

---

## 1. R1-5 — the web-shell consumer docs call `_meta.agent` the *author*; for inter-agent frames the producer stamps the *recipient*

Thread `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8F` — anchor `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.ts:1917`.

**Class: REAL** (doc/contract contradiction inside one diff; no behaviour change).

Producer side, `#emitTeammateActivity` in `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.ts`:

- `:11313-11317` — the producer's own comment: *"`agent_message` items identify direction with `author` and `recipient`, and the item's own `agent` names the recipient"*.
- `:11322-11323` — `const recipient = activity.kind === 'message' && activity.to ? activity.to : activity.name;`
- `:11332-11336` — stamps `agent: { agentName: agentName(recipient), depth: recipient === LEADER_NAME ? 0 : 1, kind: recipient === LEADER_NAME ? 'root' : 'teammate' }`.
- `:11337-11348` — the sender travels separately, in `structured.author`.

Consumer-side docs added by the same diff state the opposite:

- `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/messageTypes.ts:221-226` — "Agent Team teammate that **authored** this notification, when the daemon projected one (`_meta.agent.kind === 'teammate'`)".
- `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.ts:1912-1916` — "Teammate (Agent Team peer) **author** of a projected notification".
- `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/SystemMessage.tsx:46` — "Teammate (Agent Team peer) **author**, rendered as an `@name` chip."

The SDK leg of the same diff already states it correctly — `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/types.ts:112-119` (*"This normally names the producer; for an inter-agent message it names the recipient, matching OpenAI's `agent_message` semantics"*) and `:1119-1124`. So the diff contradicts itself across packages, and the web-shell leg is the wrong one.

**Consequence.** No user-visible defect today: the recipient chip is deliberate documented design (`docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md`). The cost lands on the next consumer of the web-shell types — `teammate` is documented as the sender and is in fact the recipient, so anyone building a "messages from @x" filter on it silently selects the wrong party on inter-agent frames.

**Same slice should also fix the test.** `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.test.ts:626-651` pairs the text `writer → checker: …` with a hand-built `agent: '/root/writer'` and asserts `teammate: { name: 'writer' }` — a shape no producer emits, so the assertion passes whichever way the semantics go. Rebuild it from the shape `#emitTeammateActivity` actually emits and assert the party the corrected contract names.

**Guard rail for the fix.** Peer *report* rows must keep chipping from `agent`: `Session.ts:11238-11246`-region stamps a sender-named `agent` with `status: 'message'` and no `structured.author`. A fix keyed on `status === 'message'` alone would drop that chip.

---

## 2. R1-13 — `teammate_activity` is missing from `isHideableStep`, so teammate activity rows escape turn collapse

Thread `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8L` — anchor `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.ts:811`.

**Class: REAL.**

The source is new in #13902 and reaches the web-shell display list:

- `packages/core/src/agents/team/team-events.ts:47` — `TEAMMATE_ACTIVITY = 'teammate_activity'`
- `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.ts:11361` — emitted as the display source
- `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.ts:444`, `:466-468`, `:811` — projected; `:819` pushes the system message with `source: notice.source`
- `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/SystemMessage.tsx:376` — consumed for rendering

The collapse gate does not know it. `packages/web-shell/client/components/MessageList.tsx:874-882`, at head `8d243a8672fd66a4db32fec8e8ba36362b99ad8f`, enumerates exactly four system sources:

```ts
case 'system':
  if (item.message.source === 'background_notification') {
    return !isFinalAnswer;
  }
  return (
    item.message.source === 'background_notification_turn_started' ||
    item.message.source === 'background_task_completed' ||
    item.message.source === 'vision_bridge_notice'
  );
```

`git grep teammate_activity 8d243a8672 -- packages/web-shell/client/components/MessageList.tsx` → **0 matches**. So `isHideableStep` returns `false`, `applyTurnCollapse` keeps the row, and the `hiddenCount` accumulator never counts it.

**Consequence.** A leader turn during which a team makes N tool calls produces ~2N activity rows per teammate that all stay on screen when the user collapses the turn, while the summary counts only what it actually hid. It also contradicts the function's own contract comment at `MessageList.tsx:854-859`, and splits one feature in half: the sibling `background_notification` row **is** hideable (`:875`) while the new `teammate_activity` row is not.

**Fix shape.** Add `item.message.source === 'teammate_activity' ||` to the unconditional-hide list at `MessageList.tsx:878-882` — not to the `return !isFinalAnswer` branch at `:875`. Extend `MessageList.test.ts` (which already drives `applyTurnCollapse` over `background_notification_turn_started` fixtures around `:3016-3208`) with a case asserting the row is absent from the returned display items **and** included in `turnCollapse.hiddenCount`; removing the added term must turn both red.

Note `MessageList.tsx` is not among #13902's 34 changed files, so this fix adds a file to an already-fused diff — which is why it is deferred rather than folded in.

---

## 3. R1-24 — three identity doc comments state guarantees the shipped code does not provide

Thread `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8Q` — anchor `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/messageTypes.ts:84`.

**Class: REAL, all three parts.** These are doc-only, but the deliverable of this slice *is* the wire contract of a public SDK.

**(a) `messageTypes.ts:78-84` claims a uniqueness guarantee `agentPath` does not have.** The new doc says the field lets the panel *"name a subagent precisely instead of by type alone — two parallel subagents of the same type are otherwise indistinguishable"*. But:

- `packages/web-shell/client/adapters/transcriptToMessages.ts:1770` fills it as `...(block.agent ? { agentPath: block.agent.agentName } : {})`
- `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/types.ts:134-144` mints it: `const segment = subagentType.trim() || 'subagent'; return { agentName: \`${parent.agentName}/${segment}\`, depth: parent.depth + 1, kind: 'subagent' }` — `segment` is the subagent **type** only

So two parallel `general-purpose` subagents both carry `/root/general-purpose` — exactly the case the comment claims the field resolves. The same diff documents the opposite for the same value at `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/types.ts:124-131`: *"It is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent subagents of the same type share it … Use `parentToolCallId` when a consumer must distinguish subagent executions."*

**Consequence.** A maintainer adding sibling disambiguation who keys grouping or dedup on `agentPath` collapses two executions into one row, and one subagent's sub-content silently disappears.

**(b) `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/types.ts:345-348` — the tool-frame `agent` doc promises producer semantics with no exception.** It reads *"The agent that produced this tool call, when it was not the session's root agent. Same shape and source as `DaemonUiTextEvent.agent`."* — while the sibling text-event doc it points at (`:112-119`) carries an explicit recipient exception that this one omits. And on replay the value is not the producer at all: `packages/acp-bridge/src/transcript-replay.ts:1694-1695` attaches `agentIdentityFromTaskExecution(resultDisplay)` to the **AgentTool result** frame, and that helper (`:2702-2715`) returns `{ agentName: \`/root/${subagentName}\`, depth: 1, kind: 'subagent' }` — the spawned **child's** identity on the **caller's** tool call id. `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/transcript.ts:1173-1174` then adopts it first-wins onto the parent tool block.

**(c) `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/normalizer.ts:1153-1160` — both claimed invariants are false.** The new doc says *"a client that keys rendering or policy on `agentName` must never see an identity whose `depth`/`kind` disagree with it"* and *"Absent means the frame came from the session's root agent"*.

- No cross-field check exists. `extractAgentIdentity` (`:1161-1179`) evaluates four independent predicates — `!agentName`, `kind ∉ {root, subagent, teammate}` (`:1172`), `depth === undefined`, `depth < 0` — so `agentName: '/root/a/b'` with `depth: 1` passes untouched.
- "Absent means root" is refuted by this same diff: `Session.ts:11335` emits `kind: recipient === LEADER_NAME ? 'root' : 'teammate'` with `depth: 0`, `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/types.ts:107-112` exports `ROOT_AGENT_IDENTITY = { agentName: '/root', depth: 0, kind: 'root' }`, and `normalizer.ts:1172` explicitly accepts `kind === 'root'`. Root frames are **present**, not absent — which is deliberate and documented in `docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md`. The code is right; the comment is wrong.

**Fix shape.** Correct each doc to the shipped behaviour: state that `agentPath` is a role path, not an execution id (pointing at `parentToolCallId`); carve the Agent-tool-card case out of the tool-frame doc the way the sibling text-event doc already does; and drop both claimed validator invariants from `extractAgentIdentity`'s doc (absence is not the only encoding of root).

---

## 4. R1-25 — declared surfaces carrying values with no producer or no reader (2 of 3 parts verified; part 3 refuted)

Thread `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8X` — anchor `packages/web-shell/client/i18n.tsx:2240`.

**(1) `'background.teammate'` has zero read sites — REAL.** `git grep "background\.teammate" 8d243a8672 -- .` (whole tree, not just `packages/`) returns exactly 2 matches, both declarations added by #13902: `packages/web-shell/client/i18n.tsx:2240` (`'Teammate'`) and `:6481` (`'队友'`). Dynamic construction is ruled out: `git grep 'background\.\${' 8d243a8672 -- packages` → 0 matches. The only kind-keyed lookup is `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/SystemMessage.tsx:227-233`, which hard-codes the choice among `'background.agent' | 'background.peer' | 'background.task'`, and `turn?.kind` is only ever compared against `'agent'` (`:228`) and `'peer'` (`:230`, `:258`) — there is no `'teammate'` member.

Consequence: two unreachable strings ship inside the web-shell transcript entry whose size budget is already nearly exhausted, and every future locale table is obliged to translate a string no user can see. Either wire it where a peer turn is teammate-labelled or drop both entries.

**(2) the persisted `kind` union writes 2 arms and reads 1 — REAL as a contract asymmetry.**

- Declared: `packages/core/src/services/chatRecordingService.ts:575-582` (new in #13902) — `agent?: { agentName; depth; kind: 'teammate' | 'subagent' }`
- Written: `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.ts:1675-1683` — `persistedNotificationAgent` maps every non-`'teammate'` input to `kind: 'subagent'` (`:1682`); call sites `:11615`, `:11970`, `:12372`
- Read: `packages/acp-bridge/src/transcript-replay.ts:2688-2699` — `isTeammateAgentRecord` requires `value['kind'] === 'teammate'` (`:2698`), and it gates both hoist sites (`:1399`, `:1830`)

So a record persisted as `kind: 'subagent'` typechecks end to end and then loses its attribution silently on reload — the live wire attributed the notice, the replayed session renders it unattributed, and nothing reports the loss.

*Verification boundary:* whether any producer reaches the `'subagent'` arm **today** was not exhaustively traced. `Session.ts:1670-1674` asserts "The root agent never produces a background notification", while `#emitTeammateActivity` (`Session.ts:11332-11336`) does build `kind: 'root'` for leader-directed messages at the display-emit level; whether that path reaches the persisted queue is unconfirmed. The asymmetry and the silent-loss shape are verified regardless. Narrow the persisted union to `'teammate'`, or teach `isTeammateAgentRecord` to accept `'subagent'` — and note `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/types.ts:104` declares the broad `kind: 'root' | 'subagent' | 'teammate'` that `persistedNotificationAgent` narrows *from*, so a narrowing fix must still handle `'root'`. Add a `packages/acp-bridge/src/transcript-replay.test.ts` case persisting `kind: 'subagent'` and asserting the same attribution the `'teammate'` cases get; it must go red if the reader arm is dropped.

**(3) `author.kind`'s `"root"` enum arm is *not* dead — NOT REAL, do not apply the suggested fix.** The review claimed no exported block can carry `"root"` and that root authorship is encoded by absence. At head `8d243a8672` the chain is intact the other way:

- `Session.ts:11335` mints `kind: 'root'`, `depth: 0` for leader-directed inter-agent messages
- `normalizer.ts:1172` explicitly accepts `kind === 'root'`
- `packages/sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/transcript.ts:912-915` copies `event.agent` onto `block.agent`
- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/export/export-transcript-document.ts:496-505` writes `author.kind` verbatim from `block.agent.kind`
- `packages/cli/src/ui/utils/export/export-transcript-document-v1.schema.json:69-72` enumerates `["root", "subagent", "teammate"]` and its description at `:71` explicitly names "the session root"

Dropping `"root"` from the enum would therefore be wrong. This part also contradicts R1-24(c) in the same review round, which correctly observes that root frames *are* present. *Verification boundary:* whether a leader-directed `teammate_activity` frame specifically survives the exporter's subtype gate (`export-transcript-document.ts:444-450`) into an exported document was not traced — but that is a reachability question about one path, not evidence the enum arm is dead.

---

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

#13902（head `8d243a8672fd66a4db32fec8e8ba36362b99ad8f`）第一轮 review 的四条 Suggestion 延期到本 issue，不在该 PR 内修。

**范围说明：** #13902 已达 +3611/−235、34 文件，远超「review 驱动增量」的熔断线。以下每条都在 2026-10-14 于该 head 上重新读代码核过。**resolve 源线程只表示已记录延期，不表示已修。**

**不含在本 issue 内：** 同一轮的 4 条 Critical（R1-1 … R1-4）。作者已在 #13902 线程里逐条裁定为 REAL 并刻意留 unresolved 等裁决，不要把它们折进这份清单当成已排期项。

1. **R1-5** — 消费侧文档把 `_meta.agent` 写成**作者**，但代理间帧的生产者写的是**接收方**：`Session.ts:11313-11317`（生产者自己的注释）、`:11322-11323`、`:11332-11336` 对比 `messageTypes.ts:221-226`、`transcriptToMessages.ts:1912-1916`、`SystemMessage.tsx:46`；同一 diff 的 SDK 侧 `sdk-typescript/src/daemon/ui/types.ts:112-119` 写对了 ⇒ diff 内部自相矛盾。附带：`transcriptToMessages.test.ts:626-651` 钉的是没有生产者会发出的形状。
2. **R1-13** — 新 source `teammate_activity` 未进 `MessageList.tsx:874-882` 的 `isHideableStep`（该文件 `git grep teammate_activity` 0 命中），因此活动行逃过回合折叠且不计入 `hiddenCount`；同类 `background_notification` 却是可折叠的（`:875`）。修法：加进 `:878-882` 的无条件隐藏列表，并在 `MessageList.test.ts` 补断言。
3. **R1-24** — 三处身份文档承诺了代码没有的保证：(a) `messageTypes.ts:78-84` 声称 `agentPath` 能区分同类型并行 subagent，但 `deriveSubagentIdentity`（`session/types.ts:134-144`）只拼类型，且同 diff 的 `sdk .../ui/types.ts:124-131` 明说「不是唯一执行 id」；(b) `sdk .../ui/types.ts:345-348` tool 帧文档没写例外，而 `transcript-replay.ts:1694-1695` + `:2702-2715` 把**子代理**身份盖到父级 Agent 工具调用上；(c) `normalizer.ts:1153-1160` 声称的两个不变量都假——`:1161-1179` 无跨字段校验，且 `Session.ts:11335` 确实发出 `kind:'root'`。
4. **R1-25** — (1) `'background.teammate'`（`i18n.tsx:2240` / `:6481`）全树仅两处声明、零读取点，`SystemMessage.tsx:227-233` 只在 agent/peer/task 间硬选 ⇒ **成立**；(2) 持久化 `kind` 写 2 读 1（`chatRecordingService.ts:575-582` / `Session.ts:1682` 对 `transcript-replay.ts:2698`）⇒ 契约不对称**成立**，静默丢归属（今天是否有生产者走到 `'subagent'` 分支未穷尽追踪）；(3) `author.kind` 的 `"root"` **不是死值**——`Session.ts:11335` → `normalizer.ts:1172` → `transcript.ts:912-915` → `export-transcript-document.ts:496-505` → `schema:69-72` 链路完整，**建议的「从枚举删掉 root」不可采纳**，且它与 R1-24(c) 自相矛盾。

## 5. R1-27 — a leader-directed teammate message is projected into two client-visible rows, and the turn-started row renders the teammate name twice

*Appended 2026-10-14 by closeout run `jmv7hlvor3o` (source thread: #13902 `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8b`, `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/SystemMessage.tsx:46`, `qwen-code-review-bot`, 2026-10-13T23:17:37Z, **[Suggestion]**). All citations below were re-read at the live head `8d243a8672fd66a4db32fec8e8ba36362b99ad8f`, not carried over from the bot's line numbers.*

**Class verdict: REAL — both legs.** This is not a "what if both fired" hypothetical: the two channels are emitted unconditionally from the same branch for the same message, and both terminate in the same client-visible update function.

### Leg A — one message, two client-visible rows (one of which vanishes on reload)

**Producer — both halves fire unconditionally on the leader-directed branch.** `packages/core/src/agents/team/TeamManager.ts:811` `await writeMessage(this.teamFile.name, LEADER_NAME, {…})`, then on the same branch `:836-841` `this.teamEventEmitter.emit(TeamEventType.MESSAGE_SENT, { from, to: LEADER_NAME, message, timestamp })`. Neither is conditional on the other.

**Half 1 — the mailbox half (persists and wakes).** `team-sink.ts:310-312` `manager.setLeaderMessageCallback(…) → deps.injectLeaderMessage` → `Session.ts:11213-11214` → `#enqueueTeammateMessage` (`Session.ts:11223-11255`; `kind:'peer'`, `taskId: teammate-message-N` at `:11236`, `agent.agentName = /root/<sender>` at `:11243`, `label: sender` at `:11250`) → `#enqueueBackgroundNotification` (`Session.ts:11559`), which at `:11605` pushes the queue, at `:11606-11619` calls `recordBackgroundTaskCompleted`, at `:11620-11622` calls `#emitBackgroundNotificationDisplay(item, 'background_task_completed')`, and at `:11627` calls `#drainNotificationQueue()` — the wake. `git grep recordBackgroundTaskCompleted` over `Session.ts` at head returns exactly one hit (`:11606`), so this is the only persistence site on the path.

**Half 2 — the activity half (display only).** `team-sink.ts:325` `emitter.on(TeamEventType.MESSAGE_SENT, messageSentListener)` → `handleMessageSent` (`team-sink.ts:286-294`, forwards `to: event.to`) → `deps.reportTeammateActivity` → `Session.ts:11216-11217` → `#emitTeammateActivity` (`Session.ts:11297-11365`): `recipient = activity.to` (`:11322-11323`) is `LEADER_NAME`, so it stamps `agent = { agentName: /root, depth: 0, kind: 'root' }` (`:11332-11336`) and calls `#emitBackgroundNotificationDisplay(…, 'teammate_activity')` (`:11324`, `:11361`).

**Same terminal function, two sources.** `#emitBackgroundNotificationDisplay` (`Session.ts:12671-12692`) is a single `sendUpdate({ sessionUpdate:'agent_message_chunk', content:{ type:'text', text: item.displayText }, _meta:{ source, … } })`. Its body contains no recording call — so the `teammate_activity` row is **not persisted** while the mailbox row **is** (`:11606`). Consequences, all head-pinned: one of the two rows the user read disappears on reload; the two rows carry contradictory `_meta.agent` (`/root/<sender>`, depth 1, kind `'teammate'` vs `/root`, depth 0, kind `'root'`); and the two carry different bodies for the same message (raw `message` verbatim and unbounded via `team-sink.ts:292` → `Session.ts:11312`, vs core's deliberately compressed one-line `displayText` via `Session.ts:11239`).

**Consumer — the activity row really is client-visible.** `transcriptToMessages.ts:443-446` declares the `teammate_activity` notice arm; `:465-471` classifies `_meta.source === 'teammate_activity'`; `:809-825` pushes a `role:'system'` message carrying `source: notice.source` at `:819` and `teammate` at `:813`/`:821`; `SystemMessage.tsx:372-376` folds `'teammate_activity'` into `isTaskNotification` and renders it at `:464-495`.

**The doc premise is false for exactly these messages.** `Session.ts:11289-11296` states *"Unlike roster changes and reports these never enter the notification queue"*. For a leader-directed message the same message **does** enter the queue — via the mailbox half at `:11605`. This also settles the open verification boundary recorded under item 4 (R1-25 part 2) above: the `kind:'root'` path built at `Session.ts:11332-11336` reaches the display emit but **not** the persisted queue (`:12671-12692` records nothing), whereas the mailbox half does persist (`:11606`).

**Which half may be suppressed — already decided by the design doc, so the fix is not a free choice.** `docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md:39` (and its `.zh-CN.md:39` twin) publishes activity frames *"without entering the notification queue and without persistence"*, on the rationale that *"every queued peer item wakes the leader into an automatic turn"*; `Session.ts:11260-11261` repeats it (*"each would wake the leader into an automatic turn for noise"*). Therefore suppressing the mailbox half would lose both the persisted report and the leader wake; suppressing the activity half for leader-directed messages is the only direction that keeps the design's guarantees.

**Fix shape:** suppress the `teammate_activity` projection for leader-directed messages only (`recipient === LEADER_NAME` in `#emitTeammateActivity`, `Session.ts:11322-11336`) — leaving tool activity and inter-teammate messages projecting as today — and correct the `:11289-11296` doc premise. Then render the name once (Leg B).

### Leg B — the turn-started row renders the teammate name twice

Two independent producers both name the teammate on the same row. Inside the `data-background-turn-start` block (`SystemMessage.tsx:200-205`): `:221-225` renders the `@{teammate.name}` chip, and `:238-243` renders `{turn?.label ?? turn?.kind ?? content}`. The chip comes from `teammateOfAgent(textBlock.agent)` (`transcriptToMessages.ts:813`, definition `:1917`); the label comes from `label: sender` (`Session.ts:11250`) read back through `parseDaemonBackgroundTurn(data)` (`SystemMessage.tsx:180`). For a single-sender teammate report both resolve to the same sender name, so the row reads `@<name>` + `background.peer` (= "Cross-session message", `i18n.tsx:2239`) + `·` + `<name>`.

Scope note: the *second* chip site, `SystemMessage.tsx:478-482`, lives in the `isTaskNotification` block, which does not also render `turn.label` — so Leg B is specific to the turn-started marker row, not to every teammate row. Fix shape: drop one of the two on that row (chip or `label` span).

### Requested tests — recorded, and blocked by the tripped scope fuse

The bot asks for two tests, both of which must go red while both channels still project:

1. `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts` — for **one** message, both emit `message_sent {to:'leader'}` and invoke `manager.leaderCallback`; assert exactly one client-visible `agent_message_chunk` row, and that it survives replay. Current coverage is split and never joins the halves: `Session.test.ts:1288` and `:1377-1417` pin the activity half alone (`teammate_activity` frames, `:1474` asserts the listener detaches); `git grep leaderCallback` over that file at head returns no case that also emits `message_sent {to:'leader'}`.
2. `packages/web-shell/client/components/messages/SystemMessage.test.tsx` — assert the teammate name appears exactly once in the rendered text. The nearest existing cases do not pin it: `:981` expects `'Cross-session message·qwen on api'` (label, no chip) and `:1060` renders `source="teammate_activity"`; neither covers chip **and** label on one row.

**These tests are code, and code is blocked on #13902 this round.** The PR's scope fuse is tripped: **+3611/−235 across 34 files** against a 1500-addition cap (live head `8d243a8672`; the `resolve-pr-comments-scope:v1` ledger, comment `6122209670`, records `substantiveRounds: 6`, baseline `9a81e08569` = 26 files +2442/−23, and that the PR is in scope-correction mode). The production fix (pick one channel; render the name once) is deferred for the same reason. **Recorded here, not silently dropped** — this entry is the durable landing spot for both the fix and its two tests.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

5. **R1-27** — 一条发给 leader 的 teammate 消息被投影成两条客户端可见的行，且回合起始行把 teammate 名字渲染两遍。来源线程 #13902 `PRRT_kwDOPB-92c6sGa8b`（`SystemMessage.tsx:46`，bot，2026-10-13T23:17:37Z，**[Suggestion]**）。所有坐标在 live head `8d243a8672` 上重读过，未沿用 bot 的行号。**判级：REAL（两条腿都成立）**——不是「万一两边都发」的假想：两条通道在同一分支上对同一条消息无条件发出，并且终结于同一个客户端可见的更新函数。

   **腿 A（一条消息两行，其中一行重载后消失）**：生产侧 `TeamManager.ts:811` 写 leader 邮箱、`:836-841` 无条件 `emit(MESSAGE_SENT, { to: LEADER_NAME })`。邮箱那一半经 `team-sink.ts:310-312` → `Session.ts:11213-11214` → `#enqueueTeammateMessage`（`:11223-11255`，`label: sender` 在 `:11250`）→ `#enqueueBackgroundNotification`（`:11559`），在 `:11605` 入队、`:11606-11619` 调 `recordBackgroundTaskCompleted`（全文件仅此一处持久化点）、`:11620-11622` 发显示帧、`:11627` 排空队列即唤醒 leader。活动那一半经 `team-sink.ts:325` → `handleMessageSent`（`:286-294`）→ `#emitTeammateActivity`（`Session.ts:11297-11365`），`recipient === LEADER_NAME` 时盖 `depth:0 / kind:'root'`（`:11332-11336`）后调同一个 `#emitBackgroundNotificationDisplay`（`:12671-12692`）——该函数体只有一次 `sendUpdate`，**不记录任何东西**。于是活动行不持久化、邮箱行持久化：用户读到的两行里有一行重载后消失，两行还携带互相矛盾的 `_meta.agent`（`/root/<sender>` depth 1 `teammate` vs `/root` depth 0 `root`）与不同正文（逐字原文 vs 压缩成一行）。消费侧确认活动行真的可见：`transcriptToMessages.ts:443-446` / `:465-471` / `:809-825`（`source` 在 `:819`）→ `SystemMessage.tsx:372-376` → `:464-495`。`Session.ts:11289-11296` 自己的文档前提「these never enter the notification queue」对这类消息不成立；这同时回答了上面第 4 条（R1-25 part 2）留下的核验边界：`kind:'root'` 那条路到达显示帧但**不**到达持久化队列。**该抑制哪一半不由我们选**：`docs/design/2026-10-11-agent-team-identity-projection.md:39`（及 zh-CN 孪生）与 `Session.ts:11260-11261` 都写明入队会把 leader 唤醒进自动轮次，所以抑制邮箱那一半会同时丢掉持久化与唤醒；唯一可行方向是只对 leader-directed 消息抑制 `teammate_activity` 投影，并订正 `:11289-11296` 的注释。

   **腿 B（名字渲染两遍）**：`data-background-turn-start` 块（`SystemMessage.tsx:200-205`）里 `:221-225` 渲染 `@name` chip，`:238-243` 又渲染 `turn?.label`。两个生产者彼此独立：chip 来自 `teammateOfAgent(textBlock.agent)`（`transcriptToMessages.ts:813`，定义 `:1917`），label 来自 `Session.ts:11250` 的 `label: sender` 经 `parseDaemonBackgroundTurn(data)`（`SystemMessage.tsx:180`）读回。单发件人报告时两者解析出同一个名字，于是该行读作 `@<name>` + "Cross-session message"（`i18n.tsx:2239`）+ `·` + `<name>`。注意范围：第二个 chip 站点 `:478-482` 在 `isTaskNotification` 块内、该块不同时渲染 `turn.label`，所以腿 B 只发生在回合起始标记行。

   **要求的两个测试（已登记，且被熔断挡住）**：① `Session.test.ts` 对同一条消息既 `emit message_sent {to:'leader'}` 又调 `manager.leaderCallback`，断言客户端可见行恰好一条且重放后仍在——现有覆盖是劈开的（`:1288`、`:1377-1417` 只钉活动那一半，`:1474` 只断言监听器解绑），没有一条同时钉两半；② `SystemMessage.test.tsx` 断言渲染文本中 teammate 名字只出现一次——最近的 `:981`（`'Cross-session message·qwen on api'`，只有 label 没有 chip）与 `:1060`（`source="teammate_activity"`）都没钉住 chip+label 同行。两个测试在两条通道都仍投影时必须变红。**这两个测试是代码，本轮 #13902 上被熔断挡住**：+3611/−235、34 文件，对 1500 行增量上限（scope ledger 评论 `6122209670` 记 `substantiveRounds: 6`、baseline `9a81e08569` = 26 文件 +2442/−23、已进入 scope-correction）。生产侧修法（选定单一通道 + 名字只渲染一次）同因延期。**登记在此，不是静默丢弃。**

</details>

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

When a `UserPromptSubmit` hook delivers `additionalContext`, the client should compare the delivered items with the memory already present in the same turn from local sources (context files and structured Auto Memory bodies), and either drop the entries that are already there or keep them but mark them with the existing `[内容已在当前上下文]` marker instead of sending the full text a second time.

### Why is this needed?

A common deployment wires an external memory store (Mem0 or a compatible provider) around local markdown memory with two hooks: one that syncs local facts into the external store, and one that recalls from it on every submission. Local memory files stay in place.

The recalled payload and the local memory never meet:

1. Hook output is appended to the request as its own part, wrapped in a reserved tag — [`client.ts#L3946-L3959`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/core/client.ts#L3946-L3959).
2. `getAdditionalContext()` escapes `<` and `>` to prevent tag forgery and does nothing else — no comparison against local memory, and no length bound — [`hooks/types.ts#L473-L482`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/hooks/types.ts#L473-L482).
3. Local memory arrives on separate channels: `QWEN.md` and other context files go into the `contextFiles` system-prompt layer, managed Auto Memory into the `autoMemory` layer, and legacy query-time recall is unshifted onto the turn's system reminders — [`client.ts#L4592`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/core/client.ts#L4592).
4. Every existing deduplication is intra-source. `dedupeByCanonicalIdentity` only compares local files with each other ([`memoryDiscovery.ts#L228`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/memory/memoryDiscovery.ts#L228)); `alreadyAvailable` only recognizes bodies already delivered out of the local store ([`search-memory.ts#L775-L782`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/memory/search-memory.ts#L775-L782)); the `[内容已在当前上下文]` marker is emitted only by the local renderer ([`tree.ts#L283-L287`](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/main/packages/core/src/memory/tree.ts#L283-L287)). None of them can observe a hook payload.

So a fact that starts as a local file, is synced outward, and comes back on the next turn is delivered twice: once inside the system prompt, once at the tail of the user prompt. No code path compares the two. With a write hook in the loop this is deterministic rather than occasional — the local file is still present, so every recalled item it produced is a second copy of something already sent.

Two consequences. The cost is paid on every request, and `/compact` or a new session does not clear it because the duplication is configuration-level. And because the copies occupy different prompt positions, the model gets no signal that they are the same fact.

`docs/design/external-context-mem0-auto-recall.md` requires the on-demand and auto-recall *profiles of one package* to be mutually exclusive, but that does not cover the cross-component combination (built-in `memory.mem0` plus an extension auto-recall hook), and neither the documentation nor the code deduplicates a hook payload against local memory.

### Additional context

- Related but not duplicates: #13721 and #13722 deduplicate within local memory; #12028 governs the resident non-conversation prefix, while this is per-turn message content.
- A separate finding at the same injection point: `getAdditionalContext()` applies no length bound, so a hook can inject an arbitrary amount of text into the prompt. That is worth its own issue if it is not handled together with this one.

<details><summary>Client Information</summary>

```
Qwen Code v0.25.0
Model: qwen3.8-max
Fast Model: qwen3.8-flash
Auth: openai
Platform: darwin arm64 (27.0.0)
Node.js: v22.22.0
Git commit: 6788c03569
LSP: disabled
```

Behavior confirmed by source inspection at `e90cb3cbe7d8`.

</details>

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

本地 markdown 记忆 + 外部记忆库、用 hook 做写入同步和每轮召回的部署下，召回结果与本地记忆**没有任何跨源去重**，同一事实会在同一轮里投递两次。

- hook 的 `additionalContext` 被作为独立 part 追加到 user prompt 尾部（`client.ts#L3946-L3959`），而 `getAdditionalContext()` 只做 `<`/`>` 转义，不比对、不截断（`hooks/types.ts#L473-L482`）。
- 本地记忆走的是 system prompt 的 `contextFiles` / `autoMemory` 层，legacy 召回走 `systemReminders`（`client.ts#L4592`）。两者位置不同。
- 现存的去重全是**源内**的：`dedupeByCanonicalIdentity` 只管本地文件之间，`alreadyAvailable` 只认从本地库投递过的 body，`[内容已在当前上下文]` 标记只有本地渲染器会输出。都看不到 hook 载荷。

写入 hook 让这件事变成必然：本地文件还在，被同步出去的内容每一轮都会被召回回来，形成第二份。`/compact` 和新 session 都不会清除它，因为这是配置层面的重复。

</details>

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

**FG8**, and the two rounds behind it: multi-process fault gates for the capabilities that have been enabled for submission since FG7 landed.

#12380's Stage F exit gate is written per capability, not per stage:

> **F** | Pass ACK-loss, SSE-gap, process crash, cancellation, output-delivery, and storage-failure tests for **each enabled capability**.

and its acceptance criteria add:

> Production enablement additionally requires actor/tenant isolation, capacity limits, and **the fault gates for the selected deployment profile**.

FG1–FG7 are merged and cover four things: the Broker ↔ Runtime tool path (FG1–FG4, #12752, sixteen gates), W0c context installation (FG5, #12804, twelve gates), the Hosted tool turn including foreground Shell output and provider controls (FG6a–FG6f, #12873 / #12888 / #12896 / #12924 / #12942 / #12954 / #13061), and the channel domains (FG7, #13839).

Between 2026-10-10 and 2026-10-13 the gate lists widened considerably, and no fault-gate round came with any of it. On current `main` (`ce6361268b`, contract v1.44.0, Flyway V68):

- `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_DOMAINS` holds **18** domains, having gained `session_message` (#13822), `team_state` and `team_task` (#13846), `session_command` (#13928 / #13955 / #13974) and `monitor_run` (#13889).
- `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS` is **`['child_agent', 'shell', 'workflow']`** — the `shell` kind joined with #13889 and `workflow` with #13858.
- `MANAGED_SESSION_CHILD_CONTINUATIONS_ENABLED` is `true`.

The coverage check behind this issue is a negative one and is deliberately narrow. The three fault-gate integration suites on `main` — `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT`, `HostedChannelProcessCrashIT`, `HostedProcessCrashIT` — contain **zero** occurrences of `monitor`, `workflow`, `hook`, `mcp`, `automation`, `schedule`, `team`, `session_command` or `session_message`; the only capability words in them are channel words. The four `runtime-broker` suites carrying an FG marker are FG2 (`LostResponseFaultGateTest`), FG3 (`ProcessCrashFaultGateTest`), FG4 (`ConcurrencyStorageFaultGateTest`) and FG5 (`ContextInstallationFaultGateTest`). So the domain-level fault coverage that exists today is **channel only**.

Proposed decomposition, in the order I would land them. Each follows the FG6/FG7 practice: real packaged binaries, a fault-injecting proxy, MySQL or MariaDB rather than only H2, and one mutation check per gate so that removing the guard it covers turns exactly that gate red.

| Round | Capability | Why this priority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG8** | `monitor_run` and the `child_run` **`shell`** kind | These own real operating-system processes that outlive their turn, hold a Runtime, and were enabled on the strength of a physical acceptance pass rather than a fault round. Highest consequence, and the round #13856 explicitly asked to land with the enablement. |
| **FG9** | `session_message` and `session_command` | Cross-Session delivery through the lead's relay, with at-most-one-send and receipt-honesty semantics. A duplicated member message is user-visible and cannot be retracted. |
| **FG10** | the `child_run` **`workflow`** kind | Deterministic in-process execution under a pinned definition digest. The failure mode is a wedged child turn, which is exactly what the fractional-`args` digest mismatch produced before #13858 canonicalised the substrate. |

FG8's sub-gates, following the FG6 letter scheme by injected fault class:

| Gate | Inject | Expect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG8a — lost replies** | Drop or delay the reply to a background dispatch, a `monitor-stop`, a capture-page commit and a monitor observation advance, one at a time. | Each retry resolves through the original execution identity; at most one physical process per dispatch; a lost observation advance leaves `observationSequence`/`notifiedThrough` behind rather than skipping ahead. |
| **FG8b — store failures** | Reject the invocation-row commit, the `:process` ledger commit, the output-manifest commit and the page-envelope commit inside real transactions. | A failure before process start leaves zero OS effects; a failed manifest commit blocks the run without re-executing it; the Artifact read chain never resolves to a manifest whose page envelopes were not persisted. |
| **FG8c — process crashes** | SIGKILL the Harness after dispatch and after capture start; SIGKILL or SIGSTOP the worker; SIGKILL the background process itself. | No duplicate dispatch; an unknown outcome stays blocked with no terminal event; cold load refuses the unsettled run; a dead Runtime generation is never silently re-minted. |
| **FG8d — cancellation and drain** | Cancel before start, during capture, with status unavailable, and with the cancel reply dropped; then run the routine-release arm and the drain arm separately. | A routine release answers `409 runtime_session_held` and stops nothing; only the drain arm produces `cancelled`/`stop_requested` with `stopRequested: true`; a run the platform stopped is never settled as `exited`. |
| **FG8e — SSE gap** | Disconnect the public and WebShell streams during a background run and during a monitor observation, then resume with `Last-Event-ID` / `afterSequence`. | Both keep progressing; the replayed sequence has no duplicates and no gaps. |
| **FG8f — output delivery** | Kill the publisher mid-capture; exceed the in-flight cap; drop the receipt after the resume watermark commits. | The 16 MiB in-flight cap and the 4 MiB resume watermark hold under loss; a durable prefix stays byte-identical and readable; output is never re-executed to recover a lost receipt. |

FG8d and FG8f are the two that matter most, because they are the arms whose semantics changed in the last three days. #13889 split release into a routine arm that refuses and a drain arm that stops, and #13929 gave a Monitor auto-stop its remote exit evidence after the review of #13889 found the production `HostedMonitorRemoteExecutor` implementing `terminate` as `Promise.resolve()` — a settled record with a still-`running` worker, zero physical terminate calls, and a Runtime hold that the old turn-settle drain used to clean up for free. Both changes are correct and neither has a fault gate.

### Scope I would cut

Being explicit rather than leaving it to whoever picks this up:

- **`team_state` and `team_task` do not get a full six-class round.** They are board reads and writes inside the lead's own journal, with no OS process and no effect leaving the process, so ACK-loss, process-crash, cancellation and output-delivery degenerate into storage consistency. Fold a storage-failure case into the existing `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` / `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT` instead of building a suite.
- **`mcp_configuration` / `mcp_operation` / `hook_registration` / `hook_execution` / `schedule` / `automation_run` need a coverage audit before anyone writes a gate, not a gate now.** They were enabled before FG7 and may already be partly covered by FG1–FG5's tool-path gates, which are capability-agnostic. The delivery ledger also records an accepted exclusion for Hooks — "The author did not run Linux cgroup execution/drain, production MySQL or the Hook-specific owner-restart matrix" — so at least the Hook owner-restart arm is a known, deliberate gap rather than an oversight. The audit is a half-day of reading and produces either "already covered, here is the gate that covers it" or a named FG11.
- **`goal_state`, `session_metadata`, `file_history`, `session_source` are out.** They are A/W-stage record domains with no execution behind them.
- **The `email` adapter is the only enabled channel adapter**, so FG9's channel-adjacent cases should not assume a second provider exists.

### Why is this needed?

Stage F's exit gate is the only thing in #12380 that makes "enabled" mean something other than "the allowlist contains the name". Every capability that joined those lists in the last three days did so on the strength of a physical acceptance pass, a design decision, or a merged runtime slice — all of which prove the happy path on one host at one commit. None of them proves that the record stays honest when a reply is lost after commit, when a process dies mid-capture, or when the platform's own stop path is the thing that failed.

The concrete risk is not hypothetical, because the two reviews that preceded the H3 enablement found exactly this class of defect by hand:

- A Monitor whose record settled `settled` with a correct `stopReason` while the worker still answered `running`, with zero physical terminate calls and the Runtime hold still true — because `terminate` was `Promise.resolve()` and the turn-settle drain that used to mask it no longer runs (#13896, fixed by #13929).
- A Monitor parked on quota or idle timeout that could never consume later real exit evidence, leaving the record at `recovery_blocked / outcome_unknown` with a null `stopReason` even though the worker had exited, the hold had been released and the capture was complete and error-free.

Both were found by reading code and running a rig. A fault-gate round is what makes the next one fail a build instead of waiting for a reviewer.

There is also a standing cost to leaving this open, and it is the same one #13856 named: the longer a capability runs without gates, the more code lands beside it assuming the unsettled states are unreachable. #13986 (restart-proofing the held-Runtime drain obligation, from #13930) is already changing the restart behaviour that FG8c would pin.

### Additional context

Part of #12380, Stage F. Follows #12748 (FG1–FG4), #12804 (FG5), #12872 (FG6, that slice's tracker) and #13802 (FG7, closed as delivered by #13839).

Related, as the code under test: **#13889** (the H3 enablement, which landed `monitor_run` and the `shell` kind together with the routine/drain release split), **#13929** (Monitor auto-stop remote exit evidence, from **#13896**), **#13858** (the workflow kind's runtime), **#13822** (`session_message`), **#13846** (`team_state` / `team_task`), **#13928** / **#13955** / **#13974** (`session_command`: board tools, member messages, plan approval), **#13265** (the H3 runtime itself). Adjacent in-flight work that FG8 will need to be rebased against: **#13986** (restart-proof the held-Runtime drain, from **#13930**), **#14021** (settle never-started background dispatches in the resident Session, from **#13801** / **#13937**), **#13918** (tenant-wide InnoDB locks must not wedge unrelated Sessions, workstream A2 of **#13800**).

Out of scope: the foreground Hosted tool turn, which FG6a–FG6f already cover; the channel domains, which FG7 covers; provider-specific adapters beyond the enabled `email` one; capacity limits and the selected-deployment-profile gates, which #12380 treats separately; Windows process semantics; the cross-host case where two live owners may observe the same process.

Naming: FG6 used letter suffixes per injected fault class and FG7 was one round for one capability area. FG8/FG9/FG10 follow that, with FG8a–FG8f above. If the maintainers would rather reopen #12872 than carry three new trackers, the decomposition is unchanged.

Verification note: the Stage F exit-gate and acceptance-criteria quotations, the FG1–FG7 numbering with their merge commits, the enabled-domain and kind lists, and the zero-hit keyword check across the three fault-gate IT suites were all read at `main` = `ce6361268b` (contract v1.44.0, Flyway V68) on 2026-10-13. The keyword check is a negative result over three named files, not over the whole test tree — a gate for one of these capabilities that lives in a file without `fault` in its name would not have shown up, which is why the `mcp` / `hook` / `schedule` / `automation` line above asks for an audit instead of asserting a gap.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

### 希望增加什么？

**FG8**，以及排在它后面的两轮：为自 FG7 合入以来已被启用提交的各能力补多进程故障门禁。

#12380 的 F 阶段验收判据是按能力写的，不是按阶段写的：

> **F** | Pass ACK-loss, SSE-gap, process crash, cancellation, output-delivery, and storage-failure tests for **each enabled capability**.

其验收标准还补了一句：

> Production enablement additionally requires actor/tenant isolation, capacity limits, and **the fault gates for the selected deployment profile**.

FG1–FG7 已合入，覆盖四件事：Broker ↔ Runtime 工具路径（FG1–FG4，#12752，十六道门禁）、W0c 上下文安装（FG5，#12804，十二道门禁）、Hosted 工具轮次含前台 Shell 输出与 provider 控制（FG6a–FG6f，#12873 / #12888 / #12896 / #12924 / #12942 / #12954 / #13061）、以及 channel 各域（FG7，#13839）。

2026-10-10 到 2026-10-13 之间门禁列表扩了不少，而没有任何一轮故障门禁随之落地。在当前 `main`（`ce6361268b`，契约 v1.44.0，Flyway V68）上：

- `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_DOMAINS` 有 **18** 个域，期间新增 `session_message`（#13822）、`team_state` 与 `team_task`（#13846）、`session_command`（#13928 / #13955 / #13974）与 `monitor_run`（#13889）。
- `MANAGED_SESSION_ENABLED_CHILD_RUN_KINDS` 是 **`['child_agent', 'shell', 'workflow']`** —— `shell` 随 #13889 加入，`workflow` 随 #13858 加入。
- `MANAGED_SESSION_CHILD_CONTINUATIONS_ENABLED` 为 `true`。

本 issue 背后的覆盖核查是一个否定性核查，且范围刻意收窄。`main` 上的三个故障门禁集成套件 —— `HostedChannelFaultGatesIT`、`HostedChannelProcessCrashIT`、`HostedProcessCrashIT` —— 对 `monitor`、`workflow`、`hook`、`mcp`、`automation`、`schedule`、`team`、`session_command`、`session_message` 的命中数为**零**；其中唯一出现的能力词是 channel 词。`runtime-broker` 侧带 FG 标记的四个套件是 FG2（`LostResponseFaultGateTest`）、FG3（`ProcessCrashFaultGateTest`）、FG4（`ConcurrencyStorageFaultGateTest`）与 FG5（`ContextInstallationFaultGateTest`）。所以今天存在的域级故障覆盖**只有 channel**。

建议的分解，按我落地的顺序排列。每一轮沿用 FG6/FG7 的做法：真实的打包二进制、一个注入故障的代理、MySQL 或 MariaDB 而不只是 H2，以及每道门禁一次变异检查，使移除它所覆盖的防护时恰好那道门禁变红。

| 轮次 | 能力 | 为何是这个优先级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG8** | `monitor_run` 与 `child_run` 的 **`shell`** kind | 它们拥有会活过自身 turn 的真实操作系统进程、持有 Runtime，而且是靠一次物理验收走查而非一轮故障门禁被启用的。后果最重，也正是 #13856 明确要求随启用一起落地的那一轮。 |
| **FG9** | `session_message` 与 `session_command` | 经 lead 的 relay 做跨 Session 投递，带「最多一次发送」与回执诚实性语义。一条重复的成员消息是用户可见的，且无法撤回。 |
| **FG10** | `child_run` 的 **`workflow`** kind | 在一个被 pin 住的定义摘要下做进程内确定性执行。失效形态是 child turn 被楔死，而这正是 #13858 规范化摘要底座之前 fractional `args` 摘要不匹配所产生的东西。 |

FG8 的子门禁，沿用 FG6 按注入故障类分字母的方案：

| 门禁 | 注入 | 期望 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **FG8a — 应答丢失** | 逐一丢弃或延迟一次后台派发、一次 `monitor-stop`、一次 capture page 提交与一次 monitor 观测推进的应答。 | 每次重试都通过原执行身份解决；每次派发最多一个物理进程；一次丢失的观测推进让 `observationSequence`/`notifiedThrough` 落在后面，而不是往前跳。 |
| **FG8b — 存储故障** | 在真实事务里拒绝 invocation 行提交、`:process` ledger 提交、output manifest 提交与 page envelope 提交。 | 进程启动前的失败不产生任何 OS 副作用；manifest 提交失败会阻塞该 run 而不重执行；Artifact 读链绝不解析到一个其 page envelopes 未被持久化的 manifest。 |
| **FG8c — 进程崩溃** | 在派发后与 capture 开始后 SIGKILL Harness；SIGKILL 或 SIGSTOP worker；SIGKILL 后台进程自身。 | 不重复派发；结果未知时保持阻塞且没有终态事件；冷加载拒绝未结算的 run；死掉的 Runtime generation 绝不被静默重铸。 |
| **FG8d — 取消与 drain** | 分别在启动前、capture 进行中、status 不可用时取消，以及丢弃取消的应答；然后把例行 release 臂与 drain 臂分开跑。 | 例行 release 答 `409 runtime_session_held` 且不停任何东西；只有 drain 臂产生 `cancelled`/`stop_requested` 与 `stopRequested: true`；被平台停掉的 run 绝不被结算成 `exited`。 |
| **FG8e — SSE 断流** | 在一次后台 run 与一次 monitor 观测期间断开公开与 WebShell 事件流，再用 `Last-Event-ID` / `afterSequence` 续传。 | 两者都继续推进；重放的序列不重复、不缺失。 |
| **FG8f — 输出投递** | 在 capture 中途杀掉 publisher；超出 in-flight 上限；在恢复水位提交之后丢弃回执。 | 16 MiB in-flight 上限与 4 MiB 恢复水位在丢失下仍成立；已持久的前缀保持逐字节相同且可读；绝不为找回一个丢失的回执而重执行输出。 |

FG8d 与 FG8f 是其中最重要的两道，因为它们正是过去三天里语义发生变化的两个臂。#13889 把 release 拆成一个拒绝的例行臂与一个停止的 drain 臂；#13929 则在对 #13889 的评审发现生产用的 `HostedMonitorRemoteExecutor` 把 `terminate` 实现成 `Promise.resolve()` 之后，给了 Monitor 自动停止它的远端退出证据 —— 那时的形态是：记录已结算、worker 仍 `running`、物理 terminate 调用数为零，而 Runtime hold 还在，从前替它兜底的 turn-settle drain 已经不跑了。两个改动都是对的，两个都没有故障门禁。

### 我要砍掉的范围

明确写出来，而不是留给接手的人去猜：

- **`team_state` 与 `team_task` 不做完整六类轮次。** 它们是 lead 自己 journal 内的 board 读写，没有 OS 进程、也没有离开进程的副作用，所以应答丢失、进程崩溃、取消与输出投递都退化成存储一致性。把一道存储故障用例折进已有的 `HostedTeamLeadMySqlIT` / `HostedTeamMemberCommandMySqlIT`，而不是新建一个套件。
- **`mcp_configuration` / `mcp_operation` / `hook_registration` / `hook_execution` / `schedule` / `automation_run` 需要先做覆盖审计，而不是现在就写门禁。** 它们在 FG7 之前就已启用，可能已被 FG1–FG5 那些与能力无关的工具路径门禁部分覆盖。交付台账也为 Hooks 记了一条被接受的排除项 ——「The author did not run Linux cgroup execution/drain, production MySQL or the Hook-specific owner-restart matrix」—— 所以至少 Hook 的 owner-restart 那一臂是一个已知的、刻意的缺口，而不是疏漏。这个审计是半天的阅读，产出要么是「已覆盖，这是覆盖它的那道门禁」，要么是一个具名的 FG11。
- **`goal_state`、`session_metadata`、`file_history`、`session_source` 不在范围内。** 它们是 A/W 阶段的记录域，背后没有执行。
- **`email` 是唯一已启用的 channel 适配器**，所以 FG9 里与 channel 相邻的用例不应假设还存在第二个 provider。

### 为什么需要？

F 阶段的验收判据是 #12380 里唯一让「已启用」这个词有意义（而不只是「白名单里有这个名字」）的东西。过去三天里加入那些列表的每一项能力，靠的都是一次物理验收走查、一个设计决定，或一个已合入的运行时切片 —— 这些证明的都是某台宿主上、某个提交上的顺利路径。它们都不证明：当一次应答在提交之后丢失、当一个进程在 capture 中途死亡、或当平台自己的停止路径就是那个失败的东西时，记录是否仍然诚实。

这个风险不是假设性的，因为 H3 启用之前的那两次评审就是靠人手找到了这一类缺陷：

- 一个 Monitor，其记录已结算为 `settled` 且 `stopReason` 正确，而 worker 仍答 `running`，物理 terminate 调用数为零，Runtime hold 仍为 true —— 因为 `terminate` 是 `Promise.resolve()`，而从前掩盖它的 turn-settle drain 已不再运行（#13896，由 #13929 修复）。
- 一个因配额或空闲超时而 park 的 Monitor，再也无法消费之后到达的真实退出证据，于是即便 worker 已退出、hold 已释放、capture 完整且无错，记录仍停在 `recovery_blocked / outcome_unknown`、`stopReason` 为 null。

两者都是靠读代码加跑 rig 找到的。一轮故障门禁的作用，是让下一个同类缺陷去打红一次构建，而不是去等一位评审者。

留着不做还有一笔持续成本，和 #13856 点出的是同一笔：一项能力在没有门禁的情况下跑得越久，落在它旁边、假设那些未结算状态不可达的代码就越多。#13986（把 held-Runtime 的 drain 义务做成重启可证，出自 #13930）已经在改 FG8c 本该钉住的那个重启行为。

### 补充信息

属于 #12380，F 阶段。接续 #12748（FG1–FG4）、#12804（FG5）、#12872（FG6，该片的跟踪者）与 #13802（FG7，已作为 #13839 的交付关闭）。

作为被测代码的相关项：**#13889**（H3 启用，把 `monitor_run` 与 `shell` kind 连同 routine/drain release 拆分一起落地）、**#13929**（Monitor 自动停止的远端退出证据，出自 **#13896**）、**#13858**（workflow kind 的运行时）、**#13822**（`session_message`）、**#13846**（`team_state` / `team_task`）、**#13928** / **#13955** / **#13974**（`session_command`：board 工具、成员消息、plan 审批）、**#13265**（H3 运行时本身）。FG8 需要绕开的在飞相邻工作：**#13986**（restart-proof the held-Runtime drain，出自 **#13930**）、**#14021**（在常驻 Session 内结算从未启动的后台派发，出自 **#13801** / **#13937**）、**#13918**（租户级 InnoDB 锁不得楔死无关 Session，**#13800** 的 workstream A2）。

不在范围内：前台 Hosted 工具轮次（FG6a–FG6f 已覆盖）；channel 各域（FG7 已覆盖）；除已启用的 `email` 之外的 provider 特定适配器；容量上限与选定部署剖面的门禁（#12380 另行处理）；Windows 进程语义；两个存活所有者可能观测同一进程的跨主机情形。

命名：FG6 用字母后缀区分各注入故障类，FG7 是一个能力域一轮。FG8/FG9/FG10 沿用该方案，FG8a–FG8f 见上。如果维护者更愿意重开 #12872 而不是背三个新跟踪者，上面的分解不变。

核实说明：F 阶段验收判据与验收标准的引文、FG1–FG7 的编号及其合入提交、两道启用列表的内容，以及三个故障门禁 IT 套件上的零命中关键词核查，均已于 2026-10-13 在 `main` = `ce6361268b`（契约 v1.44.0，Flyway V68）上读取。该关键词核查是三个具名文件上的否定性结果，不是整棵测试树上的 —— 一个把门禁放在文件名不含 `fault` 的文件里的能力不会被它查到，这正是上面 `mcp` / `hook` / `schedule` / `automation` 那一行要求做审计、而不是断言缺口的原因。

</details>

issues.title: [H4b follow-up] A Harness crash inside a batch with no Runtime work blocks the lead Session (background launches, team calls)

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/core
labels.description: Core engine and logic

labels.name: scope/session-management
labels.description: Session state and persistence

labels.name: roadmap/multi-agent
labels.description: Roadmap: Multi-agent collaboration

issues.body:
## Problem

A Hosted Turn whose tool batch has no Runtime work (only background Agent launches, or since #13846 team calls) commits nothing durable that says the Turn is mid-batch. If the Harness dies after such a call commits its journal write and before the Turn's next checkpoint, a replacement Harness cannot take the Turn over, and the lead Session stays blocked from then on:

- The Turn is parked at `model_output_committed`, a model-start phase. (The runs below used `default` mode; in `yolo` mode, where no approval wait checkpoints the Turn, the code declines the takeover the same way. That reading is from the code and was not run.) `recoverHostedRuntimeTurn` answers `declined('model_start')`, and the coordinator fails the Turn `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` ("The prior Harness generation parked a Turn this Harness cannot take over (model_start).").
- The lead's journal still holds that unsettled input, so every later load of the lead is refused (`load refused (unsettled_input)`, HTTP 409 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`).
- The child result relay must load the lead to record the child's dispatch, attach and result, so its ledger row stays in `binding` and retries forever. The child Session runs and completes, but its `child_run` stays at revision 1 (`planned`), its Session stays ACTIVE, and its result never reaches the lead.
- Every later user Turn on the lead fails the same way, so a follow-up prompt does not unblock it. Nothing in the runs below unblocked it.

This is the background-launch counterpart of #13708, which #13769 fixed for foreground child waits by committing an agent-wait checkpoint. A background launch, and a team call, takes no Runtime reservation, so `commitAwaitRuntimeBatch` (`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`, committed only when `bindings.length` is non-zero) never runs for such a batch. #13829 made every recovery route answer journal-only calls by what committed, but this crash point never reaches those routes: the takeover is declined first.

## Reproduction (physical pass for #13846, 2026-10-10)

Rig: aarch64 Linux; packaged `qwen-managed-agent-server` jar (Store, Broker, relay, coordinator), bundled CLI as `serve --profile hosted-harness`, durable local workers, MariaDB, real model (`qwen3.8-max`), `default` approval mode, public `/v1/agents/sessions` API; the Session is moved to `hosted-workspace-shell/1` by SQL before its first Turn. A proxy in front of the Session Store SIGKILLs the Harness on a chosen commit, then the Harness is restarted.

| Arm | Kill point | Records | Lead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Team member, before join | `joinTeam` commit arrives, not forwarded | one `child_run`, no roster entry | Turn fails `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`; relay `binding`, `hosted_turn_recovery_required` |
| Team member, after join | `joinTeam` committed, answer lost | one `child_run`, one roster entry | same |
| **Control: no team, unnamed background launch** | `startChildRun` committed, answer lost | one `child_run` | **same** |

The control arm runs on the code path that is enabled on main today (H4b `child_agent`), so this does not depend on teams. Re-tested on a build that includes #13829: unchanged.

## Impact and reach

- A crash inside this window permanently blocks the lead Session and loses the child's result, although the child did its work.
- Teams widen the window: every team write (`team_create`, `task_create`, `task_update`, `team_delete`, a member join) is a journal-only commit inside a batch with no Runtime work. Design open question 5 of `docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.md` accepts the window for the enablement; open question 4 is the same window on a Hooks Session, whose bare load resumes only a Turn parked at `results_ready`.
- Reach today: only Shell-laned Hosted Sessions declare the Agent and team tools, and no public Java route creates one (a public Workspace Session gets `hosted-workspace-files/1`). The window opens for users when a public route opens a Shell profile.

## What a fix has to decide

- Give a batch with journal-only calls a checkpoint a replacement Harness can drive, as #13769 did for the foreground agent wait. One shape: commit a checkpoint before the batch's first journal-only write that names the calls, so the takeover can answer them with `answerCommittedTurnCalls` / `answerResumedTurnCalls` and then resume the round or settle the Turn.
- Or let the takeover settle a model-start park whose open round holds only journal-only calls: answer the committed ones by what committed, answer the rest as never run, and end the Turn, instead of declining.
- Either way the lead must become loadable again, so the relay can record the child's attach and result and deliver the notification (labeled `<teammate>` when the join committed).
- The same answer should cover a Hooks Session (open question 4) and the `yolo` shape where no checkpoint bound the Turn.

## Acceptance probes

- Kill the Harness after `startChildRun` of an unnamed background launch, restart: the lead's interrupted call is answered as started, later Turns run, and the child's result reaches the lead.
- The same with a team member before and after its `:join` commit: one `child_run`, at most one roster entry, the result arrives labeled when joined.
- The same after `task_create` / `task_update` commits: no second task, and the model is told to read `task_list`.
- A Hooks Session and a `yolo` Session with the same batches.

## References

- #13708 / #13769: the foreground counterpart and its checkpoint fix.
- #13829: journal-only calls answered on every recovery route.
- #13550 (H4b child Session runtime), #13824 and #13846 (H4e-b1 team runtime and its enablement), #13745 (H4e).
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts` (`commitAwaitRuntimeBatch` only with Runtime bindings), `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.ts` (`declined('model_start')`), `packages/core/src/managed-runtime/managed-harness-checkpoint.ts` (`HARNESS_MODEL_START_PHASES`), `HarnessCoordinator` (`managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`), `ChildResultRelay` (the `binding` row).

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 问题

工具批次里没有 Runtime 工作的 Hosted Turn（只有后台 Agent 启动，或自 #13846 起的团队调用），不会提交任何能表明"该 Turn 正处于批次中"的持久记录。如果 Harness 在这类调用提交其 journal 写入之后、Turn 的下一个检查点之前死掉，替代的 Harness 无法接管该 Turn，lead Session 从此一直被阻塞：

- 该 Turn 停在 `model_output_committed`，属于模型起步阶段。（下面的运行使用 `default` 模式；在 `yolo` 模式下没有审批等待为该 Turn 写检查点，代码同样会拒绝接管。这一点来自读代码，没有实际运行。）`recoverHostedRuntimeTurn` 回答 `declined('model_start')`，协调器以 `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 让该 Turn 失败（"The prior Harness generation parked a Turn this Harness cannot take over (model_start)."）。
- lead 的 journal 仍保留这条未结算的输入，因此之后每次加载 lead 都被拒绝（`load refused (unsettled_input)`，HTTP 409 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`）。
- child 结果 relay 必须加载 lead 才能记录 child 的 dispatch、attach 与结果，因此其账本行一直停在 `binding` 并无限重试。child Session 会运行并完成，但它的 `child_run` 停在第 1 版（`planned`），Session 保持 ACTIVE，结果永远到不了 lead。
- 之后 lead 上的每个用户 Turn 都以同样方式失败，因此再发一条消息也解不开。下面的运行中没有任何操作能解开它。

这是 #13708 在后台启动上的对应问题；#13769 通过提交 agent 等待检查点修复了前台 child 等待。后台启动和团队调用都不占用 Runtime 预留，因此 `commitAwaitRuntimeBatch`（`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`，只在 `bindings.length` 非零时提交）在这类批次上从不运行。#13829 让每条恢复路径都按已提交内容回答只写 journal 的调用，但这个崩溃点根本到不了那些路径：接管会先被拒绝。

## 复现（#13846 的实机验收，2026-10-10）

环境：aarch64 Linux；打包的 `qwen-managed-agent-server` jar（Store、Broker、relay、协调器）、以 `serve --profile hosted-harness` 运行的打包 CLI、持久本地 worker、MariaDB、真实模型（`qwen3.8-max`）、`default` 审批模式、公共 `/v1/agents/sessions` API；Session 在第一个 Turn 之前用 SQL 切到 `hosted-workspace-shell/1`。Session Store 前的代理在选定的提交上 SIGKILL Harness，然后重启 Harness。

| 分组 | 杀点 | 记录 | lead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 团队成员，加入之前 | `joinTeam` 提交到达，未转发 | 一个 `child_run`，没有名册条目 | Turn 以 `managed_runtime_recovery_blocked` 失败；relay 停在 `binding`，`hosted_turn_recovery_required` |
| 团队成员，加入之后 | `joinTeam` 已提交，回答丢失 | 一个 `child_run`，一个名册条目 | 同上 |
| **对照：无团队、不带名字的后台启动** | `startChildRun` 已提交，回答丢失 | 一个 `child_run` | **同上** |

对照组走的是 main 上今天已启用的代码路径（H4b `child_agent`），因此这个问题与团队无关。在包含 #13829 的构建上复测：结果不变。

## 影响与可达性

- 在这个窗口内崩溃会永久阻塞 lead Session，并丢失 child 的结果，尽管 child 已经完成了工作。
- 团队会扩大这个窗口：每次团队写入（`team_create`、`task_create`、`task_update`、`team_delete`、成员加入）都是没有 Runtime 工作的批次中的只写 journal 提交。`docs/design/2026-10-10-managed-agent-team-lead-runtime.md` 的开放问题 5 为启用接受了这个窗口；开放问题 4 是同一窗口在 Hooks Session 上的形态，Hooks Session 的裸加载只恢复停在 `results_ready` 的 Turn。
- 目前的可达性：只有带 Shell 通道的 Hosted Session 会声明 Agent 与团队工具，而没有公共 Java 路由会创建这种 Session（公共 Workspace Session 得到 `hosted-workspace-files/1`）。等公共路由开放 Shell 档位，用户就会遇到这个窗口。

## 修复需要决定什么

- 给含有只写 journal 调用的批次一个替代 Harness 能够驱动的检查点，就像 #13769 为前台 agent 等待所做的那样。一种形态：在批次第一次只写 journal 的写入之前提交一个列出这些调用的检查点，接管时就可以用 `answerCommittedTurnCalls` / `answerResumedTurnCalls` 回答它们，然后继续这一轮或结算该 Turn。
- 或者让接管能够结算一个停在模型起步、且当前轮只含只写 journal 调用的 Turn：按已提交内容回答已提交的调用，其余回答为从未运行，然后结束该 Turn，而不是拒绝接管。
- 无论哪种，lead 都必须重新可加载，让 relay 能记录 child 的 attach 与结果并投递通知（加入已提交时带 `<teammate>` 标签）。
- 同一方案应覆盖 Hooks Session（开放问题 4）以及没有检查点绑定该 Turn 的 `yolo` 形态。

## 验收探针

- 在不带名字的后台启动的 `startChildRun` 之后杀掉 Harness 并重启：lead 被中断的调用被回答为已启动，之后的 Turn 能正常运行，child 的结果到达 lead。
- 对团队成员在其 `:join` 提交之前与之后做同样的操作：一个 `child_run`，至多一个名册条目，已加入时结果带标签到达。
- 在 `task_create` / `task_update` 提交之后做同样的操作：没有第二个任务，模型被告知去读 `task_list`。
- 用同样的批次在 Hooks Session 与 `yolo` Session 上各做一遍。

## 参考

- #13708 / #13769：前台对应问题及其检查点修复。
- #13829：在每条恢复路径上回答只写 journal 的调用。
- #13550（H4b child Session 运行时）、#13824 与 #13846（H4e-b1 团队运行时及其启用）、#13745（H4e）。
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`（`commitAwaitRuntimeBatch` 只在有 Runtime 绑定时提交）、`packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.ts`（`declined('model_start')`）、`packages/core/src/managed-runtime/managed-harness-checkpoint.ts`（`HARNESS_MODEL_START_PHASES`）、`HarnessCoordinator`（`managed_runtime_recovery_blocked`）、`ChildResultRelay`（`binding` 行）。

</details>
