issues.title: Web Shell: open context usage details in place instead of appending cards to the conversation

labels.name: priority/P3
labels.description: Low - Minor, cosmetic, nice-to-fix issues

labels.name: type/feature-request
labels.description: New feature or enhancement request

labels.name: category/ui
labels.description: User interface and display

issues.body:
## What would you like to be added?

Rework how the context usage indicator in the Web Shell composer toolbar (the ring with a percentage next to the send button) handles hover and click:

- **Hover** keeps showing the lightweight summary popover it shows today: usage percentage, used / context window / remaining tokens, and the quick actions.
- **Click** opens the full context breakdown (system prompt, built-in tools, MCP tools, skills, memory files, messages, ...) in a dedicated details surface anchored to the indicator, such as an expanded popover or a dialog, instead of posting a "Context Usage" card into the conversation.
- Inside that details surface the user can keep interacting: expand or collapse each category to see individual items, compress context, and close it with Esc or a click outside.
- Clicking again while the details surface is open should reuse or close it. It should never stack a second copy.

Typing `/context` or `/context detail` in the composer can keep its current behavior of printing the result into the conversation, since the user explicitly asked for it there.

## Why is this needed?

Today a click on the indicator appends a new "Context Usage" card to the conversation, and clicking "View details" on that card appends one more card with the breakdown. Every click adds another card, so checking context usage a few times during a long session leaves several near-identical cards in the transcript.

This creates a few problems:

- **Noise in the transcript.** Context usage is a status check rather than conversation content, yet it ends up interleaved with the user's prompts and the agent's replies and pushes real content out of view.
- **Stale snapshots.** Each card is a point-in-time snapshot. Older cards stay in the history with outdated numbers, which makes it easy to read the wrong one.
- **Hover and click do nearly the same thing.** Hover already shows the summary, and the click shows almost the same summary again, just in a different place. Click is the natural place to go one level deeper.
- **Losing your place.** Posting a card can scroll the conversation to the bottom, which is disruptive when the user was reading earlier output.

A details surface that opens in place, can be explored, and closes without leaving traces gives a much lighter "glance, then dig in" flow.

## Additional context

- The current hover popover says "Click to view the breakdown in the conversation." That copy would need updating to match the new behavior.
- The popover already has a "View details" action that opens the breakdown in the side panel and reuses a single tab. One option is to make a click on the indicator open the same single-instance view, so the app ends up with one consistent details surface instead of two.
- Touch devices have no hover, so on mobile a tap should probably open the summary first and offer a way to reach the details from there.
- Screenshot of the current hover popover attached below.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

## 希望增加什么？

调整 Web Shell 输入框工具栏里上下文用量指示器（发送按钮旁边带百分比的圆环）的悬停和点击行为：

- **悬停**：保持现在的轻量摘要弹层，展示用量百分比、已用 / 上下文窗口 / 剩余 token，以及快捷操作。
- **点击**：在指示器旁边打开完整的上下文明细（system prompt、内置工具、MCP 工具、skills、memory 文件、消息等），可以是展开后的弹层或对话框，不再往对话流里插入一张 "Context Usage" 卡片。
- 用户可以在明细弹层里继续操作：展开或收起每个分类查看具体条目、压缩上下文，按 Esc 或点击外部关闭。
- 明细弹层已经打开时再次点击，应复用或关闭它，不能叠出第二份。

在输入框里手动输入 `/context` 或 `/context detail`，仍然可以保持现在的行为，把结果输出到对话流中，因为这是用户主动要求放在那里的。

## 为什么需要？

现在点击指示器会往对话流里追加一张 "Context Usage" 卡片，再点卡片上的 "View details"（查看明细），又会追加一张明细卡片。每点一次就多一张，长会话里查看几次上下文用量，对话记录里就会留下好几张几乎一样的卡片。

这带来几个问题：

- **对话记录被干扰**：上下文用量是状态查询，不属于对话内容，却和用户提问、agent 回复穿插在一起，把真正的内容挤出视野。
- **快照过期**：每张卡片都是某一时刻的快照，旧卡片带着过时的数字留在历史里，很容易看错。
- **悬停和点击几乎重复**：悬停已经展示了摘要，点击后看到的还是差不多的摘要，只是换了个位置。点击更适合用来进入下一层细节。
- **打断阅读位置**：插入卡片可能会让对话滚到底部，用户正在看前面的输出时会被打断。

在原地打开、可以继续探索、关闭后不留痕迹的明细弹层，能让"先瞄一眼，再深入看"这个流程轻很多。

## 补充信息

- 现在的悬停弹层里写着 "Click to view the breakdown in the conversation."（点击在对话中查看明细），这句文案需要跟着新行为更新。
- 弹层里已经有一个 "View details" 操作，会在侧边面板打开明细，并且只复用同一个标签页。一个可选方案是让点击指示器也打开这个单实例视图，这样整个应用只有一个统一的明细入口，而不是两套。
- 触屏设备没有悬停，移动端点击可能应该先打开摘要，再从摘要进入明细。
- 当前悬停弹层的截图附在下方。

</details>

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a general `FileChanged` hook for local, non-managed sessions. Integrators can watch literal cwd filenames or register absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications carry the absolute path and `add`, `change`, or `unlink`, regardless of whether the writer is Qwen Code, a shell command, an editor, or another process.

The listening session owns the watcher. Session rotation discards outgoing registrations and queued work, and shutdown cancels notifications and releases subscriptions. ACP bootstrap loads hooks without watching; actual sessions own their subscriptions. Direct skill registration and removal refresh the listening session without a reload. Managed engines, remote execution environments and sandbox workers do not create a host filesystem watcher.

The CI repairs retain the original behavioral checks, isolate temporary fixtures, and exclude unused notification translations from the read-only transcript bundle without changing its size limit. The latest repair aligns completed permanent-deletion assertions with the existing retirement contract: writer identity and lease are cleared, the journal is `DELETED`, and the writer-generation constraints and recovery/resource checks remain enforced.

## Why it's needed

Businesses observing memory files need additions, edits and deletions from every writer. This replaces the memory-specific proposal in #12561 with a general filesystem event, as requested by the integration owner. Businesses register their actual memory directories, including directories from several accessible workspaces, and route notices by absolute path. Initial scans, deletion reconciliation, retries and changes while the CLI is absent remain business responsibilities. The separate memory enable/disable requirement in #12558 stays open.

Design reference: [Claude Code FileChanged](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#filechanged) and [SessionStart watchPaths](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#sessionstart-decision-control). This proposal follows the general filesystem notification and dynamic watch-list pattern while retaining Qwen Code matcher behavior; Claude-specific environment-file and cwd-change behavior is outside this implementation.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Register a memory directory outside cwd during SessionStart, with a FileChanged receiver that omits its matcher. Add, modify and delete a topic, including a future nested file. Expect absolute paths, the matching event and the listening session ID.
- Register two accessible workspace memory directories in one list. Expect both directories' notices with the same listening session ID; route them by absolute path. A regex matcher filters already registered paths and does not register its own directory.
- Register a literal cwd filename without a SessionStart hook. Replace or clear dynamic paths and confirm static registrations remain active. Failed, asynchronous, omitted or invalid output must not replace dynamic roots.
- Rotate or clear a session, including with a slow outgoing SessionEnd. Expect replacement-session ownership and continued delivery. Shutdown must cancel running notifications and discard queued work.
- Initialize ACP without creating a session: expect no filesystem notices. Create a real ACP session: expect its first subsequent registered-file change to carry that session and its transcript path. Register and remove a skill hook directly and confirm subscriptions update without reload.
- Confirm managed, remote and sandbox configurations do not watch the host. Hook errors or blocking decisions must leave completed file changes intact. Write handler output outside the watched set to avoid self-trigger loops.
- Complete permanent deletion under resident expiry, Spring restart, lost settle acknowledgment and lost detach acknowledgment. Expect retired writer identity, the specified generation, released original resources, physical output collection and an unaffected companion session.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for TUI visuals. Historical actual Web Shell verification at `5611882`/tree-equivalent `8914711` created a fresh session, saved Project memory, observed the exact 171 bytes through a real command receiver, and passed add/change/unlink plus registration/filtering controls. That run is retained as historical evidence rather than a new-head UI run.

Published head: `97ee35404335efd982bb25c2d32d70d17307fdc2`, complete tree `930f0dc04419eeb0ebfc726b8bbc557eaffec12b`. Build, bundle, full typecheck including integration types, and lint passed. Focused tests: 1,048 core, 4 CLI and 40 Web Shell, totaling 1,092 actual passes; 1,309 filtered CLI tests were not executed. Six independent compiled/actual bundled ACP controls passed against the same source tree and bundle. The macOS full build used the same build script with an 8 GiB V8 heap after the default 4 GiB run exhausted memory.

Linux Java 21/MySQL 8.4.6 comparison: `pristine main 6212189 and the original CI merge 1b355df each reproduced all four writer-identity failures (0 errors, 0 skipped); the corrected candidate passed all four integration scenarios and 18 storage tests, with 0 skips, Checkstyle 0 and Maven exit 0`. [Verification details, failed attempts and evidence boundaries](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#issuecomment-6125790018).

Product CI and review are separate: `new-head checks are queued/running and are not a pass. Before this push, 07ec8ff had 26 successful, 2 failed and 3 skipped checks. Its Hosted test-contract failure is repaired; its MariaDB job recorded 818 broker unit cases (813 passed, 5 skipped) and 67 passing integration tests before timing out on a later shared runner lock, which still needs runner-maintainer investigation`. The three submitted-review defects are fixed and locally verified, but the formal review still requests changes and its three threads remain unresolved. Maintainer acceptance of the feature direction and core scope is still required. Ready is not merge approval, and skipped or running checks are not passes.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ focused tests and native/ACP runtime controls |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Hosted lifecycle subset; no full FileChanged UI flow |

### Environment (optional)

macOS Node 22.14.0 and pinned pnpm 11.24.0; Linux arm64 Node 22.22.3, Temurin 21.0.12, Maven 3.9.16 and MySQL 8.4.6. Isolated temporary filesystem, actual built CLI and command receiver, dummy test credentials and local provider fixtures. Frozen installation and normal prepare were used; no checks or hooks were bypassed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: notices may be coalesced, duplicated, delayed or missed during reconfiguration and downtime. Initial scans are not replayed. Session IDs identify listeners; handlers must avoid self-trigger loops.
- Not validated / out of scope: complete Linux/Windows FileChanged CLI/UI flows, native Claude runtime behavior, hosted/SSH filesystem event producers, symlink traversal, offline replay, complete memory synchronization and auto-memory toggles.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: additive event. Memory directories require explicit registration. Dynamic roots must be registered after session rotation. The last valid explicit list in synchronous hook order replaces the shared dynamic list.

Design: [English](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same behavior, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Refs #12558. Supersedes closed #12561 without closing the separate memory-toggle requirement.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变化

为本地非托管会话添加通用 `FileChanged` hook。业务可以监听 cwd 中的字面文件名，也可以通过执行成功的同步 `SessionStart` 和 `FileChanged` 输出注册绝对文件及递归目录。通知包含绝对路径和 `add`、`change` 或 `unlink`，写入来源可以是 Qwen Code、Shell、编辑器或其他进程。

Watcher 属于监听会话。轮换会丢弃旧注册及排队任务，关闭会取消通知并释放订阅。ACP bootstrap 加载 hooks 时不监听文件；实际会话拥有订阅。直接注册或移除 skill hook 无需 reload 即可刷新订阅。Managed engine、远程执行环境及 sandbox worker 不创建宿主 watcher。

CI 修复保留原行为检查、隔离临时 fixture，并从只读 transcript 包排除未使用的通知翻译，未改变包大小上限。最新修复使永久删除完成后的断言符合既有 retirement 契约：清空 writer 身份及 lease，journal 为 `DELETED`，同时继续约束 writer generation、恢复行为和资源回收。

## 为什么需要

业务观察 memory files 需要覆盖所有写入者的增改删。按集成方要求，本方案以通用文件系统事件替代 #12561 的 memory 专属提案。业务注册实际 memory 目录，包括多个可访问 workspace 的目录，并按绝对路径分发通知。初始扫描、删除对账、重试及 CLI 离线期间的变化仍由业务处理；#12558 中独立的 memory 开关要求保持开放。

设计参考：[Claude Code FileChanged 官方文档](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#filechanged)及 [SessionStart watchPaths](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks#sessionstart-decision-control)。本方案参考通用文件系统通知及动态监听列表方式，沿用 Qwen Code matcher 行为；Claude 专属环境文件及 cwd 变化行为不在本实现范围。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

- 在 SessionStart 注册 cwd 外的 memory 目录，FileChanged 接收器省略 matcher。新增、修改、删除 topic，包含未来嵌套文件，应收到绝对路径、对应事件及监听会话 ID。
- 在一个列表中注册两个 workspace 的可访问 memory 目录。应收到两个目录的通知，监听会话 ID 相同，业务按绝对路径分发。正则 matcher 仅筛选已注册路径，不自动注册目录。
- 仅注册 cwd 字面文件名，不配置 SessionStart hook。替换或清空动态路径后静态注册仍有效；失败、异步、省略或非法输出不能替换动态根路径。
- 轮换或清理会话，包含旧 SessionEnd 很慢的情况。通知应属于替换会话并持续有效；关闭取消正在运行的通知并丢弃排队任务。
- 仅初始化 ACP、不创建会话时应无文件通知；创建实际 ACP 会话后，首次注册文件变化应携带该 session 和 transcript 路径。直接注册、移除 skill hook 时无需 reload 即可更新订阅。
- 验证 managed、远程及 sandbox 配置不监听宿主文件系统。Hook 错误或阻断决定不能改变已完成的文件写入；处理器输出应写到监听集合之外，避免自触发。
- 在 resident 过期、Spring 重启、settle acknowledgment 丢失及 detach acknowledgment 丢失四个条件下完成永久删除。应撤销 writer 身份、保持规定 generation、释放原始资源、物理回收输出，同时 companion 会话不受影响。

### 证据（变化前后）

TUI 视觉证据不适用。历史实际 Web Shell 验证在 `5611882`／同 tree 的 `8914711` 创建新会话、保存 Project memory，经真实命令接收器观察精确 171 字节，并通过增改删及注册／筛选负控。该结果作为历史证据保留，不表示本次新 head 的 UI 实测。

发布 head：`97ee35404335efd982bb25c2d32d70d17307fdc2`，完整 tree `930f0dc04419eeb0ebfc726b8bbc557eaffec12b`。Build、bundle、完整 typecheck（含集成类型）及 lint 通过；core 1,048 项、CLI 4 项、Web Shell 40 项，共 1,092 项实际通过，过滤的 1,309 项 CLI 测试未执行。同一源码树及 bundle 的六项独立 compiled／实际 bundled ACP 验证通过。macOS 默认 4 GiB 堆耗尽后，使用相同完整构建脚本和 8 GiB V8 堆构建成功。

Linux Java 21／MySQL 8.4.6 对照：`原始 main6212189 与 CI 合并树1b355df 均复现四项 writer 身份断言失败（0错误、0跳过）；修正候选的四个完整集成场景及18项存储测试全部通过，0跳过、Checkstyle 0、Maven退出码0`。[完整验证、失败尝试及证据边界](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#issuecomment-6125790018)。

产品 CI 与 review 分开报告：`新head检查正在排队／运行，不表示通过。推送前07ec8ff为26成功、2失败、3跳过；Hosted测试契约错误已修复；MariaDB任务先记录818项broker单元用例（813通过、5跳过）及67项集成通过，随后等待共享runner锁超时，仍需运行器维护者调查`。三项已提交 review 缺陷已修复且经本地验证，但正式 review 仍为要求修改，三个 thread 尚未解决；功能方向及 core 范围仍需维护者接受。Ready 不代表批准合并，跳过及运行中检查不算通过。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :--: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 针对性测试及 native／ACP runtime 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Hosted生命周期子集；未验证完整FileChanged UI流程 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS Node 22.14.0、固定 pnpm 11.24.0；Linux arm64 Node 22.22.3、Temurin 21.0.12、Maven 3.9.16、MySQL 8.4.6。使用隔离临时文件系统、实际构建 CLI 和命令接收器、虚构测试凭据及本地 provider fixture，采用冻结安装及正常 prepare，未绕过检查或 hooks。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：通知可能合并、重复、延迟，在重新配置或离线期间漏报；初始扫描不回放。Session ID 表示监听者，处理器应避免自触发。
- 未验证或不在范围：完整 Linux／Windows FileChanged CLI／UI 流程、原生 Claude runtime、托管／SSH 文件系统事件生产者、符号链接遍历、离线回放、完整 memory 同步及 auto-memory 开关。
- 兼容性与迁移：新增事件，memory 目录需要显式注册，轮换后需重新注册动态根路径。同步 hook 顺序中最后一个显式有效列表替换共享动态列表。

设计：[English](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.zh-CN.md)。两版行为、限制及验收标准一致。

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): hand back the Workspace mount when a tool turn goes recovery blocked
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a narrow broker-internal mount-release, `POST /tool-sessions/{runtimeSessionId}:release-mount`, which frees only the Workspace execution mount a managed Workspace Session holds — the row in `managed_workspace_execution_lease` keyed by `(tenantId, storageId)` — without touching the Runtime Session: its READY identity, its renewals and the recovery fleet's ability to re-adopt it are all preserved, so the RELEASED-forever verdict a full release would mint never runs. The service answers `runtime_session_busy` whenever the Session still has something unproven — any unsettled execution (background processes included; the drain's exclusion exists only beside its stop-or-settle sweep and this path runs no sweep), an in-flight control, or a settled execution whose publication delivery is still open (`deliveryStatus: pending` or `blocked` — the family the operator-recovery protocol asserts) — and `runtime_reconciliation_required` when the Session is not resident in this Broker (dead-Daemon residue belongs to the LOST family's existing sweep). On the Daemon side, the recovery-blocked transition in `executeHostedTurn` now hands the turn's mount back through this endpoint: the plain lane mirrors `finish()`'s release discipline (Hook lane shared acquisition and MCP lane session-scoped mount keep their own), the handback also runs when the acquire answer was lost after the grant (the store's holder-conditioned clear is a no-op when nothing was granted), and a busy refusal retries on a bounded cadence so the mount is freed once those executions settle — the fleet's freeze stays honest when they never do. Adds `docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md` and its synchronized Chinese version.

## Why it's needed

[#13800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13800): one `recovery_blocked` Session wedged every later tool turn of other Sessions on the same daemon — journal frozen after `hostedModelAttempt`, model never called again, no error, no terminal event. The mechanism (isolated with runtime witnesses and recorded in the issue): a turn that goes recovery-blocked never runs `finish()`, so it never releases its Workspace execution mount; every later turn on the same `(tenantId, storageId)` then spins on `409 workspace_busy` forever (~0.3 s cadence, 207 consecutive observed on the wire). Deleting only that lease row live-unwedged a parked turn in under a second while the blocked Session stayed blocked — the coupling is exactly the leaked lease. A recovery block is a legitimate outcome of the block-and-never-replay contract, so the wedge would keep re-entering through every path that produces one, not just the A1 reproducer. Per the issue's W2, a blocked Session must not stop unrelated Sessions: with this PR the blocked turn's mount goes back at the block transition, and the blocked Session itself keeps reporting its own blocked state accurately.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Behavioral change lives at the broker-internal mount-release endpoint plus the daemon's block transition; the witnesses to focus on:

- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts` — turn-level witnesses: handback calls `releaseMount` exactly once and never `release`; a failed handback logs and still lets the block verdict through, retries exactly twice for a busy refusal, gives up after that without spinning; a busy-then-settling mount is handed back on the retry; an acquire whose reply was lost after the grant still runs the handback; Hook/MCP lanes hand nothing back; a non-busy failure is one logged attempt, never a retry.
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` — route witness: a prompt-driven tool turn that goes recovery-blocked through each of the Tool/MCP/Hook error families releases the mount exactly once, never sees the full release, and still reports `recoveryBlocked`.
- `RuntimeBrokerServiceTest` — service witnesses: resident mount release keeps READY with zero full releases; crossed Harness → `runtime_session_conflict`; non-resident → `runtime_reconciliation_required`; unsettled execution / in-flight control / settled execution with a still-running background process → each `runtime_session_busy`; a transport without Workspace ownership → 501 `workspace_mount_release_unsupported`.
- `HostedWorkspaceConcurrencyIT#mountReleaseFreesHeldStorageAndKeepsTheSessionReady` — real broker + real worker + real DB: rival acquire answers 409 `workspace_busy` while held; the narrow release refuses `runtime_session_busy` behind an unsettled execution and succeeds once it settles; the mount row's holder columns clear; the Runtime Session stays `READY`; the rival acquires immediately; the holder's own later full release completes through the absent-holder path.
- Full-stack rig (the issue's own reproducer, `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`): pre-fix build wedges 3/3 with a 207-streak of `workspace_busy`; the fixed build settles the fresh turn on its first acquire attempt in ~2.6 s with the blocker still reporting blocked (`workspace_busy` count 0); removing only the `await toolTurn?.releaseForRecoveryBlock();` line brings the wedge back with the pre-fix journal fingerprint; restoring it goes green again.

Expected vs observed: before — fresh tool turn on the same storage parks unbounded with no error and no terminal event; after — it completes on the first acquire attempt while the blocked Session's verdict is unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no user-visible/TUI change; wire-level before/after summarized above, full logs in `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️ (CI lanes; local rig ran the same wire shape on macOS arm64) |

### Environment (optional)

Local rig: throwaway MariaDB (temp datadir) → in-process Spring `managed-agent-server` + embedded runtime broker → packaged `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` daemon → real `managed-runtime-worker` processes; fake OpenAI shim is the only stand-in. Also `npm run build && npm run bundle`, `npm run typecheck`, eslint/prettier, checkstyle all green.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a later full release of a mount-free Session takes the transport's existing absent-holder shortcut, so its worker-side detach is deferred to binding teardown (bounded by worker lifetime; the row still settles RELEASED honestly) — documented in code and the design doc. The busy gate reads broker-registered state as of the check and does not fence a concurrent out-of-contract admission landing one instant later (every in-contract caller — the blocked Daemon — cannot be issuing operations at that point); an additive internal endpoint under the unchanged `protocolVersion: 1`.
- Not validated / out of scope: A1 itself ([#13533](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13533), whose start-path fix ([#13789](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13789)) has landed in this branch's base); the Hook lane's shared acquisition and MCP lane's session-scoped mount (their own disciplines); daemon-death residue (LOST family sweep, [#12670](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12670) family); `monitor_run` / `child_run` `shell` kinds stay gated per the issue; the concurrent-admission atomicity hardening noted above is a recorded follow-up, not bundled here.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; new optional endpoint on the broker-internal API. Design documents: [English](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md) and [中文](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.zh-CN.md), synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Closes #13800
Related: #13533 (A1, the reproducer path), #13789 (the A1 fix, landed in this branch's base), #12670, #13184 (same "one unsettled row has consequences elsewhere" family).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增一个窄化的 broker 内部挂载释放端点 `POST /tool-sessions/{runtimeSessionId}:release-mount`，只释放受管 Workspace Session 持有的 Workspace 执行挂载——`managed_workspace_execution_lease` 中按 `(tenantId, storageId)` 主键的那一行——而不触碰 Runtime Session：其 READY 身份、续期与恢复舰队重新收养的能力全部保留，完整释放会铸造的 RELEASED-forever 判定绝不运行。当该 Session 仍有未证实事项——任何未结算执行（背景进程也算；drain 的排除集只因它有先停掉或结算的 sweep 才存在，本路径不跑 sweep）、在飞 control，或已结算但 publication 交付未关闭的执行（`deliveryStatus: pending` 或 `blocked`——正是 operator-recovery 协议所断言的家族）——服务端应答 `runtime_session_busy`；Session 不驻留在本 Broker 时应答 `runtime_reconciliation_required`（死亡 Daemon 的残留归 LOST 族既有清扫）。Daemon 侧，`executeHostedTurn` 的 recovery-blocked 转移现在通过该端点归还轮次的挂载：plain lane 镜像 `finish()` 的释放纪律（Hook lane 共享 acquisition 与 MCP lane 会话级挂载保有自己的纪律），acquire 应答在授予后丢失时归还同样执行（存储按持有者条件的清除在未授予时是 no-op），busy 拒绝按有界节奏重试——等到那些执行结算后即释放；永不结算则舰队冻结语义诚实保留。新增 `docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md` 及其同步的中文版本。

## 为什么需要

[#13800](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13800)：一个 `recovery_blocked` 会话楔死同一 daemon 上其他会话的全部后续工具轮——journal 冻结在 `hostedModelAttempt` 之后，模型再未被调用，无错误、无终态事件。机制（已用运行时见证隔离并记录在 issue 中）：进入 recovery-blocked 的轮次永远不再执行 `finish()`，因此永不归还其 Workspace 执行挂载；同一 `(tenantId, storageId)` 上的每个后续轮次随之在 `409 workspace_busy` 上无限空转（~0.3 s 节奏，线上观测到连续 207 次）。仅删该租约行即在 1 秒内让已停摆的轮次恢复，而被阻塞会话仍保持阻塞——耦合恰好是这条泄漏租约。recovery block 是「阻塞、绝不重放」契约的合法结局，所以只要还有任何产生它的路径，楔死就会一再重现，而不只来自 A1 复现器。按 issue 的 W2：被阻塞会话绝不能阻止无关会话——本 PR 让被阻塞轮次在阻塞转移点归还挂载，被阻塞会话自身仍准确上报其 blocked 状态。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

行为变化位于 broker 内部挂载释放端点 + daemon 阻塞转移；重点见证：

- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-workspace-tool-turn.test.ts`——轮次级见证：归还恰好调用一次 `releaseMount`、绝不调用 `release`；归还失败只记日志且阻塞判定照常送达，busy 拒绝恰好再重试两次后停手；busy 后结算的挂载在重试中归还；acquire 应答在授予后丢失时归还仍执行；Hook/MCP lane 不归还任何东西；非 busy 失败只做一次记录尝试、绝不重试。
- `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`——路由见证：prompt 驱动的工具轮分别经 Tool/MCP/Hook 错误族阻塞时恰好释放挂载一次，绝不触发完整释放，且仍上报 `recoveryBlocked`。
- `RuntimeBrokerServiceTest`——服务见证：驻留挂载释放保持 READY 且完整释放计数为零；跨 Harness → `runtime_session_conflict`；非驻留 → `runtime_reconciliation_required`；未结算执行 / 在飞 control / 主执行已结算但背景进程仍在跑 → 各自 `runtime_session_busy`；非 Workspace 持有的 transport → 501 `workspace_mount_release_unsupported`。
- `HostedWorkspaceConcurrencyIT#mountReleaseFreesHeldStorageAndKeepsTheSessionReady`——真实 broker + 真实 worker + 真实 DB：占用期间竞争 acquire 应答 409 `workspace_busy`；有未结算执行时窄释放拒绝 `runtime_session_busy`、结算后成功；挂载行持有者列清空；Runtime Session 保持 `READY`；竞争方立即获租；持有者随后的完整释放经无持有者路径完成。
- 全栈 rig（issue 自己的复现器，`.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`）：修复前构建 3/3 楔死、`workspace_busy` 连续 207 次；修复构建下全本轮次首次 acquire 即获租、~2.6 秒结算，被阻塞会话照常上报 blocked（`workspace_busy` 为 0）；只删 `await toolTurn?.releaseForRecoveryBlock();` 一行楔死按修复前 journal 指纹回归；恢复后再绿。

预期 vs 实际：修复前——同 storage 的全新工具轮无错误无终态地永久停摆；修复后——首次 acquire 即完成，被阻塞会话判定不变。

### 证据（修复前后）

N/A（无用户可见/TUI 变化；线上前后对比见上文，完整日志在 `.qwen/issues/13800-repro/`。）

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️（CI 车道；本地 rig 在 macOS arm64 上跑同一线路形态） |

### 环境（可选）

本地 rig：临时 MariaDB（临时 datadir）→ 进程内 Spring `managed-agent-server` + 内嵌 runtime broker → 打包的 `dist/cli.js serve --profile hosted-harness` daemon → 真实 `managed-runtime-worker` 进程；唯一替身是假 OpenAI 端点。另有 `npm run build && npm run bundle`、`npm run typecheck`、eslint/prettier、checkstyle 全绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无挂载的会话之后的完整释放会走传输层现有的无持有者捷径，因此其 worker 侧 detach 推迟到 binding 拆除（以 worker 生命周期为界；行仍诚实地落 RELEASED）——已在代码与设计文档中注明。busy 门禁读取的是检查时刻 broker 已登记状态，不为晚一瞬到达的违约并发准入设防（任何守约调用方——被阻塞的 Daemon——此刻都不可能在发号施令）；内部端点为增量，`protocolVersion: 1` 不变。
- 未验证/范围外：A1 本身（[#13533](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/13533)，其启动路径修复 [#13789](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13789) 已合入本分支基线）；Hook lane 的共享 acquisition 与 MCP lane 的会话级挂载（各自纪律）；daemon 死亡残留（LOST 族清扫，[#12670](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/issues/12670) 族）；`monitor_run` / `child_run` `shell` kind 按 issue 保持门禁；上述并发准入原子性硬化为记录在案的后续事项，不并入本 PR。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；broker 内部 API 新增可选端点。设计文档：[English](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.md) 与 [中文](../blob/main/docs/design/workspace-execution-mount-recovery-block-release.zh-CN.md)，已同步。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13800

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): honor system settings env overrides only for administrator-controlled paths
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH` and `QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_DEFAULTS_PATH` were honored regardless of who owned the file they pointed at, so a user-owned file could stand in for the system layer. This adds a trust gate at the single place where both paths resolve: Unix, `lstatSync` (symlinks are not followed) — the override is honored only for a regular file with `uid === 0`; Windows, the normalized path (lowercased, `/` → `\`, `..` segments popped) must stay inside `C:\ProgramData\qwen-code\`; any doubt fails closed to the platform default — absent file, directory, symlink, non-root owner, stat error. A rejected override now also leaves a one-shot warning naming the variable, the configured path, and the reason, so the fallback is no longer silent. The variable still lets an administrator redirect the system layer, but only to a location the administrator controls — the defense-in-depth option from the maintainer call in #13513.

## Why it's needed

I ran into this while designing managed installs: an elevated setup writes the protected system path, the CLI runs unprivileged — and the "system" layer only means something if the user cannot forge it. A user who controls the environment variable could point it at a home-directory file and win the precedence over every managed setting. #13513 has a concrete v0.24.7 reproduction and an independently verified root-cause chain.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The whole behavior of this change is "fail closed on any doubt", so reproduce it on both sides. On macOS/Linux, from the repository root (Node ≥ 22, after `pnpm install`):

```
echo '{"layer":"user-owned-fixture"}' > /tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json
pnpm exec esbuild packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=/tmp/spl.cjs
node -e 'process.env.QWEN_CODE_SYSTEM_SETTINGS_PATH="/tmp/qwen-pr13628-user-owned.json"; console.log(require("/tmp/spl.cjs").getSystemSettingsPath())'
```

On this branch the command prints the one-shot warning and resolves the platform default; on `origin/main` the same command honors the override (no warning). For the `main` side, swap the bundle input with `git show origin/main:packages/cli/src/config/storage-paths-lite.ts > /tmp/spl-main.ts` and bundle that file instead. The root-owned branch (skipped on non-root hosts) executes in a Linux container run as root — command and output under Evidence. prs.title: fix(ui): bottom-align short VP content so blank space is at top
prs.body:
## What this PR does

In VP mode (`useTerminalBuffer`, default on), when the conversation fits within the viewport the content was top-aligned, leaving a blank gap between the last message and the composer (reported in #9300, happens in every session). This bottom-aligns short bottom-stuck content: blank space moves to the TOP and the latest message sits directly above the composer, matching standard chat TUIs.

Implementation: in `VirtualizedList`, when `isStickingToBottom` and content fits (`maxScroll === 0`), compute `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight`, render it as a leading spacer, and keep the root at full `containerHeight` so there is room. Overflow (`maxScroll > 0`) and scrolled-away cases are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

#9300: default-on VP mode showed a large blank area between the last message and the composer in every session (short conversations and collapsed thinking blocks). High-frequency, default-on visual regression on the primary surface — worth a quick fix.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/VirtualizedList.test.tsx` — 32 tests pass, including the 3 updated to the new bottom-aligned layout.
2. `npx vitest run packages/cli/src/ui/components/MainContent.test.tsx packages/cli/src/ui/components/shared/ScrollableList.test.tsx` — 36 pass (no layout regression).
3. Manual (iTerm2, VP mode): start a short session — content should sit at the bottom above the composer with blank at top; collapse a thinking block (Ctrl+O) — released space appears at top, not between content and composer.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: content top-aligned, blank gap between last message and composer. After: content bottom-aligned, blank at top. (Needs a live terminal to visually confirm; unit tests pin the new frame layout.)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️ needs manual confirm (reported on iTerm2) |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅ (unit tests) |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: changes the short-content layout from top-aligned/collapsed to bottom-aligned; three tests that pinned the old collapse behavior were updated to the new expectation. Scrolling/overflow math is untouched (`scrollableContainerHeight` unchanged).
- Not validated / out of scope: live iTerm2 visual confirmation (reporter's environment); height-overestimation cases where `totalHeight >= containerHeight` (those already bottom-show via `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #9300

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

VP 模式（默认开启）下，当会话内容高度小于视口时，内容顶部对齐，导致最后一条消息与输入框之间出现大片空白（#9300，每个 session 都出现）。本 PR 将短的、贴底的内容改为底部对齐：空白移到顶部，最新消息紧贴输入框上方，与主流 chat TUI 一致。

实现：`VirtualizedList` 中当 `isStickingToBottom` 且内容放得下（`maxScroll === 0`）时，计算 `bottomAlignGap = scrollableContainerHeight - totalHeight` 作为顶部占位，并保持 root 为满 `containerHeight`。溢出或已上滚的场景不变。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：短内容布局从顶部对齐/折叠改为底部对齐，3 个固定旧行为的测试已更新；滚动数学未动。
- 未验证：iTerm2 真机视觉确认；`totalHeight >= containerHeight` 的高度高估场景（该场景本就通过 `clampedScrollTop = maxScroll` 底部显示）。
- 破坏性变更：无。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): keep one-shot system reminders out of the user's own message
prs.body:
## What this PR does

One-shot reminders that the interactive terminal UI folds into the front of a prompt are no longer shown back to the user. The transcript line for a prompt, the entry written to the cross-session ↑-recall history, the text refilled into the composer after a cancelled turn, and the same prompt as rebuilt when a session is resumed now all show what the user typed. The request sent to the model still carries the reminder exactly as before, and the machine-readable sidecar mirror of the conversation is deliberately left untouched, because its job is to report what was actually sent.

Removal is leading-only: a reminder tag the user pasted into the middle of their own prompt stays visible, and a tag that is never closed is left in place rather than swallowed. If a prompt were nothing but an envelope, the transcript keeps showing it rather than rendering an empty bubble.

## Why it's needed

Resuming a session that still had paused background agents made the first prompt render as a block of internal instructions — how to list agents, and how to message one by task id — followed by the user's own words. The user never wrote that text and cannot act on it. Cancelling the turn put the same block into the editable input box, so resubmitting sent internal context to the model as literal user text, and resuming that session again replayed it from the recording. This was reported internally during token-consumption governance work.

None of it was needed to keep the user informed. Each of the three notices that can be injected this way already has its own user-facing signal: restored background agents and a restored worktree each add an info line to the transcript, and workflow keyword steering lights an indicator in the footer. The headless and ACP runtimes both attach the notice as a separate part alongside the prompt rather than folding it in, so the interactive terminal path was the only one mixing a model-only payload into the string it also renders, logs and restores. This separates the two roles again at the points where a prompt is read back, instead of restructuring how the notice is delivered — the delivery side is threaded through the submission queue, speculation matching and side-question routing, and rewriting it is a much larger change than the defect warrants.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a session, launch a background agent, leave it paused/recoverable, exit, then `qwen --resume` that session.
2. Type any first prompt. Before: the transcript shows a `<system-reminder>` block reading "1 background agent was restored from this session. Use list_agents to inspect it and send_message with a task_id to continue one.", a blank line, then the prompt. After: only the prompt, with the separate info line "Restored 1 background agent from this session. Open Background tasks to inspect it." still present above it.
3. Confirm the model still receives the reminder — ask it what it was told about restored agents, or inspect the request payload in an API trace. It should be unchanged.
4. Cancel path: on that first prompt press ESC before any output arrives. The composer should refill with the prompt only, not the envelope. Resubmit and confirm the transcript is still clean.
5. ↑-recall: exit, start a new session in the same directory, press ↑. The recalled entry should be the prompt without the envelope.
6. Resume again: `qwen --resume` the session from step 1 and confirm the earlier prompt now renders without the envelope (this is the recording-replay path, fixed separately from the live path).
7. Paste guard: submit `before <system-reminder>x</system-reminder> after` and confirm the transcript shows it verbatim.
8. The worktree and workflow-steering notices reproduce the same way through their own one-shot latches (`--worktree`, or a prompt containing the workflow keyword with the feature enabled); both should now render only the user's words while keeping their info line and footer indicator.

Automated:

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.test.tsx \
  src/ui/utils/resumeHistoryUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/utils/historyUtils.test.ts \
  src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx
# 554 passed
npx tsc --noEmit            # clean
npx eslint <changed files>  # clean
npx prettier --check <changed files>  # clean
```

### Evidence (Before & After)

No terminal recording for this one — evidence is at the unit level, and I'm flagging that explicitly rather than implying a TUI capture was done.

- After: two new cases pin the live path (model request keeps the envelope while the transcript and the recall log carry only the user's words; stacked envelopes strip, mid-message and unterminated ones do not) and two pin the resume path (an envelope-only record restores as the bare prompt; a pasted envelope survives).
- Before: three pre-existing cancel-path expectations pinned the old text — they asserted the envelope inside the value that is both compared for identity and written back into the composer. Those three had to be updated, which is the direct before/after evidence for the cancel-restore path.
- Not run locally to completion: the full `packages/cli` suite. Every test file that mentions the reminder tag was run individually and passes, no snapshot contains it, and CI covers the rest.
- Pre-existing and unrelated: `src/acp-integration/session/Session.worktree.test.ts` fails 8 tests with `this.config.setCurrentSessionScheduledTaskCreator is not a function`. Verified identical on the base commit `0ef35351e9` with this branch's changes absent — the test's mocked config lacks a method the ACP session now calls. Not touched here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, lint and format on the changed files. No manual TUI run and no Windows/Linux run — the change is string handling with no platform-specific branch, but the manual steps above are the ones worth walking on a real terminal.

prs.title: fix(cli): recover Hosted journal-only tool batches after crashes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This change adds a durable journal-only wait before a Hosted tool batch can make its first control-plane write. The wait names the protected calls, survives through the completed model-output boundary, and lets a replacement Harness either continue the interrupted round or cancel it from journal facts without acquiring a Runtime lease.

Recovery now covers background Agent and Workflow launches, Session messages, lead-side team/task operations, yolo approval mode, and Hooks Sessions. The Java coordinator client also recognizes the new recovery phase as continuable and cancellable.

## Why it's needed

A Harness crash after one journal-only call committed but before the next checkpoint left the Turn at a model-start phase that takeover refused. The lead Session then stayed blocked, committed work could not be answered, and child results could not reach the lead. The new wait closes that gap before the first domain write and preserves exactly-once answers from the existing journals.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a zero-Runtime control-plane batch and interrupt the Harness after its first durable domain write. Load the same Session through a replacement Hosted process and continue it. The replacement should report `await_journal`, should not acquire a Runtime lease, should answer committed calls from their durable records, should fill unreached calls as never run, and should resume the model. Repeating the scenario through the cancel route should settle the Turn and leave the Session loadable. For a Hooks+yolo team task, verify that the domain journal contains exactly one committed task record after recovery.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the replacement declined the Turn at `model_start`, and the lead remained blocked by `hosted_turn_recovery_required`.

After: replacement-process continue and cancel both settle the interrupted round; the Hooks+yolo task is committed once; final status is idle and unblocked.

![#13847 local acceptance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/issue-13847-acceptance.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Local macOS acceptance used the real JSONL managed-session journal and HTTP load/continue/cancel routes with a replacement Hosted Session. Final verification passed 101 Core tests, 6 focused CLI fault scenarios, 71 Java Hosted client tests, the CLI build, all-workspace typecheck, changed-file ESLint, and diff checks.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: takeover now admits one additional durable phase and allows Hooks recovery only for that phase; malformed, mixed-wait, mismatched-Turn, and unknown states remain blocked.
- Not validated / out of scope: a physical Kubernetes/MariaDB process-kill run and Windows/Linux execution; the local fault injection exercises the same durable JSONL journal and HTTP recovery control plane.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing checkpoints remain readable because the new group is optional and omitted when absent. A checkpoint written in the new phase requires a reader containing this change.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13847

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本改动在 Hosted 工具批次第一次写入控制面记录之前，新增一个持久化的 journal-only wait。该 wait 记录受保护调用，在模型输出完成边界之后继续保留，并让替代 Harness 在不获取 Runtime lease 的情况下，根据 journal 事实继续或取消被中断的轮次。

恢复范围覆盖后台 Agent 与 Workflow 启动、Session 消息、lead 侧 team/task 操作、yolo 审批模式和 Hooks Session。Java 协调器客户端也会把新的恢复阶段识别为可继续、可取消。

## 为什么需要

此前 Harness 在某个 journal-only 调用已经提交、但下一个 checkpoint 尚未写入时崩溃，Turn 会停在接管不接受的模型起步阶段。lead Session 因此持续阻塞，已提交工作无法得到回答，child 结果也无法回到 lead。新的 wait 在第一次领域写入前封住这个窗口，并继续由现有 journal 提供只执行一次的回答。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

启动一个零 Runtime 的控制面批次，在第一次持久化领域写入之后中断 Harness。通过替代 Hosted 进程加载同一个 Session 并继续。替代进程应报告 `await_journal`，不获取 Runtime lease，按持久化记录回答已提交调用，把未执行调用补为 never run，然后恢复模型轮次。通过 cancel 路径重复该场景时，Turn 应完成结算并让 Session 恢复可加载。对于 Hooks+yolo 的 team task，恢复后领域 journal 应只有一条已提交的 task 记录。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：替代进程在 `model_start` 拒绝 Turn，lead 持续被 `hosted_turn_recovery_required` 阻塞。

After：替代进程的 continue 与 cancel 都能结算中断轮次；Hooks+yolo task 只提交一次；最终状态为空闲且无阻塞。

![#13847 本地验收](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yiliang114/img-host/main/assets/issue-13847-acceptance.png)

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

本地 macOS 验收使用真实 JSONL managed-session journal 与 HTTP load/continue/cancel 路径，并启动替代 Hosted Session。最终验证通过 101 项 Core 测试、6 个聚焦 CLI 故障场景、71 项 Java Hosted client 测试、CLI build、全工作区 typecheck、改动文件 ESLint 和 diff 检查。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：接管新增接受一个持久阶段，并且 Hooks 只为该阶段开放恢复；畸形状态、混合 wait、Turn 不匹配和未知状态仍保持阻塞。
- 未验证 / 不在范围：物理 Kubernetes/MariaDB 进程 kill，以及 Windows/Linux 执行；本地故障注入覆盖同一套持久 JSONL journal 和 HTTP 恢复控制面。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：现有 checkpoint 仍可读取，因为新 group 为可选，缺失时不会编码。新阶段写出的 checkpoint 需要包含本改动的 reader。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/codex/fix-13847-journal-recovery/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-agent-journal-wait-recovery.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13847

prs.title: fix(managed-runtime): landed PR 12691 review follow-ups across providers, activator, core tools and runtime broker
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Follows up on the two post-merge review rounds of #12691 (25 threaded findings plus 9 posted in the round-2 review body — 2 of them explicitly deferred-only lists excluded). All 10 Criticals are fixed; all Suggestions are either fixed with tests, verified as already-fixed on main, or answered with an evidence-based not-changing rationale inline on the original threads. Every finding was re-verified against current main before acting, since the reviewed tree (928004d0) predates the managed-agent landing.

Criticals fixed here: the v2 client marker leaking past a failed cold start and converting a session into a permanently closed one (R1-1); the Windows path-separator traversal guard in the file-history parser (R2-1); activator `close()` skipping registry drain when one worker's cleanup rejects (R2-2); `observe()` leaking the ownership entry of a provably dead worker (R2-3); a transport-failed warmup wedging a local release record forever (R2-4); a broker `released:false` silently leaving `releasing=true` (R2-5); `prepareRetryWindowMs: 0` arming a 0 ms abort deadline (R2-6); the worker env allowlist missing Windows case-insensitive variable names (R2-7); an unguarded final `structuredClone` wedging an invocation on a non-cloneable hook payload (R2-8); and a failed worker cleanup permanently leaking the capacity slot (R2-9).

Suggestions fixed with tests: broker honoring `retryable:false` (R1-2), evicted-after-failure execution reservations (R1-3), throw-after-dispose release parity (R1-5), end-to-end secret-leak observation (R1-6), handshake rejection coverage (R1-8), dead v1 scaffolding deleted (R1-9), post-abort cleanup failure surfaced (R1-10), provider-level cancel coverage (R1-11), dead retry parameter removed (R1-12), snapshot cap tied to `MAX_SNAPSHOTS` (R1-13), switch-to-default normalized locally (R1-16), observe() version guard (R1-19, R1-20 docs, R1-21 HTTP tests), tombstone set digests (R1-18), docs pointers for the provisional activator surface and the sendPrompt reserved contract (R1-25, R1-22), session-store parser tests (R1-23), media-binding coverage (R1-24), and the missing HTTPS-outside-loopback guard on the session-store URL (chiga0 P2).

Verified as already-fixed on main: broker control-path result validation (R1-4 — `parseManagedRuntimeProviderResult` now validates every operation's result) and `parseManagedToolConfirmationPayload` production call sites (R1-14); its residual budget asymmetry stays on the round-2 deferred ledger.

Answered with not-changing rationale on the thread: the eviction TOCTOU count proposal (chiga0 P3 — counting retiring generations is deliberate backpressure, pinned by an existing green test; the permanent leak from _failed_ cleanup is fixed); deleting the reserve→start client surface (R1-15 — deleting costs the strongest durable-identity wire oracle while the managed-agent wiring is still landing).

The items recorded as "Deferred under the convergence posture" in the round-2 review body remain deferred and are not part of this PR.

## Why it's needed

The review's Criticals are mostly fails-closed defects on newly landed guarded surfaces (managed runtime providers, worker activator, runtime broker): transient faults were converted into permanent state — sessions permanently closed after one cold-start failure, capacity slots leaked, ownership/tombstone records retained with bearer-token material, and one CI-lane-flipping test assertion on Windows. Since the surfaces are still unwired in production, fixing the state-machine and boundary defects now is strictly cheaper than after the hosted-runtime wiring lands.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

All fixes are unit/integration pinned; each regression test fails on the pre-fix tree.

```bash
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run \
  src/serve/local-process-runtime-activator.test.ts \
  src/serve/managed-runtime-provider.test.ts \
  src/serve/broker-managed-runtime-provider.test.ts
cd packages/core && npx vitest run \
  src/tools/managed-tool-runtime.test.ts \
  src/tools/managed-tool-file-history-protocol.test.ts
cd packages/acp-bridge && npx vitest run src/bridgeTypes.test.ts
export JAVA_HOME=~/Install/jdk21
cd packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker && mvn test
```

Results on this branch: TypeScript 226/226 green across the four suites (cli 93, core 107, acp-bridge 26, incl. ~30 new pinning tests); Java runtime-broker 606/606 green with 0 failures; `npm run build` + `npm run typecheck` green; ESLint/Prettier clean on all touched files.

Notable witnesses: R1-1 asserts `/v1/prepare` 500 → no second attempt is cached — the first `getToolV2Client` rethrows, `release()` then goes through `/internal/managed-runtime/v1/release`, and the second `getToolV2Client` issues a fresh prepare; R2-1 adds `'..\\outside'` so the traversal guard is pinned on POSIX lanes too; R1-6 seeds real secret env vars and asserts the spawned worker observes none of them.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non–user-visible change: N/A. Behavioral witnesses are the regression tests above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ (R2-1/R2-7 fixes target Windows; suite relies on the win32 lane) |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ (not run locally; Java module runs on hosted CI) |

### Environment (optional)

Local run of vitest 3.2.7 workspaces + Maven 3.8.4 on Zulu JDK 21.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `stop()` now frees the activator capacity slot even when cleanup fails, so a new generation may spawn while a zombie worker's `outputRoot` remains on disk — accepted per the review's Critical, and cleanup failures still surface through `close()`'s aggregated rejection.
- Not validated / out of scope: the round-2 "deferred under the convergence posture" items remain deferred intentionally; R1-15's reserve→start client surface is kept with rationale pending the managed-agent wiring; R2-2's close() still caches its rejection after draining (retry semantics unchanged).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: ~110 lines of production-dead v1 protocol exports were deleted (zero production importers, verified repo-wide at PR head); `RemoteManagedRuntimeProvider.prepare` lost its never-supplied second parameter (interface declared one argument).

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #12691.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 内容

这是对 #12691 合并后两轮评审（楼内 25 条 + 第 2 轮正文 9 条，正文明确标注「延后」的清单除外）的跟进修复。10 条 Critical 全部修复；其余 Suggestion 要么带测试修复、要么在 main 上核实已被后续提交修好、要么在原线程上以基于证据的「不改」理由答复。所有发现都在处理前按当前 main 重新核实（评审基线 928004d0 早于 managed-agent 落地）。

修复的 Critical：v2 标记在冷启动失败后被钉死导致会话永久关闭（R1-1）；Windows 路径分隔符使穿越校验失效且致 CI 车道翻转（R2-1）；activator `close()` 在单个 worker 清理失败时跳过 registry 排空（R2-2）；`observe()` 泄漏已死 worker 的所有权条目（R2-3）；传输失败的 warmup 永久卡死本地 release 记录（R2-4）；broker `released:false` 静默残留 `releasing=true`（R2-5）；`prepareRetryWindowMs: 0` 通过校验却武装 0ms 中止时限（R2-6）；worker 环境白名单正则区分大小写导致 Windows 不带 PATH（R2-7）；结尾 `structuredClone` 无守卫使不可克隆 hook 结果卡死调用（R2-8）；worker 清理失败永久泄漏容量槽（R2-9）。

带测试修复的 Suggestion：broker 尊重 `retryable:false`、失败预约淘汰、dispose 后 release 抛错对齐、端到端秘钥泄露观测、握手拒绝路径覆盖、删除 v1 死脚手架、post-abort 清理失败可见、provider 级 cancel 覆盖、移除死参数、快照上限与 `MAX_SNAPSHOTS` 绑定、switch-to-default 本地归一、observe() 版本守卫、javadoc 进度不可用说明、broker HTTP 成功路径与 400/413 测试、墓碑集合改存 SHA-256 摘要、临时面与 sendPrompt 保留契约的文档指针、session-store 解析器逐分支测试、媒体绑定覆盖、session-store URL 补 HTTPS 强制（chiga0 P2）。

在 main 上已修复（核实后无需本 PR 处理）：broker 控制面结果校验（R1-4）与 `parseManagedToolConfirmationPayload` 的生产调用点（R1-14；其预算不对称留在第 2 轮延后清单）。

以证据答复不改：chiga0 P3（retiring 计入容量是有意的背压设计，且现有绿灯测试钉住该行为；「清理失败导致永久泄漏」已被本轮修复）；R1-15（此时删除 reserve→start 客户面会损失最强的持久身份 wire oracle，且 managed-agent 接线仍在落地中）。

第 2 轮正文中明确「收敛姿态下延后」的条目继续延后，不在本 PR 范围内。

## 动机

这些 Critical 多为新落地受守卫面上的 fails-closed 缺陷：瞬时故障被放大为永久状态（一次冷启动失败后会话永久关闭、容量槽泄漏、含 bearer token 的所有权/墓碑记录滞留），另有一处 Windows 上测试断言翻转。由于这些面尚未接入生产，现在修复状态机与边界缺陷成本远低于接线之后。

## 验证方式

全部修复以单测/集成测试钉住，每个回归用例在修复前的树上会变红。本分支上 TypeScript 四个套件 226/226 绿（新增约 30 个钉住用例），Java runtime-broker 606/606 绿 0 失败；`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、ESLint、Prettier 全部通过。环境：本机 macOS + Zulu JDK 21 + Maven。

## 风险与范围

- 主要取舍：`stop()` 现在在清理失败时也释放容量槽，可能让新一代 worker 在残留 `outputRoot` 的情况下启动——按评审 Critical 接受，`close()` 仍聚合抛出清理失败。
- 不在范围：第 2 轮延后清单维持延后；R1-15 的 reserve→start 客户面保留（理由见该线程）；R2-2 的 close() 在排空后仍缓存其拒绝（重试语义未变）。
- 破坏性变更：删除约 110 行零生产引用的 v1 协议导出（PR head 上全仓核实）；`RemoteManagedRuntimeProvider.prepare` 移除从未被传入的第二参数。

</details>

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): restart-proof the held-Runtime drain obligation (#13930)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Restores the close's held-Runtime drain obligation across a Harness restart or takeover. A turn-held Runtime (a live background Shell or Monitor) is tracked only in a process-local set on the Harness; after a restart the reloaded Session held an empty set, so its close answered 204 while the run kept its Runtime. This change adds a read-only Broker inventory of a Harness Session's live hold rows — a new `POST /tool-sessions:active-holds` route backed by a paged repository query over the durable execution ledger, with the in-memory and JDBC implementations pinned by one shared contract — and the Harness seeds its held set from that answer at Session load: restore-only, never discharged at load, and a failed query logs and loads without the obligation rather than failing the load. The close's drain arm is unchanged; the Broker's answer already arrives in the idempotent Runtime Session id form the drain maps over. A composite index on the execution ledger's harness column keeps the per-load read bounded on a long-lived Broker, and the schema upgrade lands in all three DDL paths (fresh schema, the embedded upgrader, and a new Flyway migration), pinned by a contract assertion.

## Why it's needed

Issue #13930's R1-2: the merged H3 enablement (#13856) deliberately left this hole and it was called out at merge time. Without this change, a restarted Harness's close reports success over a background run that is still alive; the Runtime and its workspace mount stay pinned — silently, nothing records the strand — until the workspace-level drain cascade runs, possibly much later.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The acceptance case in `hosted-harness-session.test.ts` ("restores the held-Runtime drain obligation on a replacement load") prewrites a shell-profile Session whose process died before any close, lets the Broker still list the held Runtime Session, loads the Session on a fresh process, and asserts the close's release goes out with `{ drain: true }` for exactly that Runtime Session id. With the restore gate disabled the case is red (mutation-checked during development). Beside it: a restore-failure degrade case (the query rejects → the load still answers 200, the close drains nothing) and a create-time no-query gate case. On the Broker side, the shared repository contract covers the new query against both store implementations (including limit-1 paging to exhaustion), the service answers a 101-hold page-crossing case, and the HTTP route carries its own 200/400 case. The expected result is that CI and `npm run build && npm run typecheck`, plus `mvn test -Dgpg.skip=true` in `packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker` and the Flyway schema contract in `managed-agent-server`, are all green.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI change; the behavior lives on the managed-agent close path).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A |

### Environment (optional)

N/A (unit + integration tests: vitest for the CLI side, maven for the broker side, including the H2-backed JDBC contract and the Flyway migration chain).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a workspace-profile Session load now pays one read-only Broker round trip; an unreachable Broker fails fast and the load proceeds without the obligation (the pre-change behavior), while a hung one can delay a load up to the client's 30s request timeout.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 28 Suggestions deferred from the #13856 review wave (the hygiene batch #13930 also tracks) — including a shared-helper extraction for the JDBC windowing loop; the control-plane Session close's own `drainHarnessSession` backstop; the known whole-file-load flakiness in `hosted-harness-session.test.ts`, which predates this change (the failing test name rotates across runs and the same signature reproduces on clean HEAD) and deserves its own hygiene issue.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the Flyway migration V69 adds one index (online DDL); no API or record-contract change.

Design document (both language versions, kept in sync): `docs/design/2026-10-12-restart-proof-held-runtime-drain.md` (English) and `docs/design/2026-10-12-restart-proof-held-runtime-drain.zh-CN.md` (中文).

## Linked Issues

Refs #13930 — this PR completes the R1-2 slice; the issue also tracks the deferred review-hygiene batch, which this PR does not close.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做什么

让 close 的被持有 Runtime drain 义务跨 Harness 重启/接管存活。被 turn 持有的 Runtime（仍在运行的后台 Shell 或 Monitor）此前只记录在 Harness 进程内的集合里；重启后重新加载的 Session 拿到的是空集合，于是它的 close 对着仍存活的 run 回答 204。本 PR 在 Broker 侧新增一个只读清单——`POST /tool-sessions:active-holds` 路由，由持久执行台账上的翻页仓储查询支撑，InMemory 与 JDBC 两个实现由同一份共享契约钉住——Harness 在 Session 加载时用它的答案回填持有集合：只恢复、绝不在加载时清偿，查询失败记日志后不带义务加载，而不是让加载失败。close 的 drain 臂不变；Broker 的答案本身已是 drain 映射幂等的 Runtime Session id 形态。执行台账的 harness 列新增复合索引，让每次加载的只读读法在长寿 Broker 上保持有界；schema 升级落在全部三条 DDL 路径（新装 schema、内嵌升级器、新 Flyway 迁移），并由一条契约断言钉住。

## 为什么需要

issue #13930 的 R1-2：已合入的 H3 启用（#13856）当时刻意留下这个洞并在合并时明示。没有本 PR，重启后的 Harness 的 close 会对着仍存活的后台 run 报告成功；Runtime 与它的 workspace mount 被继续钉住——且是静默的，没有任何地方记录这次滞留——直到很晚的 workspace 级 drain 级联才兜住。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

`hosted-harness-session.test.ts` 中的验收用例（"restores the held-Runtime drain obligation on a replacement load"）预写一个进程在 close 前死亡的 shell-profile Session，让 Broker 仍列出被持有的 Runtime Session，在全新进程上加载该 Session，并断言 close 的 `release` 恰好以 `{ drain: true }` 打到那个 Runtime Session id。把恢复门关掉该用例变红（开发期做过变异检查）。旁边还有：restore 失败降级用例（查询拒绝 → 加载仍 200 → close 不 drain 任何东西）与 create 不查询门用例。Broker 侧：共享仓储契约对两个存储实现覆盖新查询（含 limit=1 翻页到穷尽），service 层有 101-hold 跨页用例，HTTP 路由自带 200/400 用例。预期：CI、`npm run build && npm run typecheck`、`packages/sdk-java/runtime-broker` 的 `mvn test -Dgpg.skip=true`、managed-agent-server 的 Flyway schema 契约全部绿。

### 前后对照证据

N/A（非 UI 改动；行为在 managed-agent 的 close 路径上）。

### 已测平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测 |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A |
|  🐧 Linux  | N/A |

### 环境（可选）

N/A（单元 + 集成测试：CLI 侧 vitest，broker 侧 maven，含 H2 承载的 JDBC 契约与 Flyway 迁移链）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：workspace-profile Session 的加载多一次只读 Broker 往返；Broker 不可达时快速失败、加载不带义务继续（即改动前行为），Broker 挂起时最多把加载拖到客户端的 30s 请求超时。
- 未验证/不在范围内：#13856 评审波次推迟的 28 条 Suggestion（#13930 同时跟踪的卫生批）——包括 JDBC 翻页循环的共享助手抽取；control-plane Session close 自己的 `drainHarnessSession` 兜底；`hosted-harness-session.test.ts` 既有的整文件负载 flaky（先于本改动存在：失败用例名逐轮轮换，同一签名在 clean HEAD 可复现），值得在卫生批单独立项。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：Flyway 迁移 V68 只加一个索引（online DDL）；无 API 或记录契约变更。

设计文档（双语版本，保持同步）：`docs/design/2026-10-12-restart-proof-held-runtime-drain.md`（English）与 `docs/design/2026-10-12-restart-proof-held-runtime-drain.zh-CN.md`（中文）。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #13930 —— 本 PR 完成其中的 R1-2 切片；该 issue 同时跟踪推迟的评审卫生批，本 PR 不关闭它。

prs.title: feat(core): skip re-injecting an unchanged UserPromptSubmit hook context block
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A `UserPromptSubmit` hook that returns `additionalContext` has that text appended to the user's message, wrapped in a reserved tag, on every turn. When the payload the hook returns is byte-identical to one already appended earlier in the same session, the change detects the earlier copy in the shallow conversation history and does not append it again; the turn also stops recording the hook context as coming from this turn, so the stored transcript matches what the model actually received. A payload that differs in any byte — different results, a different order, a changed similarity score — still appends, so there is no state that can expire or go stale. Identical bytes alone are not treated as proof: suppression also requires the shape an injection produces — a user entry whose trailing part is that block — so tagged text that merely appears elsewhere in the transcript, in a model turn or as a whole user message, does not suppress a fresh delivery.

## Why it's needed

The appended block becomes a permanent part of session history, so a hook whose payload repeats is paid for again on every subsequent request: the resent tokens grow on the order of T² over a session. The bundled retrieval extensions make this easy to hit, because their auto-recall hooks render a bounded, newest-first window — with a stable upstream result set the rendered bytes are identical turn after turn. The earlier copy is still in the conversation, so the information is not lost; what is removed is the duplicate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Point a `UserPromptSubmit` hook at a command that prints a constant `additionalContext` (for example a one-line Node script that writes the same hook JSON every time), then send three prompts in the same session, continuing that session between sends. Read the session transcript for the run and, for each recorded user message, note whether the reserved tagged block and the recorded hook-context provenance are present. Expected: the first user message carries both; later user messages carry neither. Then ask the model to repeat the extra context block it was given — it should still return it verbatim, which shows the deduplication removed a repeat rather than the content.

Count only user records, and only as a presence check. Unrelated records in the same file (telemetry, the auto-memory extractor) can quote the payload back, so a raw substring count over the whole file is not a usable metric.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on the released CLI (v0.25.0), a constant-payload hook over three turns in one session: all three user records carried both the tagged block and the hook-context provenance.

After, running from source, a constant-payload hook over four turns in one session: the first user record carried the block and the provenance; the second, third, and fourth carried neither. On the fourth turn the model was asked to output the extra context block from its history and returned it verbatim, confirming the earlier copy is still there.

Unit tests: the core hooks suite passes (21 tests), the `UserPromptSubmit` cases in the core client suite pass (5 of 504, the rest filtered out), the full core client suite passes (504 tests), and the ACP session suite passes (1240 tests, including a regression test for the IDE injection site). The predicate's own suite covers the provenance cases as non-matches: the same block in a model entry, as a sole user part, and ahead of the trailing part each fails to match, so the guard injects as before. Deleting only the new condition makes the new regression test fail at each site, which is how the tests were confirmed to exercise the guard rather than pass incidentally.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

The before run used the globally installed `qwen` (v0.25.0); the after run used `node scripts/dev.js` from this branch, which executes the TypeScript sources directly with `DEV=true`, in a scratch directory containing only the test hook and its settings.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a hook that deliberately repeats a fixed block on every turn — a standing or pinned instruction — now appears only on the first turn of a session, and the hook output schema has no field to opt out of that. Any change to the payload re-injects it on the next turn, and suppressing a repeat never removes the text from the conversation.
- Not validated / out of scope: the headline scenario from the linked issue — an external memory recall hook whose items restate content that core already injected from local memory files — is **not** fixed by this change. Core holds no identifier that matches an external recall item against a local memory block, so that comparison cannot be expressed at delivery time; this PR only removes the byte-identical repeat. The cross-source case stays open in the issue, as does putting a size bound on hook context.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No configuration, protocol field, or package API is added, and hooks whose payload varies per turn behave exactly as before.
- Design documents: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #14089. This does not close it: the issue's headline case, where recalled external memory duplicates content core already injected from local memory files, needs an identity that core owns on both sides and is left open.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

返回 `additionalContext` 的 `UserPromptSubmit` hook，其文本会在每一轮被追加到用户消息后面，并用保留标签包裹。当 hook 返回的载荷与同一会话中此前已追加过的某一份逐字节相同时，本次改动会在浅拷贝的会话历史中识别出此前那一份，不再重复追加；同时本轮也不再记录该 hook 上下文来源于本轮，使落盘的会话记录与模型实际收到的内容一致。只要载荷有任何字节不同——结果不同、顺序不同、相似度分数变化——仍会照常追加，因此不存在会过期或失效的状态。仅字节相同并不被当作证据：抑制还要求满足注入所产生的形状——某个用户条目的最后一部分就是该块——因此仅仅在记录其他位置出现过的带标签文本（出现在模型回合中，或作为整条用户消息）不会抑制一次新的投递。

## 为什么需要

被追加的块会成为会话历史的永久组成部分，因此载荷重复的 hook 会在之后每一次请求中再付一次代价：重发的 token 量随会话轮数呈平方级增长。本仓库自带的检索扩展很容易触发这一点，因为它们的自动召回 hook 渲染的是一个有界、最新优先的窗口——只要上游结果集稳定，渲染出的字节就逐轮完全相同。此前那一份仍留在对话里，信息并没有丢失，去掉的是重复。

## 评审验证方案

### 如何验证

让 `UserPromptSubmit` hook 指向一个每次都打印相同 `additionalContext` 的命令（例如一行 Node 脚本，每轮输出同一份 hook JSON），然后在同一会话中发送三次提示，每次之间延续该会话。打开该次运行的会话记录，逐条用户消息查看保留标签包裹的块与本轮记录的 hook 上下文来源信息是否存在。预期：第一条用户消息两者都有，之后的用户消息两者都没有。随后让模型复述它拿到的额外上下文块，它应当仍能原样给出，这说明去重去掉的是重复而非内容。

只统计用户记录，且只做有无判断。同一份文件里不相关的记录（遥测、自动记忆抽取器）会把载荷原样引用回来，因此对整个文件做子串计数不能作为指标。

### 证据（修复前后）

修复前，在已发布的 CLI（v0.25.0）上，载荷恒定的 hook 在同一会话中跑三轮：三条用户记录都同时带有标签块和 hook 上下文来源信息。

修复后，从源码运行同一场景，四轮同一会话：第一条用户记录带有标签块和来源信息，第二、三、四条都没有。第四轮要求模型输出它历史中的额外上下文块，它原样返回，证明此前那一份仍在。

单元测试：core hooks 套件 21 项通过，core client 套件中 `UserPromptSubmit` 相关用例 5 项通过（共 504 项，其余被过滤），core client 全套 504 项通过，ACP session 套件 1240 项通过（其中包含针对 IDE 注入点的回归测试）。该谓词自身的套件把来源相关情形作为不匹配覆盖：同一个块出现在模型条目中、作为用户唯一的 part、以及位于最后一个 part 之前，都不会匹配，因此守护逻辑照旧注入。仅删除新增的那个条件会使两个注入点的回归测试各自失败，以此确认这些测试确实在验证这个守护逻辑，而不是碰巧通过。

### 测试环境

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 运行环境（可选）

修复前为全局安装的 `qwen`（v0.25.0）；修复后为在本分支上运行 `node scripts/dev.js`，它以 `DEV=true` 直接执行 TypeScript 源码，工作目录是一个只包含测试 hook 及其配置的临时目录。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：有意每轮重复某个固定块的 hook——例如常驻或钉住的指令——现在只会在会话第一轮出现，而 hook 输出 schema 没有可供退出该行为的字段。载荷一旦变化，下一轮就会重新注入；抑制重复也从不把文本从对话中移除。
- 未验证／超出范围：关联 issue 的核心场景——外部记忆召回项与 core 已从本地记忆文件注入的内容重复——**并未**被本次改动修复。core 不持有能把外部召回项与本地记忆块对应起来的标识，因此在投递时刻无法表达这种比较；本 PR 只消除了逐字节重复。跨来源去重仍留在该 issue 中，给 hook 上下文加长度上限同样如此。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。没有新增配置、协议字段或包 API，载荷逐轮变化的 hook 行为与之前完全一致。
- 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/14089-hook-context-dedup/docs/design/user-prompt-submit-context-dedup.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 issue

关联 #14089，但不关闭它：该 issue 的核心场景（召回的外部记忆与 core 已从本地记忆文件注入的内容重复）需要 core 在两侧都持有的标识，因此保持开启。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): let a workspace only turn auto-update off
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `general.enableAutoUpdate` to `WORKSPACE_TIGHTEN_ONLY_SETTINGS` (`packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.ts`) with `strictness: (value) => (value === false ? 1 : 0)` — a workspace may only turn the updater off, never back on. A workspace `true` is dropped when an operator scope set `false`, and a workspace `false` is honored over the schema's `true` default. Updates the exhaustive pin in `settingsUtils.test.ts` and adds ranking plus merge-level coverage.

The same series also guards the write path: `POST /workspace/settings` refuses a workspace-scope write of a tighten-only key that the merge would strip — it loosens an operator scope, System scope sets the key, or it would overwrite a strictly stricter value the workspace file already carries — with 400 `workspace_tighten_only_setting`, instead of persisting a dead committable entry and answering 200 (`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.ts`, with route-level coverage).

## Why it's needed

Follow-up to the R2-3 discussion in #13665 (link below). That review established that `general.enableAutoUpdate` is read from `settings.merged` by every consumer of the flag (`ui/handleAutoUpdate.ts:46`, `/update`'s branches) and that a trusted repository's `.qwen/settings.json` merges after `user` (`config/settings.ts`). A repository shipping `{"general":{"enableAutoUpdate":true}}` therefore re-authorizes the unattended binary replacement the user opted out of with `false`. #13665 narrows one consumer; this merge-layer entry closes the exposure for all of them at once — the systemic fix the review asked for. Excluding workspace scope per read site would leave the startup path on merged scope. The write guard closes the same trap at the API surface: without it a write the merge strips is persisted and answered 200.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- `packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts`: the exhaustive pin now lists `general.enableAutoUpdate`; a new ranking test asserts `strictness(false) > strictness(true)`, `strictness(undefined) === strictness(true)` (the schema default is on), and that an unrecognized value ranks with on.
- `packages/cli/src/config/settings.test.ts`, new `auto-update scope handling` describe:
  - user `false` + trusted workspace `true` → `merged.general.enableAutoUpdate === false`, with the existing "would loosen the User value" warning, while other workspace `general` keys (`vimMode`) still merge;
  - workspace `false` alone → honored over the default on, no warning.
- `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts`, `tighten-only key writes at workspace scope`: the loosening write and the System-scope-sets write are refused (400 + reason, nothing persisted); the tightening write, the write repeating the effective value and the write repeating the file value pass; a write that would destroy the file's own stricter value is refused; a write bound to the home directory (workspace scope inactive) is accepted.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Mutation — removing the list entry (the only production change) reddens exactly the new coverage, all previously green here:

- `settingsUtils.test.ts`: the exhaustive pin and the ranking test — 2 failed;
- `settings.test.ts`: `drops a workspace opt-in that would reopen the user opt-out` — 1 failed.

The `honors a workspace that turns auto-update off over the default on` case also passes without the entry (with no operator scope the plain merge already yields `false`), so it documents the tightening direction rather than witnessing the entry; it is not claimed as mutation evidence.

Route-level mutation — neutralizing the two round-3 refinements (the file-value comparison and the workspace-active short-circuit) reddens exactly the two new cases: `rejects a workspace write that would destroy the file's own stricter value` and `accepts a workspace write when the bound workspace is the home directory` — 60 passed, 2 failed. Restored, `workspace-settings.test.ts` is 62 passed.

Full suites in `packages/cli`: `settingsUtils.test.ts` 67 passed; `settings.test.ts` 243 passed, 8 skipped (pre-existing skips); `workspace-settings.test.ts` 62 passed.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ✅   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Unit tests run locally on Windows; macOS/Linux left to CI.

### Environment (optional)

In `packages/cli/`: `npx vitest run src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts src/config/settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts` — the files live at `packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/config/settings.test.ts`, `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts`.

## Risk & Scope

- Semantics come from the schema default: `enableAutoUpdate` defaults to `true`, so unset ranks with `true` and only a literal `false` is the stricter direction. System scope still wins outright through the existing tighten-only machinery; the existing warning text is reused unchanged.
- The write guard changes API behavior: a workspace-scope write of a tighten-only key that the merge would strip now answers 400 `workspace_tighten_only_setting` instead of 200. User scope is untouched; a write that tightens or repeats a value still goes through.
- Deliberately not included: the end-to-end `non_interactive` pin requested in the R2-3 review (user `false` + workspace `true`, asserting `performStandaloneUpdate` is not called). It runs through `/update`'s gate, which lives in #13665 and is not on `main` yet; the case is written and mutation-verified on a branch stacked on #13665's and I will push it to this PR once #13665 lands, so the guarantee is witnessed end to end.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #13665's review discussion (R2-3): https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13665#discussion_r4221615163 — Refs #13665, #13634

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 `general.enableAutoUpdate` 加入 `WORKSPACE_TIGHTEN_ONLY_SETTINGS`（`packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.ts`），`strictness: (value) => (value === false ? 1 : 0)`——仓库只能把自动更新关掉、不能重新打开：当操作者作用域设了 `false` 时丢弃 workspace 的 `true`；workspace 的 `false` 则相对 schema 默认值 `true` 属于收紧，被保留。同步更新 `settingsUtils.test.ts` 的穷举锁定，并新增排名测试与合并级测试。

同一组提交还守护了写入路径：`POST /workspace/settings` 对「合并层会丢弃」的 tighten-only 键 workspace 写入返回 400 `workspace_tighten_only_setting`——即写入会放松操作者作用域、System 作用域已设置该键、或会覆盖 workspace 文件当前更严格的值——而不是持久化一个永不生效的条目并回 200（`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.ts`，含路由级测试）。

## 为什么需要

本 PR 是 #13665 R2-3 评审讨论的后续（链接见上）。该评审确认：`general.enableAutoUpdate` 被该标志的所有消费方从 `settings.merged` 读取（`ui/handleAutoUpdate.ts:46`、`/update` 的各分支），而受信任仓库的 `.qwen/settings.json` 在 `user` 之后合并（`config/settings.ts`）。因此一个携带 `{"general":{"enableAutoUpdate":true}}` 的仓库会重新授权用户以 `false` 明确退出的无人值守替换。#13665 只收窄了其中一个消费方；本条目在合并层一次性闭合所有消费方——正是评审所要求的系统性修复。若改为在读取点排除 workspace 作用域，启动路径仍会读到 merged 作用域。写入守护在 API 层闭合同一陷阱：没有它，被合并层丢弃的写入会被持久化并回 200。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- `packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts`：穷举锁定新增 `general.enableAutoUpdate`；新排名测试断言 `strictness(false) > strictness(true)`、`strictness(undefined) === strictness(true)`（schema 默认为开），且未识别的值按「开」计。
- `packages/cli/src/config/settings.test.ts` 新增 `auto-update scope handling` describe：
  - user `false` + 受信任的 workspace `true` → `merged.general.enableAutoUpdate === false`，并产生既有的 "would loosen the User value" 警告，同时其他 workspace `general` 键（`vimMode`）仍正常合并；
  - 仅 workspace `false` → 相对默认为开被保留，无警告。
- `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts` 的 `tighten-only key writes at workspace scope`：放松写入与 System 已设置的写入被拒（400 + 原因，未持久化）；收紧写入、重复当前生效值的写入、重复文件当前值的写入通过；会销毁文件自身更严格值的写入被拒；绑定 home 目录（workspace 作用域不活跃）的写入被接受。

### 证据（改动前后）

变异验证——移除列表条目（本 PR 合并层唯一的生产代码改动）后，恰好只有新增覆盖变红（此前全绿）：

- `settingsUtils.test.ts`：穷举锁定与排名测试——2 红；
- `settings.test.ts`：`drops a workspace opt-in that would reopen the user opt-out`——1 红。

`honors a workspace that turns auto-update off over the default on` 用例在无条目时也通过（无操作者作用域时普通合并本就得到 `false`），因此它记录的是收紧方向而非见证条目，不主张其为变异证据。

路由级变异——使第 3 轮两项修正失效（文件当前值比较与 workspace 不活跃短路）后，恰好只有两个新用例变红：`rejects a workspace write that would destroy the file's own stricter value` 与 `accepts a workspace write when the bound workspace is the home directory`——60 通过、2 失败；恢复后 `workspace-settings.test.ts` 62 通过。

`packages/cli` 相关套件：`settingsUtils.test.ts` 67 通过；`settings.test.ts` 243 通过、8 跳过（存量跳过）；`workspace-settings.test.ts` 62 通过。

### 测试过的平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ✅  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

单元测试在本地 Windows 上运行；macOS/Linux 交由 CI。

### 环境（可选）

在 `packages/cli/` 下执行 `npx vitest run src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts src/config/settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts`——文件位于 `packages/cli/src/config/settingsUtils.test.ts`、`packages/cli/src/config/settings.test.ts`、`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.test.ts`。

## 风险与范围

- 语义以 schema 默认值为准：`enableAutoUpdate` 默认为 `true`，因此未设置按「开」计，只有字面量 `false` 属于收紧方向。System 作用域仍通过既有机制直接覆盖；警告文案沿用现有管线，未新增文案。
- 写入守护改变了 API 行为：合并层会丢弃的 tighten-only 键 workspace 写入现在返回 400 `workspace_tighten_only_setting` 而非 200。user 作用域不受影响；收紧或重复值的写入照常通过。
- 刻意未包含：R2-3 评审要求的端到端 `non_interactive` 锁定（user `false` + workspace `true`，断言 `performStandaloneUpdate` 不被调用）。它经过 `/update` 的守护分支，该分支位于 #13665、尚未进入 `main`；该用例已在基于 #13665 的堆叠分支上写好并完成变异验证，#13665 合并后我会把它推入本 PR，使该保证获得端到端见证。

#13665 R2-3 评审讨论的后续：https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13665#discussion_r4221615163 —— Refs #13665、#13634
