prs.title: feat(managed-agent): consolidate persistence into a 32-table baseline
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Consolidates Managed Agent persistence from 63 business tables into a shared 32-table MySQL 8.4 baseline for a new database. Server and Runtime Broker consume one versioned DDL source; active stores and workers use the new tables, and the retired migration sequence is archived outside runtime classpaths. Session/head/event-stream, request receipts, typed operations/work, deliveries, runtime generations, physical storage ownership and read leases retain separate authority and failure semantics.

Preserves immutable journal commits, fixed snapshot pagination, resource references, tools/output publication, Workspace/CSI recovery, child Agents, channels and automation. Schedule definitions project in the journal transaction; expired projection bodies can be collected safely; original immutable PUTs can reconcile lost SQL receipts without another write. The integration preserves current-main lifecycle v2, Workflow children, ordered member commands and private/public event transport with independent wake/message watermarks.

## Why it's needed

The existing schema spreads shared request, worker and resource lifecycles across many tables and maintains independently drifting Server/Broker schema definitions. A fresh-database baseline reduces this duplication while keeping recovery, idempotency, retention and physical exclusion explicit. It also addresses the confirmed review defects in output settlement, active-Session resource collection, delivery scan costs and full-length actor identities.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Initialize an empty MySQL 8.4/InnoDB database through either component and confirm exactly 32 business tables plus Flyway history. An existing legacy, foreign or partial catalog, a system catalog or a missing selected catalog must be rejected before mutation. Confirm create/commit/read/replay/delete closure and that journal bytes, resource references, projections and head advancement commit together; stale writers and claim generations must be refused.

Exercise immutable multi-page snapshots while messages change, a paused snapshot build/read lease concurrent with GC, and projection rebuild after retained events are exhausted. Verify that active references, recovery protection, unresolved PUTs and valid cursors prevent collection. Lose the SQL receipt after an object PUT, then recover by querying the original object: exactly one physical write; missing or mismatched contents remain unresolved. Expand terminal history from 1,000 to 10,000 rows and confirm bounded indexed delivery and resource scans without increasing the existing small-message query budget.

Read/build a snapshot with a one-connection pool, then force its committed lease to expire and retire the Session during construction: reads must stop and no snapshot may publish. Reconcile an expired channel claim through the real Harness and verify the original claim identity reaches the private journal, a stale generation is refused and no provider message repeats.

Deliver duplicate and reordered event notices, race wake claims and advance message projection: one wake claimant wins, journal wake progress remains independent of public message progress and retention, and Control/retired Sessions cannot supply public consumer state. Ownership checks must use indexed digest identities and recheck the original bytes.

Run the real-stack failover scenarios against the fresh baseline: all seeds and audits must use canonical tables, and Linux physical registration must finish before Harness admission. The original execution identities and writer takeover invariants must survive restart. Verify default Workspace/ACL and physical storage alias exclusion, execution-specific CSI/recovery evidence, lifecycle v2 cleanup, Workflow/child close debt, ordered member commands, channel generations and schedule revision/scanner races. The bilingual design and implementation plan contain the complete old-to-new ownership mapping and cutover/rollback constraints. A separate comment records executed suites and their environment limits.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — persistence implementation and API-contract refactor; no UI layout change. The schema changes from 63 to 32 business tables. Independent MySQL fault reproduction verified six orphan snapshot bodies become zero on an ACTIVE Session, 512-emoji actors create/replay successfully, lost PUT receipts recover with one physical PUT, and tenfold completed history no longer increases the confirmed relay scans.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested: current-head Java/Node and local MySQL 8.4 acceptance |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ current head not redeployed; earlier baseline passed isolated native worker and real reboot acceptance |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Java 21, Node.js 26 for build/native channel tests and Node.js 22.22.3 for complete Harness verification, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, native MySQL 8.4.11/InnoDB and isolated disposable databases. Output fault tests use controlled immutable file/in-memory adapters and actual child JVMs. The earlier Linux acceptance used Ubuntu 24.04, Java 21, Node.js 22 and native MySQL 8.4; it is historical evidence for the pre-integration artifact.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a broad persistence replacement touches concurrency, recovery, idempotency and collection. Independent writer/stream/scanner/physical ownership fences remain distinct, with real-MySQL fault, isolation and load gates.
- Not validated / out of scope: the corrected MariaDB generated-column and CHECK-catalog paths await CI (native startup was blocked on macOS). Full Hosted native-workspace/process gates require Linux; current local channel gates are verified separately. Production traffic cutover, migration of old data, real cloud OSS/CSI provider acceptance and redeploying the current head on Linux. DataAgent `da_qwen_session_*` tables are excluded.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: this is a fresh-database baseline, not an in-place upgrade. Preserve the old database and its historical endpoint; new Sessions belong to the new environment. Current LOCAL tool/child Git execution requires Linux verified workspace recovery and offline native storage registration; macOS text Turns work, while macOS LOCAL tools fail closed. The platform scope decision remains pending; this follow-up documents the implemented behavior and does not disable physical fencing. Rollback must retain the new database. HTTP/SDK business identities and existing fields remain stable. Public pagination changes to signed opaque cursors for fixed snapshots, with 30-minute expiry, 409 cursor_expired and SSE resynchronization even after all retained events are removed; public contract version 1.45.0 records these changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.zh-CN.md). Implementation and acceptance: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/plans/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/plans/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.zh-CN.md). Both versions preserve the same decisions, constraints and acceptance boundaries.

## Linked Issues

N/A — implementation of the reviewed Managed Agent schema consolidation plan.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

将 Managed Agent 的 63 张业务表整合为新数据库使用的 32 张 MySQL 8.4 业务表。Server 与 Runtime Broker 共用一个版本化 DDL 来源；现役存储与 worker 全部接入新表，旧迁移序列归档到运行时 classpath 之外。Session/head/event-stream、请求回执、有类型的 operation/work、delivery、Runtime 代次、物理存储占用和读取租约继续保留独立权威与失效语义。

保留不可变日志提交、固定快照分页、资源引用、工具/输出发布、Workspace/CSI 恢复、子 Agent、渠道及自动化能力。Schedule 定义与私有日志同事务投影；过期投影正文可以安全回收；原不可变 PUT 在 SQL 回执丢失后可以对账，避免第二次写入。同步主线时保留生命周期 v2、Workflow 子会话、按提交顺序投递的成员命令，以及私有/公开事件传输和独立的 wake/消息水位。

## Why it's needed

现有 schema 将共享的请求、worker 与资源生命周期分散到大量表中，并分别维护可能漂移的 Server/Broker 结构。新库 baseline 减少这些重复，同时明确保留恢复、幂等、保留边界和物理排他规则。本次也修复审查确认的输出结算、活跃 Session 资源回收、投递扫描成本和完整 actor 身份容量问题。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

使用任一组件初始化空的 MySQL 8.4/InnoDB 数据库，确认恰好 32 张业务表加 Flyway history。已有旧库、外来结构、部分结构、系统库及未选定应用库必须在修改前拒绝。验证创建/提交/读取/重放/删除闭环，日志正文、资源引用、领域投影与 head 原子提交；旧 writer 和领取代次必须被拒绝。

在消息持续变化时验证固定快照多页读取，暂停快照构建/读取租约并与 GC 并发，以及事件已清空后的投影重建。有效引用、恢复保护、未决 PUT 和有效游标均须阻止回收。对象 PUT 完成后丢失 SQL 回执，通过读取原对象恢复：物理写入恰好一次；对象缺失或不匹配时继续未决。将终态历史从 1,000 扩至 10,000 条，确认投递与资源扫描仍由索引约束，且不提高原小消息查询预算。

使用单连接池读取/构建快照，再强制已提交租约过期并在构建中退役 Session：读取必须停止，快照不得发布。通过真实 Harness 对账过期渠道 claim，确认原 claim 身份传入私有日志、旧代次被拒绝，且不重复发送 provider 消息。

投递重复和乱序事件通知，并发领取 wake 并推进消息投影：wake 只有一个领取者，私有日志唤醒水位保持独立于公开消息投影及保留边界，Control/已退役 Session 不得提供公开消费者状态。所有权检查须通过摘要身份索引定位，并核对原始字节。

在新 baseline 上运行真实栈故障转移场景：全部播种与验收使用 canonical 表，Linux 原生注册须在 Harness 准入前完成，重启后保留原执行身份与 writer 接管不变量。验证默认 Workspace/ACL、物理存储别名排他、逐 execution 的 CSI/恢复证明、生命周期 v2 清理、Workflow/子会话关闭欠账、成员命令顺序、渠道换代及 schedule 定义/扫描竞争。中英文设计与实施方案包含完整旧职责映射和切换/回滚约束。独立评论记录实际执行的测试及环境限制。

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — 数据库存储与 API 契约重构，没有 UI 布局改动。业务表从 63 张变为 32 张。独立 MySQL 故障复现验证：ACTIVE Session 的六个快照孤儿正文回收为零；512 emoji actor 可以创建/重放；PUT 回执丢失后恢复且只物理写入一次；十倍终态历史不再增加已确认投递查询的扫描量。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已验证当前 head 的 Java/Node 及本地 MySQL 8.4 验收 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 当前 head 未重新部署；早期 baseline 通过独立原生 worker 与真实重启验收 |

### Environment (optional)

macOS、Java 21、Node.js 26 用于构建/原生渠道测试、Node.js 22.22.3 用于完整 Harness 验证、锁定 pnpm 11.24.0、原生 MySQL 8.4.11/InnoDB 及独立临时数据库。输出故障测试使用受控不可变文件/内存适配器及真实子 JVM。早期 Linux 验收采用 Ubuntu 24.04、Java 21、Node.js 22 和原生 MySQL 8.4；属于同步主线前制品的历史证据。

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: 大范围存储替换涉及并发、恢复、幂等与回收。writer/stream/scanner/物理占用 fence 保持独立，并以真实 MySQL 故障、隔离与负载测试验收。
- Not validated / out of scope: 修改后的 MariaDB 生成列及 CHECK 目录入口待 CI 验证（macOS 原生启动受阻）。完整 Hosted 原生工作区/进程门禁需要 Linux；本地渠道门禁单独验证。正式流量切换、旧数据迁移、真实云 OSS/CSI 服务验收，以及当前 head 在 Linux 的重新部署。DataAgent 的 `da_qwen_session_*` 表不在范围内。
- Breaking changes / migration notes: 本次是新库 baseline，不提供原库升级。保留旧库和历史端点，新 Session 归属于新环境。当前 LOCAL 工具/子 Git 工作区执行要求 Linux verified workspace recovery 及离线原生存储注册；macOS 纯文本 Turn 可用，macOS LOCAL 工具会安全拒绝。平台范围仍待决定，本轮仅明确当前实现行为，不关闭物理 fence。回滚必须保留新库。HTTP/SDK 业务身份及已有字段保持稳定。公开分页改为固定快照的签名 opaque cursor，明确 30 分钟有效期、409 cursor_expired，以及保留事件已全部删除后的 SSE 重同步；公共契约版本 1.45.0 记录这些变化。

设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.zh-CN.md)。实施与验收：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/plans/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-schema-32/docs/plans/2026-10-13-managed-schema-consolidation.zh-CN.md)。两个版本的决策、约束与验收边界保持一致。

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): H4f public task cancel for workflow tasks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Extends the public task cancel surface to the `workflow` task kind — the remaining `child_run` kind of #13746's F1, deferred from the H4f slice (#13823) and named as the follow-up of the workflow runtime (#13803, landed in #13858). A workflow task whose run has not ended (pending, running, waiting or degraded) in an active Session now advertises `cancel` and accepts a cancel on both surfaces; it rides the same durable task_cancel operation, the same record-first delivery and the same relay stop arm as a child agent's, and the workflow child is stopped through its own Turn's abort and settles `cancelled` by `stop_requested`. The contract moves to 1.45.0 to say so.

The production change is one gate member. Every stop mechanic on the path already existed and is kind-blind — the close cascade has been stopping workflow children through the same record verbs since #13858 — the Session authority already admits the stop-request revision on a workflow row, and the waiter text already names the kind, so there is no TypeScript production change and no migration. The contract test also surfaced, and now pins, one previously-unnamed behavior: the one open operation per Session rule spans task kinds — while a child agent's cancel is open, a workflow task's cancel answers 409 session_operation_active.

## Why it's needed

Since the workflow runtime landed, a workflow launch is a real task a caller can list and watch — and cannot stop; the only way to end one today is to close the whole parent Session. Cancel is the piece of the task surface users notice, and for this kind the stop path shipped with the runtime, so the gate was closed by slice boundary, not by a missing runtime.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Store tier: a workflow task admits a cancel in the same states as a child agent (pending/running/waiting/degraded), refuses in terminal and recovery_blocked states with 409 task_action_unavailable, replays under its retained key, and conflicts on a different payload under the same key. The red→green was demonstrated: with the gate member reverted, the new workflow arm fails at admission with 409 task_action_unavailable; with it, the class is green.

Delivery tier: a workflow target completes from its committed record, coalesces an already-recorded stop without a send, and a run that ended without a stop fails task_already_settled without a send.

Real-record tier: a workflow chain committed through the Session store carries the advertised action at each step, the draining runtime on the stop request, the five journaled state_changed events and the output cursor.

Contract tier: a workflow task's cancel answers 202 on both surfaces, replays under its key including cross-surface, its view advertises exactly ["cancel"], and the cross-kind one-open pin answers 409 session_operation_active with the error code asserted.

Commands: `cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server && mvn test -Dtest='ManagedTaskCancelOperationTest,TaskCancelCoordinatorTest,ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest,ManagedAgentApiContractTest'` (75 green). TypeScript pins unchanged: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.test.ts` (44 green) and `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-child-operations.test.ts src/managed-runtime/managed-child-run-record.test.ts` (227 green).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (non-UI). Before: a workflow task's cancel admission answered 409 task_action_unavailable (demonstrated red). After: 202 with a durable task_cancel operation, replay-stable across both surfaces.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux: the Stage F real-stack fault round owed for this kind (lost cancel reply, cancel during settlement, cancel after the owner is gone) is planned and owed; the rig is the maintainer's own, as for #13823/#13858, whose K4 acceptance already exercised the physical stop of a workflow child through the same record verbs on that rig.

### Environment (optional)

Unit/contract tiers: H2 + Flyway via Maven. The full managed-agent-server suite (2360 tests) ran with two failures, both pre-existing and unrelated to this diff — a Flyway schema-index expectation on qwen_tool_execution, and the known non-UTF8 child-worktree case on this machine's /bin/sh.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: minimal — one gate-set member over a stop path that is already shipped and kind-blind; every cancel outcome is read from the task's committed record, never from the wire.
- Not validated / out of scope: the Stage F real-stack round for this kind (planned, owed); the WebShell task panel stays child_agent-scoped (its own follow-up); background_shell/monitor cancel needs per-kind stop semantics first; automation_run waits on H6; channel-delivery cancel belongs with H5's public mutation routes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no migration — the operation table's task_id is kind-agnostic.

Design doc: docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-workflow-task-cancel.md (English) · docs/design/2026-10-13-managed-workflow-task-cancel.zh-CN.md (中文)

## Linked Issues

Refs #13746 — F1's remaining kind; F3 (channel-delivery cancel) stays with H5's public mutation routes and is not served here.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把公开任务取消面扩展到 `workflow` 任务类型 —— #13746 F1 剩余的 `child_run` 类型，由 H4f 切片（#13823）推迟，并被点名为 workflow 运行时（#13803，由 #13858 落地）的后续。一个运行未结束（pending、running、waiting 或 degraded）的 workflow 任务在活跃 Session 中现在会公布 `cancel` 并在两个面上接受取消；它走与 child agent 取消完全相同的持久 task_cancel operation、record-first 投递与 relay 停止臂，workflow child 经由其自身 Turn 的 abort 被物理停止，并以 `stop_requested` 结算为 `cancelled`。契约升至 1.45.0 以载明此事。

生产改动只是一个门禁集合成员。路径上的每个停止机构都已存在且与 kind 无关 —— 自 #13858 起 close cascade 就经由同一套记录动词停止 workflow child —— Session authority 已经准纳 workflow 行上的停止请求修订，waiter 文案也已按 kind 命名，因此没有 TypeScript 生产改动，也没有迁移。契约测试还浮现并钉住了一个此前未命名的行为：每 Session 单 open operation 规则跨任务 kind 生效 —— 当一个 child agent 的取消处于 open 状态时，对一个 workflow 任务的取消答复 409 session_operation_active。

## 为什么需要

自 workflow 运行时落地起，一次 workflow 发起就是一个真实的任务：调用者能列出它、能观察它 —— 却不能停止它；今天要停掉一个只能关闭整个父 Session。取消是任务面上用户会注意到的那部分，而这个 kind 的停止路径随运行时就已经交付，所以闸门只是因切片边界而关闭，并非缺少运行时。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

存储层：一个 workflow 任务在与 child agent 相同的状态（pending/running/waiting/degraded）下准纳取消，在终态与 recovery_blocked 状态下以 409 task_action_unavailable 拒绝，按其保留 key 回放，且同 key 不同载荷冲突。红绿已演示：回退门禁成员后，新 workflow 臂在准入处以 409 task_action_unavailable 失败；带上它则该类全绿。

投递层：一个 workflow 目标从其已提交记录完成；已记录的停止请求被合并且不再发送；无停止请求而结束的运行以 task_already_settled 失败且不发送。

真实记录层：一条经 Session store 提交的 workflow 链在每一步携带公布动作、停止请求上的 draining 运行时状态、五条落日志的 state_changed 事件与输出游标。

契约层：一个 workflow 任务的取消在两个面上应答 202，按其 key 回放（含跨面），其视图恰好公布 ["cancel"]，跨 kind 的单 open operation 钉住应答 409 session_operation_active 并断言错误码。

命令：`cd packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server && mvn test -Dtest='ManagedTaskCancelOperationTest,TaskCancelCoordinatorTest,ManagedExtensionRecordStoreTest,ManagedAgentApiContractTest'`（75 绿）。TypeScript 钉住不变：`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-child-agent-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workflow-turn.test.ts`（44 绿）与 `cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-child-operations.test.ts src/managed-runtime/managed-child-run-record.test.ts`（227 绿）。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（非 UI）。之前：workflow 任务的取消准入答复 409 task_action_unavailable（已演示红）。之后：202 携带一个持久 task_cancel operation，在两个面上回放稳定。

### 已测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux：该 kind 欠下的 Stage F 真实栈故障轮次（取消应答丢失、结算过程中取消、所有者消失后取消）已计划、仍欠账；rig 为维护者自有，与 #13823/#13858 相同 —— #13858 的 K4 验收已在该 rig 上经由相同记录动词演练过 workflow child 的物理停止。

### 环境（可选）

单元/契约层：H2 + Flyway，经 Maven。managed-agent-server 全量套件（2360 个测试）跑出两个失败，均为与本 diff 无关的存量问题 —— 一个 qwen_tool_execution 上的 Flyway 模式索引期望，以及本机 /bin/sh 上已知的非 UTF8 child-worktree 用例。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：极小 —— 在一条已交付且与 kind 无关的停止路径上放宽一个门禁集合成员；取消的一切结果都从任务的已提交记录读取，绝不从线上应答读取。
- 未验证/不在范围：该 kind 的 Stage F 真实栈轮次（已计划、仍欠账）；WebShell 任务面板保持 child_agent 范围（其自身的后续）；background_shell/monitor 的取消需要先有各自的停止语义；automation_run 等待 H6；channel-delivery 取消归属 H5 的公开变更路由。

prs.title: test(managed-agent): Pin the history response size boundary
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds paired HTTP regression coverage for the history-response boundary: a complete response envelope of exactly 8 MiB is accepted unchanged, while an envelope one byte larger is rejected with the existing response-too-large error. Both cases use a valid synthetic history state whose result alone remains below 8 MiB.

## Why it's needed

The S1 follow-up in #13103 identified a remaining coverage gap: removing history from the large-response branch survived the existing protocol and worker suites. This test independently fixes the expected boundary at 8 MiB and checks the observable HTTP status, serialized size, and complete accepted content.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Confirm that a valid history response whose complete envelope is 8,388,608 bytes returns HTTP 200 with every history entry and the session envelope preserved.
- Increase the complete envelope by one byte and confirm HTTP 413 with `managed_runtime_provider_too_large`, even though the history result itself remains below 8 MiB.
- Remove history from the large-response branch and confirm both new cases fail while the pre-existing cases remain green; restore production behavior and confirm the complete focused set passes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a test-only change with no user-facing behavior change. The 131 focused worker and protocol tests passed. Under the targeted mutation, all 129 pre-existing tests still passed and both new boundary cases failed; restoring production behavior returned all 131 tests to green. Full build and typecheck subsequently passed.

Final sequential verification used Node.js 22.20.0 on macOS arm64, the pinned pnpm 11.24.0, CI timeouts, and a four-worker cap, with no concurrent preflights. The full preflight exited 1 on both this head and clean main `6212189f1f8334da78a69e3fb6b63ff6ca88251e`; it is not claimed green. Install, formatting, lint, full build, and typecheck passed on both. The separately completed startup-bundle check also passed on both.

| Completed check | This head | Clean main |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Workspace tests | 102,449 passed; 8 failed; 286 skipped | 102,446 passed; 9 failed; 286 skipped |
| Script tests | 2,969 passed; 2 failed; 75 skipped | 2,970 passed; 1 failed; 75 skipped |
| Test-worker update RPC timeouts | 5 | 7 |

Six workspace failures reproduced on main with the same failing assertions: worktree removal's missing renamed directory; selecting the nonfirst skill; committing through a copied Windows-style Git executable; the missing lock hint on a wedged Git index; and two DingTalk attachment path checks. In the latter two, the test fixture uses the runtime executable under the allowed temporary directory and hits the size guard instead of the expected outside-directory guard. The script auto-rerun scenario also exceeded its explicit 20-second timeout on both full runs.

The heartbeat connection reset, localized-badge timeout, and budget-kill handoff failure did not recur in main's full run. Each then passed twice on both main and this head in alternating focused controls. The auto-rerun control passed twice on main and on the second head attempt, but exceeded its timeout on the first head attempt; this timing sensitivity remains disclosed. Main's full run additionally failed two authorization-dialog assertions and a generation-stream timeout, not observed in this head's full run. No production code or unrelated tests were changed to conceal these results.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Node.js 22.20.0, arm64; pinned pnpm 11.24.0 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Package-local test-script coverage against the local worker HTTP route. Only the history state producer supplies the boundary-sized fixture; serialization, protocol validation, and response enforcement use the production path.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only change; production behavior is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: S2 precision, production follow-ups, the original mutants covered elsewhere, deployed Broker behavior, and Windows/Linux execution. This is a regression and mutation report, not an E2E claim.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.
- AI-assisted contribution.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13103 (S1 only). Follows #13118 and does not close the broader issue.

在包目录中通过测试脚本覆盖本地 worker HTTP 路由。仅由 history 状态生成方提供边界大小的数据；序列化、协议校验和响应限制均使用生产路径。

prs.title: fix(acp): drain late MCP reminders
prs.body:
## What this PR does

ACP now drains queued MCP tool and server-instruction reminders before sending a fresh user prompt, so tools discovered after session start are announced to the model.

## Why it's needed

MCP discovery runs in the background and can finish after an ACP session starts. ACP sends prompts through its own session loop, so the queued reminders were never drained and the model could not learn about the newly available tools.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start an ACP session with an MCP server whose discovery completes after session startup, then send a fresh prompt. Confirm the request includes the reminder naming the newly available MCP tools and any server instructions. Send another prompt and confirm the announcements are delivered only once.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — this is a protocol and prompt-content change with no UI layout.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ Not tested |
| Windows | ✅ Tested |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested |

Focused core MCP reminder tests passed (2 tests), the ACP fresh-user-turn regression test passed (1 test), and `npm run build` plus `npm run typecheck` passed on Windows. The global released `qwen` executable was unavailable, so the manual ACP dry-run was not performed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Reminder delivery depends on the existing one-shot deduplication state, which is shared by ACP and the core turn path.

- Breaking changes / migration notes: None.

prs.title: fix(managed-agent): bound retry loops with terminal states
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Across the managed-agent stack, asynchronous retry loops had no terminal state, and in one case a permanently wedged projection. This change gives every loop a budget and a terminal state: the message projection heals past a provably permanent sequence gap instead of throwing on every scan — settling as failed any items whose turn's terminal event was in the skipped range — and the scanner itself backs off per session (exponential to a 60s cap, surfaced loudly once) so a deterministic failure can no longer flood the log at 10Hz; admitted turns converge to a bounded terminal failure once their retry budget is spent; lifecycle operations whose settle can never succeed terminate `failed` with the settle's failure code kept (the Session keeps its pending status — nothing certifies a completion that never happened) — except while a live journal writer means the close can still succeed, which keeps waiting; a blocked workspace close keeps its failure code through every attempt and through the terminal record; a failed action response whose Action is still waiting is re-admitted by the caller's retry under the same idempotency key instead of returning a stale failure receipt forever; a memory-blocked embedded scheduler arms its own recheck wake so a missed capacity notification can no longer starve queued work; transient store IO failures are retried within the lease window (renewals) or retried bounded before abandoning (releases), a consecutive-failure streak halts the worker loudly when a "transient" outage is really persistent, and a per-activation budget records a terminal outcome instead of re-running forever; session close seals the writer in a finally; and a failed HTTP seal throws loudly out of that finally while the grant lapses with the lease, so a takeover can proceed. There is deliberately no seal retry (issue #13182 item 6b): keeping the grant renewed was found in review to let a stale client seal the journal out from under a freshly re-attached session, so the bounded-retry cut was withdrawn and 6b is answered by the loud throw plus the grant lapse.

## Why it's needed

Audit of the retry loops (issue #13182) found: a single event-sequence gap wedged a session's projection forever while the scanner logged the same stack at 10Hz; an admitted turn failing transiently was rescheduled without bound; a close/delete whose settle can never succeed retried forever; a missed capacity notification starved queued activations silently; one transient renewal error bricked the embedded scheduler; and a failed close could leave a writer unsealed, blocking both clean resume and takeover. The fail-closed posture of the session authority is correct — the layers around it treated transient IO failures as indistinguishable from consistency damage. Review of the first cut found the remaining gaps this wave closes: the exhaustion arm used the success-path completion write (erasing the blocked failure code and certifying an unsettled close), the gap heal left orphaned items streaming forever, the materializer's other permanent failure modes still spun at 10Hz, the scheduler's transient retry had no escalation bound, the first cut's renewal-keeping seal retry let a stale client seal the journal under a re-attached session (withdrawn in favor of the loud throw), and a budget-terminated action answer could never be re-delivered.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The affected paths are not reachable from the CLI binary (the Java control plane needs a deployed broker; the embedded scheduler is hardened ahead of its first production wiring), so the evidence is the new regression suites, each verified to fail on the pre-fix code and pass after:

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`: `mvn test` — 2096 tests; the full suite is green except two pre-existing `ToolPublicationStoreTest` timing errors that reproduce identically on base, and one `ChildWorktreeGitTest` non-UTF8-name case that fails only on macOS's sh (identical on main). Key suites: `MessageProjectionGapHealTest` (real H2 + real transaction boundary: a gapped projection heals, the gap is logged once naming only the truly missing sequences, a lost `turn.completed` settles its orphaned items as failed, and a second-connection `FOR UPDATE` witness pins that the scan holds the session row lock the permanence premise rests on), `MessageMaterializerTest` (backoff + surface-once + reset on success), `AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary 9 retries / 10 terminates, configured budgets honored, both the daemon-503 and broker arms), `OperationRetryTerminalStateTest` (budget boundary, configured budgets, the committed-decision arm, the live-writer gate, the blocked-code-preserving terminal, the bound-session workspace-close routing, the terminal-record-failure fallback), `ManagedActionStoreTest` (stage invariants + re-admission of a FAILED response while the Action is still requested), `SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest` (a blocked close stays blocked below the budget).
- `packages/core`: `npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` — 3281 tests (one known under-load-only flake that passes in isolation). Coverage includes journal tail repair fault injection (torn write repaired, unrepairable write halts, first-write ENOENT is transient, vanished journal is fatal), the scheduler's claim/renewal/release retry policies, the transient-streak halt, per-activation budget convergence, dispose-race wake guards, the memory-blocked poll's decelerating cadence (one store scan per tick, doubling from 1s to a 30s cap, with a cancelled-queue tick clearing the block), and the seal failure path's loud throw with the grant left to lapse.
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` and `npm run typecheck` pass; `packages/web-shell` OpenAPI contract sync test passes (the generated client was regenerated after the contract description update).

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — no user-visible UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit/integration-level verification only (H2 in-memory for the Java broker, fault-injection fs mocks for the TS store); the hosted paths are covered by the suites above rather than a live broker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a turn/operation/action that keeps failing transiently now reaches a terminal failure instead of retrying forever — that is the intended change; budgets are configurable (`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`, `dispatch.max-operation-retries`, both default 10) and validated at startup. A lifecycle operation that hits the budget now reads `failed` with a failure code instead of `completed` — the more honest answer, and the one the contract text now describes.
- Not validated / out of scope: the embedded scheduler has no production caller yet (hardened ahead of wiring, disclosed in test comments); the MySQL-backed `*IT` integration tests run in CI's Hosted process fault gates lane (locally they need Docker/MySQL); the materializer backoff is in-memory (a persisted terminal consumer-progress state is a possible follow-up if operators need it to survive restarts).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the startup validation now rejects `max-pre-admission-retries` greater than `max-post-admission-retries` — a combination that was accepted before (and silently stripped late-admitted turns of retries). Deployments with that combination in external config must align the two keys before upgrading; the error message names both values. Otherwise: two new optional config keys with safe defaults; one new turn failure code; new lifecycle/action failure codes (free-form string fields, no enum change).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13182

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

managed-agent 栈中的异步重试环路此前没有终态，其中一处会让投影永久卡死。本次改为给每个环路预算与终态：消息投影在遇到可证永久的事件序号缺口时自愈越过——并把终结事件落在缺口区间的 turn 的在途 item 置为 failed——不再每次扫描都抛错，扫描器自身也按 session 退避（指数退避封顶 60 秒，超预算后响亮上报一次），确定性失败不再以 10Hz 刷日志；已受理的 turn 在重试预算耗尽后收敛到有界终态；settle 永远无法成功的生命周期操作以 `failed` 终结并保留 settle 的失败码（Session 保持待定状态——不再为从未发生的完成出具凭证）——除非 journal writer 仍存活，此时 close 仍可能成功，operation 继续等待；被阻塞的 workspace close 在每次尝试与终态记录中都保留其失败码；Action 仍在等待应答的失败 action response 可被调用方按同一幂等键重试重新受理，而不是永远返回陈旧的失败回执；内存不足的嵌入式调度器会自行武装复检唤醒，错过容量通知不再让排队激活永久饥饿；瞬时存储 IO 失败在租约窗口内重试（续约）或有界重试后再放弃（释放），连续失败计数会在"瞬时"故障实为持续故障时响亮地 halt worker，按激活的预算则记录终态而不是无限重跑；会话关闭在 finally 中保证封存 writer；HTTP 封存失败会从该 finally 中响亮抛出，并让授权随租约失效，使接管得以进行。此处刻意不做封存重试（issue #13182 第 6b 项）：评审发现保持续约会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后从其手中封存 journal，因此有界重试方案被撤回，6b 由响亮抛错加授权失效来回答。

## 为什么需要

对重试环路的审计（issue #13182）发现：一个事件序号缺口会让该会话的投影永久停摆，扫描器以 10Hz 重复打印同一堆栈；瞬时失败的已受理 turn 被无上限重排；永远无法 settle 的 close/delete 无限重试；一次遗漏的容量通知会让排队激活静默饥饿；一次瞬时续约错误就让嵌入式调度器报废到进程重启；失败的 close 可能留下未封存的 writer，既不能干净恢复也不能被接管。会话 authority 的 fail-closed 姿态本身是对的——问题是外围各层把瞬时传输/IO 失败与一致性损坏混为一谈。对第一版实现的评审发现了本轮修复的剩余缺口：预算耗尽分支此前复用成功路径的完成写入（抹掉被阻塞的失败码，并为从未 settle 的关闭出具凭证）；gap 自愈让失去 turn 终结事件的 item 永远停在"流式"状态；materializer 的其他永久失败模式仍以 10Hz 空转；调度器的瞬态重试没有升级上限；第一版保持续约的封存重试会让陈旧客户端在新会话重新挂载后被其封存 journal（已撤回，改为响亮抛错）；预算耗尽的 action 应答永远无法再投递。

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

受影响路径无法从 CLI 二进制触达（Java 控制面需要部署的 broker；嵌入式调度器在首次生产接线前完成加固），因此证据是新增的回归套件，每个都已在修复前代码上验证为红、修复后转绿：

- `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server`：`mvn test` —— 2096 个测试；除两个在基线上同样复现的既有 `ToolPublicationStoreTest` 时序错误，以及一个仅在 macOS sh 上失败的 `ChildWorktreeGitTest` 非 UTF8 命名用例（在 main 上同样失败）外全绿。关键套件：`MessageProjectionGapHealTest`（真实 H2 + 真实事务边界：缺口投影自愈、缺口只记录一次且只命名真正缺失的序号、丢失 `turn.completed` 时其孤立 item 被置为 failed、第二连接 `FOR UPDATE` 见证钉住"扫描持有 Session 行锁"这一自愈前提）、`MessageMaterializerTest`（退避 + 一次性上报 + 成功后重置）、`AdmittedTurnRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界 9 重试 / 10 终结、配置预算生效、daemon-503 与 broker 两臂）、`OperationRetryTerminalStateTest`（预算边界、配置预算、已提交决定分支、存活 writer 闸门、保留失败码的终态、绑定 Session 的 workspace 关闭路由、终态写入失败的回退）、`ManagedActionStoreTest`（stage 不变式 + Action 仍在等待时 FAILED 行的重新受理）、`SessionLifecycleCoordinatorTest`（预算内被阻塞的 close 保持阻塞）。
- `packages/core`：`npx vitest run src/managed-runtime` —— 3281 个测试（一个仅在负载下出现、单独运行通过的既有 flake）。覆盖含 journal 尾部修复故障注入（撕裂写入可修复、不可修复则熔断、首写 ENOENT 为瞬时、日志消失为致命）、调度器 claim/续约/释放重试策略、瞬态连续失败熔断、按激活预算收敛、dispose 竞态唤醒保护、内存阻塞轮询的减速节拍（每 tick 一次存储扫描，从 1 秒翻倍至 30 秒封顶，队列被清空的那一拍解除阻塞），以及封存失败路径的响亮抛错与授权失效。
- `npm run build && npm run bundle` 与 `npm run typecheck` 通过；`packages/web-shell` 的 OpenAPI 契约同步测试通过（契约描述更新后已重新生成客户端）。

### 前后对比证据

N/A —— 无用户可见的 UI 变更。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅单元/集成级验证（Java broker 用 H2 内存库，TS store 用故障注入 fs mock）；hosted 路径由上述套件覆盖，未跑真实 broker。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：持续瞬时失败的 turn/operation/action 现在会到达终态而不是无限重试——这正是预期变更；预算可配置（`dispatch.max-post-admission-retries`、`dispatch.max-operation-retries`，默认均为 10）并在启动时校验。命中预算的生命周期操作现在读作 `failed` 并带失败码，而不是 `completed`——这是更诚实的回答，也是契约文本现在描述的回答。
- 未验证/超出范围：嵌入式调度器尚无生产调用方（在接线前完成加固，已在测试注释中声明）；MySQL 版 `*IT` 集成测试由 CI 的 Hosted process fault gates 通道运行（本地需要 Docker/MySQL）；materializer 的退避在内存中（若运维需要跨重启的终态 consumer-progress，可作为后续工作）。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：启动校验现在会拒绝 `max-pre-admission-retries` 大于 `max-post-admission-retries` 的配置——该组合在以前是合法的（并且会静默地剥夺迟受理 turn 的重试）。外部配置中存在该组合的部署需要在升级前对齐两个键；报错信息会指明两个值。除此之外：新增两个带安全默认值的可选配置键；turn 侧新增一个失败码；lifecycle/action 侧新增失败码（自由字符串字段，无枚举变更）。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13182

</details>

prs.title: feat(web-shell): show live trajectory executions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a collapsible Recent executions section to the opt-in trajectory panel. Requests and tools update by execution identity, with estimated elapsed time only for trusted live executions and recorded duration once finished. Details show lifecycle metadata, distinguish tool execution status from final outcome, and can locate an associated request in the currently loaded history.

## Why it's needed

The historical trajectory is useful after records arrive, but it does not show an in-flight request or tool reliably. This adds immediate execution visibility while preserving the reader's historical window, filters, selection and existing timeline semantics. Retention is bounded to 256 requests and 256 tools, with a virtualized list and explicit incomplete/omitted notices.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Enable the existing trajectory entry, open it during a request and tool execution, and inspect a row. Running elapsed time is marked approximate; terminal duration uses recorded data. A tool rejected before execution says “Not executed” without a fabricated 0ms duration.
2. Interrupt the actual SSE connection while a request is running. Its state becomes unknown and elapsed growth stops; after reconnect, the recorded terminal state appears without adding a duplicate execution.
3. Navigate to an older historical window, search and select a request, then reconnect after an event gap. The historical window, query and selection remain, with a refresh notice. Live updates do not refresh history automatically.
4. Switch sessions and verify execution details do not leak across owners. Use keyboard navigation and a short viewport; the recent section can be collapsed and reopened, and details remain accessible.

Local validation: root build/typecheck/bundle passed. The broader App/trajectory run passed 1,582 tests; final focused verification plus artifact gates passed 140 tests (overlapping counts). Changed-file lint/format passed. Transcript remainder is 1,330,134 against the unchanged 1,331,500 limit. Independent review findings were fixed and rechecked. A separate comment records the real App/daemon E2E results and limitations.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Real standalone App and daemon with a controlled loopback model; prompts and responses are fixtures. Both comparison images are 1440×1000; they show different recorded windows. Before is the existing PR6C worktree build (source HEAD `456d098`); its exact bundle/source identity was not independently attested, so it is not presented as an exact current-main build. After is the final implementation build, reloaded during validation; its source hashes match this PR's committed source.

| Before: historical trajectory | After: recent executions above retained historical window |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before PR6C](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/before-pr6c.png) | ![After PR7A, history retained after gap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/history-after-gap.png) |

<details>
<summary>900×500: keyboard-opened execution details</summary>

![Compact execution inspector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/99773ee1b82ee78a555715d638b495aa33cf0a38/compact-inspector.png)

</details>

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ local build, tests and real browser/daemon E2E |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment

Node 24.14.1; frozen pnpm dependencies; actual standalone App → Provider → SDK/daemon/SSE, isolated runtime and controlled loopback provider. Transport failures used a local proxy that destroyed event sockets; no browser-store injection or external model calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: distinguishing trusted running state from replay/disconnection, and retaining history while lifecycle state changes. Tests cover these boundaries; the recent clock stays separate from historical metrics.
- Not validated / out of scope: full native subagent/PostToolUse cancellation runtime matrix; auto-follow, pause/return-to-latest behavior and a unified time viewport remain PR7B. Clock skew, conflicts, capacity and hidden timer behavior have deterministic tests, not an exhaustive real-runtime matrix.
- Breaking changes / migration: none. Existing opt-in remains; no daemon wire, core, or persistent schema changes. Historical tools are not heuristically joined to lifecycle records.

## Linked Issues

Follows #13952 (PR6C). PR7A of the staged trajectory work.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在已有 opt-in 轨迹面板中增加可折叠的“近期执行”区域。请求和工具按执行身份更新；只有可信实时执行显示估算耗时，完成后采用记录耗时。详情展示生命周期元数据，分别展示工具执行结果和最终处理结果，并可定位当前已加载历史中关联的请求。

## 为什么需要

历史轨迹适合查看已落盘记录，但不能可靠呈现正在执行的请求或工具。本次补上即时执行可见性，同时保留历史窗口、筛选、选择和既有时间轴含义。请求和工具各保留最多256条，使用虚拟列表，并明确提示不完整或展示上限省略的记录。

## 审核者验证计划

1. 打开已有轨迹入口，观察请求和工具执行并查看详情。运行耗时明确标注“约”，终态采用记录值；执行前被拒绝的工具显示“未执行”，不伪造0ms。
2. 运行中真正断开SSE连接，确认状态变为未知且停止增长；重连后收到记录终态，同一执行不会重复成多行。
3. 进入旧历史窗口，搜索并选择请求，再经历事件gap恢复。窗口、查询与选择保持，并出现刷新提示；实时更新不会自动刷新历史。
4. 切换会话，确认旧owner详情不泄漏；使用键盘和低高度视口，确认近期区可折叠和重新展开，详情可访问。

本地验证：根目录build/typecheck/bundle通过。较广的App/轨迹回归1582项通过；最终重点验证及构建产物门禁140项通过，两组数量有重叠。修改文件lint/format通过；transcript余量长度1,330,134，低于未修改的1,331,500上限。独立审查发现的问题已修复并复核；另有评论记录真实App/daemon端到端结果与边界。

## 前后证据

上方对比图均为1440×1000，真实standalone App和daemon，模型使用受控loopback，提示与回复为fixture；两张图展示不同历史窗口。Before来自PR6C工作树已有构建，源码HEAD为456d098，未独立证明旧bundle精确对应源码，因此不冒充当前main构建。After来自最终实现构建，验证时已重新加载；其源码哈希与本PR提交一致。另附900×500键盘打开执行详情的截图。

## 测试平台与环境

macOS完成本地构建、测试和真实浏览器/daemon端到端验证；Windows、Linux未在本地测试。Node 24.14.1，pnpm冻结锁文件，实际standalone App → Provider → SDK/daemon/SSE，隔离runtime及loopback模型。通过本地代理销毁事件socket模拟真实断线，没有浏览器store注入或外部模型调用。

## 风险与范围

主要风险是区分可信进行中状态与回放/断线，以及生命周期更新时保留历史状态；已有对应测试，近期区时钟不参与历史指标。未完整覆盖native子代理/PostToolUse取消真实矩阵；自动跟随、暂停/回到最新与统一时间视口留给PR7B。时钟偏差、冲突、容量与隐藏时钟有确定性测试，不能替代完整真实运行矩阵。无破坏性变更或迁移；保留已有opt-in，不修改daemon wire、core或持久化schema，也不通过猜测关联旧工具历史行。

## 关联

接续#13952（PR6C），属于轨迹分阶段工作的PR7A。

</details>

prs.title: feat(runtime-broker): add bounded retention for terminal JDBC history
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds opt-in, bounded cleanup of eligible terminal Runtime Broker JDBC history on main #14069's single canonical 32-table baseline. A dedicated scheduler deletes executions before sessions and retired bindings, using database time, a continuation cursor, row-version guards and same-connection reference checks. Defaults remain disabled, 30 days, 100 rows and a one-minute delay; bare max-age values use days and explicit values of at least 1 ms retain their units.

Publication (including COLLECTED metadata), typed CSI ACK/retirement and operator recovery, physical holders/reservations, child lineage and unsettled background Shell records protect original evidence. Shared operation/work, Session/projection, resource and storage metadata are retained. Exact binary identities and the distinct raw-publication/ACK versus Broker hash algorithms are preserved. Placement checks historical blocking evidence without decrypting it even when cleanup is off.

Both initialization routes consume one versioned 32-table baseline, with the cleanup/reference indexes included there. The former V69 SQL and old receipt-upgrade witness are archive-only. Retention remains disabled until the exact-original-owner Hosted cleanup release-proof contract in #13992 is delivered and verified.

## Why it's needed

Terminal runtime history accumulates indefinitely and adds work to placement admission. Cleanup must limit each tick's candidates and deletions while preserving physical-stop and reference evidence. Main's 32-table consolidation removed the legacy tables used by the earlier PR, so the authorized integration ports these predicates and writers' safety contracts to the canonical storage model.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm fresh initialization produces exactly 32 business tables through both routes, repeated initialization preserves complete terminal receipts, and legacy/partial catalogs are refused before writes. No second schema or old-data upgrade should be created.

Verify the two enablement flags, unit binding, minimum 1 ms configuration admission, independent scheduling and next-tick retry after a rolled-back error. Age unreferenced stopped families and check strict database-time boundaries, child-before-parent deletion, all three budgets, cursor progress, generation continuity, concurrent sweepers and rollback. Max-age is eligibility, not a deletion deadline; referenced families remain retained regardless of age.

Exercise each reference with actual shared-table kinds and raw identities, including uncommitted reads on the sweep connection and reference writers racing in both commit orders. Wrong operation/work kinds and ACTION projections must not stand in for CSI or DOMAIN evidence. Preserve COLLECTED publication and unsettled Shell process rows while collecting unreferenced siblings. Real Broker HTTP after a protected sweep must remain 200; actual Hosted reconciliation must preserve dispatch_started after close/reopen. Once the canonical Shell projection settles, the unreferenced control can delete 2 executions, 1 runtime session and 1 binding and return 404 without redispatch.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for UI screenshots. The same frozen Java integration witness failed on 3 removed legacy tables before the port and passes after it, with actual cleanup and generation continuity. Current local acceptance includes 330 scoped Java tests, 49 CLI/artifact cases, both Checkstyles, frozen installation, actual build/typecheck/bundle, the active single-V1 migration guard, two clean audits and independent exact-tree source review.

Owned MySQL 8.4.11 and MariaDB 10.11.19 each pass 32 native IT cases. Independent native HTTP/client verification covers both Session/Workspace isolation modes on both engines; independent reference sweeps retain shared metadata. At 3000 settled process rows plus 23000 projections, the production guard completes in 38.17/48.01 ms on MySQL/MariaDB. Removing DISTINCT actually times out on MariaDB but not MySQL's optimized plan; raw-only DISTINCT loses a hidden unsettled owner on both permissive actual tables. These bounded observations are not latency guarantees. New-head CI is separate and must be refreshed after push.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, JDK 25 compiling release 21, Maven 3.9.14, Node 22.22.3, pnpm 11.24.0; H2 fast feedback and isolated native MySQL 8.4.11/MariaDB 10.11.19 databases. The MariaDB catalog's large-byte fixture requires a 64MiB packet limit on the owned test server. The experimental Managed CLI worker entry remains unimplemented; acceptance uses actual Java repositories/Broker HTTP and the Hosted client, not that entry.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: deleted history cannot be restored and expired runtime-session IDs/idempotency keys must not be reused. No permanent execution tombstone or missing-binding release-success fallback is added. References can retain families indefinitely; whole-Session Shell protection remains conservative. Retention stays off pending #13992's verified release proof.
- Not validated / out of scope: production cutover, physical Shell/worker recovery, real cleanup-debt crash/reopen, full Managed deployment/scheduling, Windows/Linux local acceptance and the separate release-proof contract. Active-binding history, worker/Pod retirement, physical files and shared publication/operation metadata collection are outside this change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing HTTP/repository interfaces remain. The baseline is fresh-only; no old-data migration or in-place upgrade is provided. Preserve the old environment for historical reads, stop new admissions and settle its work before cutover, and create new Sessions only in the new environment. Rollback after new data exists must preserve and serve the new database records. Disable cleanup before reverting writers; disabling cannot restore deleted data.

Complete synchronized design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #13203. Follow-up enablement prerequisite: #13992. Canonical baseline dependency: #14069.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

在主干 #14069 的唯一 canonical32表 baseline 上，为符合资格的 Runtime Broker JDBC 终态历史增加可选有界清理。独立调度按execution、session、已退役binding顺序删除，使用数据库时间、续扫游标、行版本保护及同连接引用检查。默认仍关闭、30天、100行、一分钟间隔；无单位max-age按天解析，至少1ms的显式单位保持原义。

Publication（包括COLLECTED元数据）、有类型的CSI ACK/retirement及operator recovery、physical holder/reservation、child lineage与未结算后台Shell记录保护原证据。共享operation/work、Session/projection、resource及storage元数据保留。精确二进制身份与publication/ACK原始哈希、Broker哈希的差异保持不变。即使清理关闭，placement仍无需解密历史即可检查阻塞证据。

两种初始化共用唯一版本化32表baseline，清理与引用索引在该baseline提供。原V69 SQL与旧receipt升级witness仅归档。#13992的精确原拥有者Hosted cleanup释放证明交付并验证前，保持清理关闭。

## 必要性

Runtime终态历史持续累积并增加placement接纳开销。清理须限制每轮候选和删除量，同时保留物理停止及引用证据。主干32表整合移除了早期PR使用的旧表，因此用户批准的适配将这些查询条件和writer安全契约迁移到canonical存储模型。

## Reviewer Test Plan

### 如何验证

确认两种新库初始化都得到精确32张业务表，重复初始化保持完整终态receipt不变，旧/残缺catalog在写入前被拒绝。不得产生第二套schema或旧数据升级。

验证两个enablement开关、单位绑定、配置至少1ms、调度独立及错误回滚后下轮重试。对无引用且已停止的家族设为超龄，检查严格数据库时间边界、子先于父删除、三项预算、游标推进、generation连续性、并发清理及回滚。max-age仅表示资格，不是删除期限；有引用家族不因年龄被删除。

用真实共享表类型及原始身份验证各引用，包括sweep同连接未提交读及两种提交顺序的writer竞争。错误operation/work类型及ACTION projection不能代替CSI或DOMAIN证据。保留COLLECTED publication和未结算Shell process行，同时删除无引用兄弟记录。保护性sweep后真实Broker HTTP仍须200，实际Hosted reconciliation在close/reopen后须保留dispatch_started。canonical Shell projection结算后，无引用对照可以删除2条execution、1条runtime session及1条binding，返回404且不redispatch。

### 证据（Before & After）

UI截图为N/A。同一冻结Java集成witness在适配前真实访问3张已移除表而失败，适配后通过真实清理和generation连续性。当前本地通过330个定向Java测试、49个CLI/artifact用例、两模块Checkstyle、冻结安装、实际build/typecheck/bundle、现役单V1迁移检查、两次干净自审及独立精确tree源代码审查。

隔离MySQL8.4.11和MariaDB10.11.19每种通过32个原生IT。独立原生HTTP/client覆盖两引擎的Session/Workspace隔离，独立引用sweep验证共享元数据保留。3000条SETTLED process与23000条projection下，生产guard在MySQL/MariaDB为38.17/48.01ms。去掉DISTINCT的MariaDB反例真实超时，MySQL优化计划未超时；两种实际宽松collation表的raw-only DISTINCT均丢失隐藏未结算拥有者。这些有限规模观察不是延迟保证。新head的CI单独验证，须在推送后刷新。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ 已测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ 本地未测试 |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、JDK25编译release21、Maven3.9.14、Node22.22.3、pnpm11.24.0；H2快速反馈及隔离原生MySQL8.4.11/MariaDB10.11.19库。MariaDB catalog大字节fixture需要隔离测试服务器64MiB包限制。实验Managed CLI worker入口仍未实现；验收使用真实Java repository/Broker HTTP及Hosted client，不通过该入口。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：删除历史不能恢复，过期runtime-session ID/幂等键不得复用。本次不增加永久execution墓碑或missing-binding释放成功fallback。引用可以无限保留家族；整Session Shell保护仍保守。#13992释放证明验证前，清理保持关闭。
- 未验证或范围外：生产切换、物理Shell/worker恢复、真实cleanup-debt crash/reopen、完整Managed部署/调度、本地Windows/Linux及独立释放证明契约。活跃binding历史、worker/Pod退役、物理文件及共享publication/operation元数据回收不在范围内。
- 接口及迁移：现有HTTP/repository接口保留。baseline仅支持新库，不提供旧数据迁移或原地升级。旧环境保留历史读取，切换前停止新准入并结算工作，新Session只在新环境创建。新库产生数据后的回滚必须保留并从新库提供这些记录。回退writer前先关闭清理；关闭不能恢复已删除数据。

完整同步设计：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention/docs/design/runtime-broker-jdbc-retention.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #13203。后续启用前置条件：#13992。canonical baseline依赖：#14069。

</details>

prs.title: feat(providers): add QwenCloud as the first /auth entry
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds **QwenCloud** as a new first-position top-level entry in `/auth`, ahead of the existing Alibaba ModelStudio entry. Per the product ruling in #14025, the two entries **coexist** — ModelStudio is not replaced, renamed, or rewired, so saved ModelStudio credentials, endpoints, and model selections keep resolving to their existing presets and no migration is needed in this scope.

The new group mirrors ModelStudio's wizard shape exactly (Access Method → Platform → API Key → Model IDs), with two presets:

- `qwencloud-standard` — pay-as-you-go, `sk-` / `sk-ws-` keys
- `qwencloud-token-plan` — Credit subscription, `sk-sp-` keys

Each preset offers **China — 千问AI平台** and **International — QwenCloud** as an explicit platform step, so the UI language never decides the endpoint. Coding Plan is deliberately not offered here — it is a ModelStudio product, and presenting it as a QwenCloud one was one of the things #14025 asked us not to do.

Group wiring is mirrored across every surface that enumerates providers: the ink dialog, the OpenTUI dialog, the VS Code provider picker, and the serve catalog that Web Shell consumes. The new hosts are added to DashScope provider detection and to the web-search endpoint allowlist so the built-in `web_search` backend keeps working. Both new env keys are added to the no-AK CI gate's cleared-env list.

## Why it's needed

Users arriving from 千问AI平台 or QwenCloud could not identify the corresponding official provider in `/auth` and had to translate platform names and hand-edit endpoint URLs. #14025 also flagged that pay-as-you-go and Token Plan credentials must stay distinct — reusing ModelStudio's `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` would have made the two platforms fight over one env var.

## Naming follow-up (ee4b4a6f)

The top-level entry label is now locale-aware instead of a mixed CJK/Latin lockup: en and other locales show **QwenCloud**, zh shows **千问AI平台**, zh-TW shows **千問AI平台**. Locale-neutral surfaces (the serve catalog consumed by Web Shell, and the VS Code provider picker) carry the single Latin brand; the Chinese brand stays visible in the explicit platform step (**China — 千问AI平台**) and in the docs. The step-title brand now goes through `t()` so the localized name also appears in "… · Step 1/3 · …". The frames above are the en render; the zh render is captured in the verification artifact.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

**Endpoints are real, not inferred.** All four base URLs were taken from the platform's own documentation and then probed over the network before landing. Each returns the DashScope `invalid_api_key` envelope pointing at `alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/error-code`, which also settles the domain-ownership question raised in triage:

```
$ curl -sS -X POST https://maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-invalid-probe" -d '{"model":"qwen3.8-max","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
{"error":{"message":"Invalid API-key provided. For details, see: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/error-code#apikey-error",
 "type":"invalid_request_error","code":"invalid_api_key"}}
```

Same envelope from `maas.qwencloudapi.com`, `token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com`, and `token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com` (HTTP 401, IPs in Alibaba Cloud ranges).

**Backward compatibility is pinned by tests, not asserted.** `qwencloud-standard.test.ts` and `qwencloud-token-plan.test.ts` cross-check ownership in both directions — a ModelStudio model is not claimed by QwenCloud and vice versa — and that a saved ModelStudio `baseUrl`/`envKey` pair still resolves to the ModelStudio preset.

**Ordering change is walked, not just re-asserted.** `AuthDialog.test.tsx` previously assumed ModelStudio was the default first entry in 11 places. Rather than flipping those assertions, they now go through a `selectAlibabaModelStudio` helper that first asserts the cursor is on QwenCloud and then moves down one step — so the suite genuinely traverses the new order. The "preserve the selected main entry" test also gained a QwenCloud case.

```
core      src/providers + src/tools/web-search.test.ts        411 passed
core      src/core/openaiContentGenerator + web-search       1289 passed
cli       src/ui/auth + src/i18n                              179 passed
cli       src/serve/server/auth-provider-helpers.test.ts       20 passed
web-shell AuthMessage.dom.test.tsx                             22 passed
scripts   no-ak-integration-ci.test.js                         14 passed
```

Typecheck: `packages/core` clean. `packages/cli` reports 120 errors on this box, all pre-existing baseline from unbuilt workspace dists (`@qwen-code/sdk/daemon`, `export-transcript-document.ts`); **zero** in any file this PR touches. Prettier (repo-locked 3.6.1) and ESLint clean on all changed files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Interactive-TUI pixel capture is structurally unavailable in local worktrees on this box, so the frames below are **real ink render output** captured from `lastFrame()` in a scratch vitest run against the built dialog — not hand-drawn, and not from the packaged `dist/cli.js`.

**After — `/auth` top level (QwenCloud first, ModelStudio second and unchanged):**

```
│ Connect a Provider                                                                               │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › QwenCloud                                                                         │
│   Official recommended setup: Token Plan or Standard API Key                                     │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Alibaba ModelStudio                                                                            │
│   Official recommended setup: Coding Plan, Token Plan, or Standard API Key                       │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Third-party Providers                                                                          │
│   Choose a built-in provider and connect with an API key                                         │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Custom Provider                                                                                │
│   Manually connect a local server, proxy, or unsupported provider                                │
```

Before this PR the first entry was `› Alibaba ModelStudio` and the list had three items (see the screenshots already posted in #14025).

**After — access-method sub-menu (Token Plan + Standard API Key, no Coding Plan):**

```
│ QwenCloud · Access Method                                                           │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › Token Plan                                                                                     │
│   Subscription with a monthly Credit quota · Dedicated endpoint (Personal and Team editions)     │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Standard API Key                                                                               │
│   Pay-as-you-go · Connect with an existing platform API key                                      │
```

**After — explicit platform step, each option showing its own endpoint:**

```
│ QwenCloud · Step 1/3 · Platform                                                     │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › China — 千问AI平台                                                                             │
│   https://token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1                                    │
│                                                                                                  │
│   International — QwenCloud                                                                      │
│   https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1                                    │
```

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests via `npx vitest` in a git worktree off `origin/main` (`d28bc60d73`), plus direct `curl` probes of the four endpoints. No packaged `dist/cli.js` run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: **no authenticated first call was made.** No API key for either platform was available on this box, so first-call success, streaming, and tool calling against the new endpoints are verified only up to "the endpoint exists, serves `/compatible-mode/v1`, and authenticates through the DashScope error path". A maintainer with a key should confirm before release.
- Not validated / out of scope: `webSearch: { backend: 'dashscope' }` is declared on both presets on the strength of the platform docs (which scope the Harness search tools to models served over the Responses API) plus the identical wire shape of the ModelStudio endpoints — it is **not** confirmed by a live `web_search` call. The Token Plan model list is seeded from the platform's chat catalog with `supportsModelDiscovery: true`, because the plan docs do not enumerate which models a given tier unlocks; per-model capability metadata for `deepseek-v4.1-flash` and `glm-5.3` follows their in-repo siblings rather than a published spec.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. ModelStudio presets, env keys, `modelNamePrefix`, and `ownsModel` matching are untouched. QwenCloud uses its own `QWENCLOUD_API_KEY` / `QWENCLOUD_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY` so the two platforms cannot fight over one env var. The visible behaviour change is that `/auth` now has four top-level entries and opens on QwenCloud instead of ModelStudio.

## Linked Issues

Closes #14025

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 `/auth` 顶层新增 **QwenCloud**，排在既有的 Alibaba ModelStudio 之前。按 #14025 里 maintainer 的产品定调，两个入口**并存**——ModelStudio 不替换、不改名、不改接线，因此已保存的 ModelStudio 凭据、endpoint 与模型选择仍然匹配到原有预设，这个范围内不需要迁移。

新分组完全对齐 ModelStudio 的向导结构（接入方式 → 平台 → API Key → 模型 ID），含两个预设：

- `qwencloud-standard`——按量付费，`sk-` / `sk-ws-` 前缀
- `qwencloud-token-plan`——Credit 订阅，`sk-sp-` 前缀

两个预设都把 **中国 — 千问AI平台** 和 **国际 — QwenCloud** 做成显式的平台步骤，UI 语言不会决定 endpoint。这里刻意不提供 Coding Plan——它是 ModelStudio 的产品，#14025 明确要求不要把它当成 QwenCloud 的产品来呈现。

分组接线在所有枚举 provider 的入口都做了同步：ink 对话框、OpenTUI 对话框、VS Code provider 选择器、以及 Web Shell 消费的 serve catalog。新域名已加入 DashScope provider 判定与联网搜索 endpoint 白名单，内置 `web_search` 继续可用。两个新 env key 也加进了 no-AK CI 门禁的清空清单。

## 为什么需要

从千问AI平台或 QwenCloud 过来的用户在 `/auth` 里认不出对应的官方入口，只能自己翻译平台名、手改 endpoint URL。#14025 还指出按量付费与 Token Plan 的凭据必须区分开——沿用 ModelStudio 的 `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` 会让两个平台争用同一个环境变量。

## 评审验证方案

## 命名后续（ee4b4a6f）

顶层入口 label 改为按 locale 分开，不再是中英混排锁排：en 及其它 locale 显示 **QwenCloud**，zh 显示 **千问AI平台**，zh-TW 显示 **千問AI平台**。locale-neutral 的面（Web Shell 消费的 serve catalog、VS Code provider picker）用单一拉丁品牌；中文品牌保留在显式平台步骤（**China — 千问AI平台**）与文档里。步骤标题的品牌现在走 `t()`，所以本地化名字也会出现在「… · Step 1/3 · …」里。上文帧为 en 渲染，zh 渲染见验证 artifact。

### 怎么验

**Endpoint 是实证的，不是推断的。** 四条 base URL 都取自平台自己的文档，并在落地前做了真实网络探测。每条都返回指向 `alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/error-code` 的 DashScope `invalid_api_key` 错误体——这同时解决了 triage 里提出的域名归属问题：

```
$ curl -sS -X POST https://maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1/chat/completions \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-invalid-probe" -d '{"model":"qwen3.8-max","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
{"error":{"message":"Invalid API-key provided. For details, see: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/error-code#apikey-error",
 "type":"invalid_request_error","code":"invalid_api_key"}}
```

`maas.qwencloudapi.com`、`token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com`、`token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com` 返回同样的错误体（HTTP 401，IP 落在阿里云网段）。

**向后兼容由测试钉住，不是口头声明。** `qwencloud-standard.test.ts` 与 `qwencloud-token-plan.test.ts` 双向交叉验证归属——ModelStudio 的模型不会被 QwenCloud 认领，反之亦然——并且已保存的 ModelStudio `baseUrl`/`envKey` 组合仍然解析到 ModelStudio 预设。

**顺序变更是被走通的，不是改断言改过去的。** `AuthDialog.test.tsx` 原先有 11 处假定 ModelStudio 是默认首项。我没有翻转这些断言，而是让它们走一个 `selectAlibabaModelStudio` helper：先断言光标在 QwenCloud 上，再下移一格——所以整套测试是真的在新顺序上走了一遍。"preserve the selected main entry" 那条也补了 QwenCloud 用例。

```
core      src/providers + src/tools/web-search.test.ts        411 passed
core      src/core/openaiContentGenerator + web-search       1289 passed
cli       src/ui/auth + src/i18n                              179 passed
cli       src/serve/server/auth-provider-helpers.test.ts       20 passed
web-shell AuthMessage.dom.test.tsx                             22 passed
scripts   no-ak-integration-ci.test.js                         14 passed
```

Typecheck：`packages/core` 干净。`packages/cli` 在本机报 120 条，全是 workspace dist 未构建造成的既有基线（`@qwen-code/sdk/daemon`、`export-transcript-document.ts`），**本 PR 改动的文件零报错**。Prettier（仓库锁定的 3.6.1）与 ESLint 在所有改动文件上干净。

### 证据（前后对比）

本机 worktree 结构性拿不到交互式 TUI 的像素证据，所以下面的帧是从已构建的对话框上、用一次性 vitest 跑出来的 **真实 ink 渲染输出**（`lastFrame()`）——不是手绘，也不是打包产物 `dist/cli.js`。

**改动后——`/auth` 顶层（QwenCloud 第一，ModelStudio 第二且未改动）：**

```
│ Connect a Provider                                                                               │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › QwenCloud                                                                         │
│   Official recommended setup: Token Plan or Standard API Key                                     │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Alibaba ModelStudio                                                                            │
│   Official recommended setup: Coding Plan, Token Plan, or Standard API Key                       │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Third-party Providers                                                                          │
│   Choose a built-in provider and connect with an API key                                         │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Custom Provider                                                                                │
│   Manually connect a local server, proxy, or unsupported provider                                │
```

改动前首项是 `› Alibaba ModelStudio`，列表共三项（见 #14025 里已贴的截图）。

**改动后——接入方式子菜单（Token Plan + Standard API Key，无 Coding Plan）：**

```
│ QwenCloud · Access Method                                                           │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › Token Plan                                                                                     │
│   Subscription with a monthly Credit quota · Dedicated endpoint (Personal and Team editions)     │
│                                                                                                  │
│   Standard API Key                                                                               │
│   Pay-as-you-go · Connect with an existing platform API key                                      │
```

**改动后——显式平台步骤，每个选项显示自己的 endpoint：**

```
│ QwenCloud · Step 1/3 · Platform                                                     │
│                                                                                                  │
│ › China — 千问AI平台                                                                             │
│   https://token-plan.maas.qianwenaiapi.com/compatible-mode/v1                                    │
│                                                                                                  │
│   International — QwenCloud                                                                      │
│   https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1                                    │
```

### 测试环境

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS    |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows   |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux    |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

在基于 `origin/main`（`d28bc60d73`）的 git worktree 里用 `npx vitest` 跑单测，外加对四条 endpoint 的直接 `curl` 探测。没有跑打包产物 `dist/cli.js`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：**没有做带凭据的首调。** 本机没有这两个平台的 API key，所以新 endpoint 上的首调成功、流式、工具调用只验证到"endpoint 存在、提供 `/compatible-mode/v1`、且走 DashScope 的鉴权错误路径"这一层。发布前建议由持有 key 的 maintainer 确认。
- 未验证 / 范围外：两个预设都声明了 `webSearch: { backend: 'dashscope' }`，依据是平台文档（把 Harness 搜索工具限定在走 Responses API 的模型上）加上与 ModelStudio endpoint 完全一致的线路形态——**没有**用真实 `web_search` 调用确认过。Token Plan 的模型清单取自平台的 chat 目录并开启 `supportsModelDiscovery: true`，因为套餐文档没有列出各档位解锁哪些模型；`deepseek-v4.1-flash` 与 `glm-5.3` 的逐模型能力元数据沿用仓库内同族模型，而非已发布的规格。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。ModelStudio 的预设、env key、`modelNamePrefix` 与 `ownsModel` 匹配全部未改动。QwenCloud 使用自己的 `QWENCLOUD_API_KEY` / `QWENCLOUD_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY`，两个平台不会争用同一个环境变量。可见的行为变化是 `/auth` 现在有四条顶层入口，且默认落在 QwenCloud 而非 ModelStudio。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14025

prs.body:
## What this PR does Projects agent identity and Agent Team coordination onto the ACP/daemon wire, in two deliberately distinct collaboration columns. Subagent column (parent→child delegation): every projected subagent frame (thought, message, tool call, tool call update) now carries `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }` with a path-style name (`/root/general-purpose`), mirroring OpenAI Responses' per-item `agent` identity; the Web Shell shows that path on subagent panels (tooltip always, visible chip from depth ≥ 2). `agentName` is a readable role path, not a unique execution id: concurrent same-type subagents share it, and renaming the agent definition changes it. `parentToolCallId` distinguishes subagent executions; that boundary is documented on both the producer and the normalizer. Agent Team column (peer complete agents): an ACP-hosted session now attaches a leader sink (`teamSink.ts`). Before this, `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` returned before consuming on this host (teammate reports stayed unread in the leader inbox) and `TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` was void-emitted — the coordination never reached anyone. Now teammate reports are delivered as `peer` background notifications carrying structured sender identity (`kind: 'teammate'`, minted from the inbox entry's `from`, never parsed from message text), roster joins/exits are projected as peer notifications so an already-attached client can track membership transitions (there is no current-state snapshot for late attach or reconnect), and teammate tool approvals route to the client's `requestPermission` (fail-closed: Cancel plus a `` to the leader when the host cannot answer; YOLO auto-approve only when the request carries no renderable details). ## Why it's needed #13785 records the gap: the public vocabulary names child agents and teams, but nothing a client receives says which agent produced what. Both reference protocols (OpenAI Responses multi-agent, Anthropic Managed Agents) treat agent identity as contractual. This slice delivers the identity dimension on the daemon/ACP projection and removes the "ACP host has no leader sink" failure class — the zero-signal class among the three host classes in #13785 M4 — giving M1b a reference wire shape. Peer delivery reuses core's existing `'peer'` background-notification channel (idle wake, loss accounting, kind-agnostic drain/display), so no new event types and no ACP protocol extensions were needed. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify At `df760052100d1`, bridge-client tests passed 159/159, Agent Team leader-sink cases 6/6, and team-sink tests 12/12; targeted ESLint, CLI/ACP bridge typechecks, and the ACP bridge build passed. Real-model acceptance confirmed that a writer approval survives leader background-turn completion, remains pending for host approval, and writes the file after a Web Shell vote. See the [current-head report and screenshots](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209), including outstanding CI gates. Earlier build and runtime results below belong to earlier revisions and are not current-head acceptance evidence. Real machine: boot the daemon from this branch with `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`, create a session, send a team prompt (`team_create`, then spawn teammate `correctness` asking it to report one sentence ending in a marker). Expected and observed on SSE: peer notifications `teammate-roster-1` (status joined) and `teammate-message-2/3`, each carrying `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`, plus leader-reply frames with `source=background_notification_response`; the same capture contains zero subagent-column frames. Contrast run without a team: 47 `parentToolCallId`-chained frames carrying `kind:'subagent'` and zero peer markers — the two columns are mutually attributable at a glance. The Web Shell rendered the peer rows (`ⓘ … · peer`) and the verbatim teammate report in a real headless Chromium against the same daemon. ### Evidence (Before & After) Before: on this host an ACP session with a team delivered 0 teammate reports (retained unread in the leader inbox) and emitted 0 approval signals; no projected object carried any agent identity. After: the SSE markers and browser rendering described above. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested | ### Environment (optional) Linux host; daemon via `node scripts/dev.js serve` (no bundle step); headless Chromium (playwright) for Web Shell rendering; unit suites via vitest with `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: identity is additive `_meta`; older readers ignore it. Teammate identity is minted only for single-sender batches — mixed-sender batches stay unattributed rather than misattributed. Status/idle team events are deliberately not projected (each would wake the leader into an automatic turn). Join/exit notifications are incremental, so a client that attaches late still needs a non-waking roster snapshot/query before it can claim authoritative current membership. - Not validated / out of scope: managed-agent public-contract projections (#13785 M1a/M2/M3) and client intervention verbs (M4) remain design surfaces; foreground nested subagents do not project their own frames today (verified on real machine: single `parentToolCallId` layer, depth values only 1), so depth ≥ 2 identity has no wire producer yet — nested trees remain record-projection work (M1a); cross-session teammate projection is M1b/M3. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none; all fields additive, no new daemon routes, no contract-test surface changed. ## Linked Issues Refs #13785 (referenced without a closing keyword: the public-contract milestones remain open design work).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 把 agent 身份与 Agent Team 协调投影到 ACP/daemon 的 wire 上，分为刻意保持区分的两条协作列。 subagent 列（父子委派）：每个投影出的 subagent 帧（thought、message、tool call、tool call update）现在都带 `_meta.agent = { agentName, depth, kind }`，名字为 path 风格（`/root/general-purpose`），与 OpenAI Responses 的逐 item `agent` 身份同形；Web Shell 在 subagent 面板上显示该 path（tooltip 恒显示，depth ≥ 2 显示可见 chip）。`agentName` 是可读的角色 path，并不是唯一执行 ID：同类型并发 subagent 会共享它，agent 定义改名也会改变它；`parentToolCallId` 用于区分 subagent 执行，这一边界在生产侧与 normalizer 两侧都有文档。 Agent Team 列（对等完整 agent）：ACP 托管会话现在会挂一个 leader sink（`teamSink.ts`）。在此之前，本宿主上 `TeamManager.pollLeaderInbox()` 会在消费前早退（队员报告留在 leader inbox 里未读），`TEAMMATE_APPROVAL_REQUEST` 空 emit——协调过程到不了任何人手里。现在队员报告以 `peer` 背景通知投递，带结构化发送者身份（`kind: 'teammate'`，从 inbox 条目的 `from` 铸造，绝不从消息文本解析）；roster 的加入/退出投影为 peer 通知，已挂载的客户端可跟踪成员变化（晚挂载或重连时没有当前状态快照）；队员的工具审批路由到客户端 `requestPermission`（fail-closed：宿主无法应答时 Cancel 并向 leader 注入 ``；仅当请求不带可渲染细节且处于 YOLO 时才自动批准）。 ## 为什么需要 #13785 记录了缺口：公共词表里有 child agent 与 team，但客户端收到的任何东西都不说明「哪条输出是哪个 agent 产的」。两个参照协议（OpenAI Responses multi-agent、Anthropic Managed Agents）都把 agent 身份当契约内容。本片在 daemon/ACP 投影侧交付身份维度，并消掉「ACP 宿主没有 leader sink」这一失效类——即 #13785 M4 三类宿主中的零信号类——为 M1b 给出参考 wire 形状。peer 投递复用 core 既有的 `'peer'` 背景通知通道（空闲唤醒、丢失记账、kind 无关的 drain/display），因此不需要新事件类型、不需要 ACP 协议扩展。 ## 评审测试计划 ### 如何验证 `df760052100d1` 上 bridge-client 159/159、Agent Team leader sink 6/6、team-sink 12/12、定向 ESLint、CLI/ACP bridge 类型检查和 ACP bridge 构建均通过。真实模型已验证队员审批跨 leader 后台轮次结束仍保持待审，Web Shell 单次批准后文件实际写入。见[当前提交验收报告与截图](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13902#issuecomment-6138227209)，其中也列出尚未完成的 CI gate。下方构建和真机结果属于较早版本，不作为当前提交的验收证据。 真机：从本分支起 daemon（`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM=1 node scripts/dev.js serve --port

--token --workspace

`），建会话，发 team prompt（`team_create`，再派 teammate `correctness` 要求其回一句以 marker 结尾的话）。SSE 上期望并实测到：peer 通知 `teammate-roster-1`（status joined）与 `teammate-message-2/3`，均带 `_meta.agent={"agentName":"/root/correctness","depth":1,"kind":"teammate"}`，以及 `source=background_notification_response` 的 leader 回话帧；同一抓帧中 subagent 列帧为零。不带 team 的对照跑：47 帧 `parentToolCallId` 链帧带 `kind:'subagent'`、peer 标记零命中——两列形状互斥、可一眼归因。Web Shell 在真 headless Chromium 中对同一 daemon 渲染出了 peer 行（`ⓘ … · peer`）与队员原话。 ### 证据（Before & After） Before：本宿主上带 team 的 ACP 会话投递 0 条队员报告（留在 leader inbox 未读）、0 个审批信号；任何投影对象都不带 agent 身份。After：上述 SSE 标记与浏览器渲染。 ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :-------------: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 | ### 环境（可选） Linux 宿主机；daemon 走 `node scripts/dev.js serve`（无 bundle 步骤）；Web Shell 渲染用 headless Chromium（playwright）；单测走 vitest 并加 `env -u QWEN_CODE_SERVE -u QWEN_RUNTIME_DIR`。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或权衡：身份是 additive `_meta`，旧读者会忽略它。teammate 身份只为单发送者批次铸造——混合发送者批次宁可无身份也不张冠李戴。status/idle 队事件刻意不投影（每条都会唤醒 leader 起一个自动 turn）。加入/退出通知是增量流，晚挂载客户端仍需要一个不会唤醒 leader 的 roster 快照/查询，才能声称拿到了权威当前成员表。 - 未验证 / 超出范围：managed-agent 公共契约投影（#13785 M1a/M2/M3）与客户端干预动词（M4）仍是设计面；foreground 嵌套 subagent 今天不投影自身帧（真机验过：parentToolCallId 仅一层、depth 取值仅 1），故 depth ≥ 2 身份暂无 wire 生产者——嵌套树仍是记录投影工作（M1a）；跨 session 的 teammate 投影属 M1b/M3。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无；全部字段 additive，无新 daemon 路由，契约测试面未变。 ## 关联 Issue Refs #13785（不用 closing 关键字引用：公共契约里程碑仍是开放的设计工作）。
