prs.title: fix(managed-agent): Wire OSS capture budgets into Hosted sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does New Hosted Shell-family Sessions now receive the configured raw-output capture budget when tool publication is enabled. The Java SDK serializes the optional budget only when supplied and validates the existing 1-to-2^41 contract. Files, MCP and no-tool creation retain their request shape, while load and recovery retain the Session's saved budget. The public lifecycle regression fixture now verifies remote output bytes and object collection. ## Why it's needed The Harness and Java/OSS publication backend already supported remote capture, but Java Session creation omitted the budget even with publication enabled. Real-bucket testing produced no publication rows and an UNSUPPORTED / unsupported_receipt_producer result projection. This wiring allows the ordinary Java creation path to produce durable, publicly readable output without a test admission relay. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. With publication enabled and a 1 MiB execution budget, create a Shell Session through the public Java API and approve a foreground command whose stdout and stderr exceed 64 KiB. Confirm the saved definition and publication grant contain the configured budget, and the public tool-result and raw Artifact downloads preserve the original bytes and digests. 2. Confirm publication-disabled Shell creation and Files/MCP/no-tool creation omit the optional budget. Change the deployment budget and exercise create-conflict-to-load and cold recovery; existing Sessions must retain their saved budget and explicit conflicting Harness loads must be rejected. 3. Cancel a running command with a child process, then execute another Shell/Read Turn in the same Session. Confirm the original process group exits, the next effect occurs once, close physically retires the original worker while retaining readable output, and DELETE collects only that Session's objects. Focused SDK/server tests, Checkstyle, SpotBugs, full repository build/typecheck/bundle and 11 selected Harness recovery contract cases were rerun and passed on the submitted commit after rebasing onto main `163e4686191ddf888a45c1d95b20ac4c646a4e01`. The separate E2E report records the earlier 8-case Linux integration gate and unrelayed real-bucket run against `ec37cec0f3a44c6928a23498de6dd845e3852823` plus the identical capture change; that Linux gate was not rerun after rebase. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A — no visual UI changes. Backend before/after evidence, byte counts and physical cleanup observations are included in the separate E2E report. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested, including post-rebase checks | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested before rebase; exact acceptance baseline recorded above | ### Environment (optional) macOS used Node 22.22.3 and Java 21.0.8. Linux acceptance used Ubuntu 26.04 arm64, Node 22.22.1, Java 21.0.12.1, MySQL 8.4.11 and OSS SDK 3.18.4 with a controlled model responder and a private, unversioned Beijing bucket. The capture budget was 1 MiB and the Session/tenant capacities were each 1 GiB. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: enabling publication activates the existing remote producer for new Shell-family Sessions. Aggregate capacities must cover the raw budget, 4,784,128 bytes of producer/admission overhead and retained publications. Existing Monitor/background paths retain their admission, approval and delegated cgroup requirements. - Not validated / out of scope: Windows, a fresh post-rebase Linux/cloud run, a real deployment-budget switch, new VM reboot qualification, cross-host recovery, real model providers, the full permission-fault matrix and 100 MiB/1 GiB load gates. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no new route, public request field, SQL migration or configuration default. Publication, original-Artifact exposure and GC retain their independent flags. Existing inline Sessions remain inline, and load does not replace their saved budget. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/f2222d6f846620654295963c19d0a951faca287f/docs/design/2026-10-13-hosted-oss-capture-wiring.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/f2222d6f846620654295963c19d0a951faca287f/docs/design/2026-10-13-hosted-oss-capture-wiring.zh-CN.md). Both versions contain the same decisions, constraints, acceptance results and validation boundaries. ## Linked Issues Refs #12380 (Managed Agent delivery proposal; this change does not close the proposal).
中文说明 ## 本 PR 的改动 启用 tool publication 时，新建的 Hosted Shell-family Session 现在会收到配置的原始输出 capture 预算。Java SDK 仅在提供预算时序列化该可选字段，并按现有 1 至 2^41 合同校验。Files、MCP 与无工具创建保持原请求格式，load 与恢复保持 Session 已保存的预算。公开生命周期回归装置现在验证远程输出字节和对象回收。 ## 为什么需要 Harness 与 Java/OSS publication 后端已经支持远程 capture，但 Java Session 创建即使启用 publication 也没有传入预算。真实 bucket 测试中没有产生 publication 记录，结果投影为 UNSUPPORTED / unsupported_receipt_producer。本接线使普通 Java 创建路径无需测试 admission relay 即可产生持久、公开可读的输出。 ## Reviewer 测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 启用 publication 并配置 1 MiB 执行预算，通过公开 Java API 创建 Shell Session，审批 stdout 和 stderr 均超过 64 KiB 的前台命令。确认保存的 definition 与 publication grant 含配置预算，公开工具结果及原始 Artifact 下载保持原字节与摘要。 2. 确认关闭 publication 的 Shell 创建及 Files/MCP/无工具创建均省略可选预算。修改部署预算后验证 create 冲突转 load 与冷恢复；已有 Session 必须保持已保存的预算，显式冲突的 Harness load 必须被拒绝。 3. 取消带子进程的运行中命令，再在同一 Session 执行 Shell/Read Turn。确认原进程组退出、后续副作用恰好一次、close 物理关闭原 worker 且保留可读输出，DELETE 仅回收该 Session 的对象。 Rebase 到 main `163e4686191ddf888a45c1d95b20ac4c646a4e01` 后，提交的 commit 重新执行针对性 SDK/server 测试、Checkstyle、SpotBugs、完整仓库 build/typecheck/bundle 及选定的 11 个 Harness 恢复合同用例，全部通过。独立 E2E 报告记录此前在 `ec37cec0f3a44c6928a23498de6dd845e3852823` 加相同 capture 改动上完成的 8 个 Linux 集成用例与无 relay 真实 bucket 运行；rebase 后没有重跑该 Linux 门禁。 ### 证据（改动前后） N/A — 没有视觉 UI 改动。后端改动前后证据、字节计数与物理清理观察记录在独立 E2E 报告中。 ### 已测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :---: | :---: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试，包含 rebase 后检查 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ rebase 前已测试，精确验收基线已在上文注明 | ### 环境（可选） macOS 使用 Node 22.22.3 与 Java 21.0.8。Linux 验收使用 Ubuntu 26.04 arm64、Node 22.22.1、Java 21.0.12.1、MySQL 8.4.11、OSS SDK 3.18.4，以及受控模型 responder 和北京的私有、未启用版本控制的 bucket。Capture 预算为 1 MiB，Session/tenant 容量各为 1 GiB。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：启用 publication 会为新 Shell-family Session 激活现有 remote producer。聚合配额须覆盖原始预算、4,784,128 字节的 producer/admission 开销及保留的 publication。现有 Monitor/后台路径保持各自的准入、审批与 cgroup 委派要求。 - 未验证或范围之外：Windows、rebase 后新的 Linux/cloud 运行、真实部署预算切换、新 VM 重启验收、跨主机恢复、真实模型服务、完整权限故障矩阵及 100 MiB/1 GiB 负载门禁。 - 兼容性与迁移说明：不新增路由、公开请求字段、SQL 迁移或配置默认值。Publication、原始 Artifact 暴露与 GC 保持各自独立开关。已有内联 Session 保持内联，load 不替换其已保存预算。 设计：[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/f2222d6f846620654295963c19d0a951faca287f/docs/design/2026-10-13-hosted-oss-capture-wiring.md) 与 [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/f2222d6f846620654295963c19d0a951faca287f/docs/design/2026-10-13-hosted-oss-capture-wiring.zh-CN.md)。两版包含一致的决策、约束、验收结果与验证边界。 ## 关联 Issue 关联 #12380（Managed Agent 交付 proposal；本改动不关闭该 proposal）。

prs.title: feat(web-shell): review MCP App messages before submission (PR3a)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a reviewed submission flow for standard MCP App text messages. The Test Failure Explorer can ask to analyze up to 20 selected failures, then the host shows the complete request, its source and the original live session. Only explicit confirmation submits an ordinary prompt. Success means a real daemon prompt receipt; it does not mean analysis has completed. Composer drafts remain intact, and hosts without messaging retain manual copy.

## Why it's needed

PR2 requires copying the generated analysis request into the conversation. This PR3a stage connects that request to the existing session submission and permission flow, with host review, lifecycle checks and clear cancellation or unknown-receipt states. It also guards each SDK recovery attempt so an invalidated review cannot retry later, and keeps the current session's recovered client identity usable for a fresh review.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Display an imported test report in the Explorer and select failures across pages. Selection stops at 20; the request contains a fixed read-only instruction plus report/failure IDs. Requesting analysis opens a host-owned review, and no prompt is sent until the user confirms there.
2. Confirm an idle session's request. The original session receives exactly one ordinary prompt, the App reports acceptance after its real receipt even while the model is running, and any unsent composer draft remains unchanged. Closing the App afterward must not cancel the accepted turn.
3. Cancel review or invalidate its session while asynchronous submission preparation is pending. Releasing preparation must not produce a late write. Repeat during client-registration recovery: the old request stays cancelled, and a fresh same-page request can use the recovered client. Switching A→B→A must not send to or overwrite the wrong owner.
4. Check known-busy refusal, missing message capability and a lost admission response. Busy refuses without local queue/mid-turn submission; missing capability retains copy/query; a lost response shows unknown acceptance without automatic resend or a generic failed-send claim. Ordinary composer recovery and downstream tool approvals should remain unchanged.

Exact source `1070d92dacb9f742ec9e6007440e591fc4646a17`: build, bundle, workspace/integration typecheck, SDK public types, formatting and lint passed. Host/actions/bridge/review/i18n **390/390**, full App **1,161/1,161**, SDK **99/99**, Explorer **138/138**, embedded host **45/45**, isolated React 18 DOM **46/46** passed; counts overlap and are not summed. Final actual-daemon incremental verification passed **14/14**. All 21 PR3a acceptance entries have explicit daemon/SDK/DOM evidence layers. Two clean final self-review passes and independent full/follow-up review found no remaining actionable issue. [Acceptance report, identity and limitations](https://github.com/qqqys/qwen-code/blob/b904554e9d686cac49ba2a90aa25091bf6b92374/acceptance.md).

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before is the merged PR2 implementation at `96707ab988`: an actual daemon/App card with a synthetic 75-failure report, dark theme and 900px inner App width (915×641 card capture including scrollbar), offering manual copy. After is this PR's actual daemon, packed extension, AppBridge and sandbox with a deterministic one-failure report/model fixture, light theme and the stated host viewport. Report, theme and framing differences are disclosed; this illustrates the workflow change, not a pixel comparison.

| Before: PR2 manual copy | After: host review, 1280×900 |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before: manual-copy request in PR2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b904554e9d686cac49ba2a90aa25091bf6b92374/before-pr2-copy-900px.png) | ![After: explicit host review and send](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b904554e9d686cac49ba2a90aa25091bf6b92374/after-review-1280x900.png) |

| Real receipt accepted before model completion, 1440×1000 | Lost receipt remains unknown, 390×844 |
| --- | --- |
| ![Accepted with the original draft preserved](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b904554e9d686cac49ba2a90aa25091bf6b92374/after-accepted-1440x1000.png) | ![Unknown receipt without retry or a contradictory failure toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/qqqys/qwen-code/b904554e9d686cac49ba2a90aa25091bf6b92374/after-unknown-390x844.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local checks and actual daemon/browser acceptance |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally; hosted CI is separate |

### Environment (optional)

Local build/tests used Node 22.17.0. Actual daemon acceptance used Node 25.9.0, Chromium, React 19, isolated workspaces and a freshly packed extension. React 18.3.1 compatibility used isolated hook/bridge DOM tests. SDK 60/120-second timeout cases used actual SDK classes with a controlled logical clock; the host's 90-second review expiry was exercised in the real browser. Final daemon verification ran on 2026-10-12 07:51–08:02 UTC. Sources, build outputs and served assets matched the recorded hashes; owned test processes and ports were cleaned up. Model/report data were local fixtures, with no claim of production or live-model analysis quality.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: asynchronous preparation, session changes and registration recovery must preserve the reviewed owner. A small optional SDK check runs before every admission attempt; ordinary callers retain existing recovery. App-origin admission errors retain their dedicated review state after normal cancellation/transcript cleanup. Maintainer review of this cross-package boundary is requested.
- Not validated / out of scope: PR3b busy queues/mid-turn delivery, generated layouts, test execution/fixes, production model quality, a full React 18 daemon browser run and every background-history/pane visual combination. The ordinary prompt may queue if another client wins a dispatch race; this does not promise atomic idle-only admission. Historical/related lifecycle variants have focused DOM coverage.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new daemon route, dependency or lockfile change. Validated base is `30582105fe`; publication-time main `e9b87acd73` merges cleanly, but local acceptance was not rerun on that merged tree. Plans, raw local evidence and screenshots are excluded from the product diff; published review evidence is on a separate immutable commit. Hosted CI, approval and merge remain separate gates.

## Linked Issues

Follows merged PR2 #13916 and PR1 #13854. Implements PR3a of the revised Test Failure Explorer sequence.

prs.title: fix(Managed agent): settle never-started background dispatches in the live turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

A failed background Shell dispatch now settles its child task in the live Turn when the original Broker definitively proves no process was admitted. This covers reservations that never created a publication row. Present, unknown, rejected or mismatched process results remain unresolved; Monitor dispatches keep their existing proof path.

## Why it's needed

The in-turn failure path depended on closing a publication row that might not exist. Its failed proof left an admitted task at running/dispatch_started indefinitely, even though the reload reconciliation could later prove the process never started.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Refuse a background reservation before its publication row is created. Confirm the original process lookup returns typed runtime_execution_not_found and the resident task becomes failed/not_started_proven without reopening the Session. Repeat with a present process row or unavailable Broker and confirm the task remains unresolved.

### Evidence (Before & After)

On base 21b78c55, the absence regression failed because the last operation remained dispatchStarted; the ambiguous-proof controls passed. After main integration, the candidate passes all 293 tool-turn/Broker/reconciliation/workflow-child tests. Dedicated macOS/H2-file and native Linux/MySQL 8.4 cases pass: three reserve refusals leave no publication row; the real Broker returns typed process-not-found; the durable record and public task become failed with not_started_proven, without Session reopen or a Shell side effect. The witness covers task settlement before Session reopen; final Turn liveness is not qualified. No UI layout changes. The process-fault cases above ran on the frozen pre-integration candidate (base 21b78c55 plus the same fixes). Its CLI bundle, Java executable packaging, Checkstyle and independent correctness/security source reviews passed. After integration with main c5098a27, repository build/typecheck, changed-file ESLint/Prettier, 293 CLI tests and 193 Java tests pass. Delivered-head CI remains pending.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Focused regression, build and controlled JDBC fault case |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ Native Linux / MySQL 8.4 fault case |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64 and Ubuntu 24.04 arm64 (kernel 6.8), Node 22.22.0, JDK 21. Isolated H2-file and fresh MySQL 8.4 databases, controlled model provider, unused mocked object-store seam and internal team-lead profile. A labelled private transport producer supplies captureBytes=1 MiB; the Java public connector does not enable that lane today. No capability flags are faked. This no-dispatch case does not certify actual Linux Shell containment or a real provider.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Only the original Broker process ledger can supply the fallback proof. Publication absence itself, timeout or a generic 404 must never authorize terminal settlement.
- Not validated / out of scope: Monitor absence proof, successful completion of the remaining uncertain batch, periodic reconciliation, and full Linux/production qualification are separate work.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: No public route, schema or protocol field changes.

Design: [English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.zh-CN.md). Both versions are synchronized.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13937. Related programme: #12380.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的变更

后台 Shell 派发失败时，原 Broker 明确证明进程从未准入后，在当前回合内结算 child 任务，覆盖 publication 行从未创建的预留失败。进程存在、unknown、查询拒绝或身份不匹配时继续未结算；Monitor 保留已有取证路径。

## 为什么需要

回合内失败路径依赖关闭一个可能不存在的 publication 行。取证失败后，已准入任务会长期保持 running/dispatch_started，直到重开会话才可能由 reload 对账证明从未启动。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

在创建 publication 行之前拒绝后台预留。确认原进程查询得到带类型的 runtime_execution_not_found，常驻任务无需重开会话即可变为 failed/not_started_proven。进程行存在或 Broker 不可达时重复，确认任务仍保持未结算。

### 证据（Before & After）

基线 21b78c55 上，行缺失回归因最后一次操作仍是 dispatchStarted 而失败，不确定证明的对照通过。合入主干后，候选通过全部 293 项 tool-turn/Broker/对账/workflow-child 测试。独立 macOS/H2 文件库和原生 Linux/MySQL 8.4 场景均通过：三次预留拒绝后没有 publication 行，真实 Broker 返回带类型的进程不存在，持久记录与公开任务无需重开会话即可变为 failed / not_started_proven，且没有 Shell 副作用。取证覆盖重开会话前的任务结算；未验证最终 Turn 活性。 无 UI 布局变更。上述进程故障场景运行于合入新主干前的冻结候选（基线 21b78c55 加同一修复）。该候选的 CLI bundle、Java 可执行包、Checkstyle 及独立正确性/安全源码审查通过。合入 main c5098a27 后，仓库 build/typecheck、改动文件 ESLint/Prettier、293 项 CLI 与 193 项 Java 测试通过。发布 head 的 CI 待出。

### 已测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :--: | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 定向回归、构建及受控 JDBC 故障场景 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 原生 Linux / MySQL 8.4 故障场景 |

### 环境

macOS arm64 和 Ubuntu 24.04 arm64（内核 6.8）、Node 22.22.0、JDK 21。使用独立 H2 文件库、新建 MySQL 8.4、受控模型、未使用的对象存储 mock 和内部 team-lead profile。明确标记的私有传输 producer 提供 captureBytes=1 MiB；当前 Java 公共 connector 尚未开启这条 lane。未伪造能力标志。本次从未派发场景不能证明真实 Linux Shell 进程隔离或真实 provider 资格。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：后备证明只能来自原 Broker 进程账本。publication 缺失、超时或普通 404 都不能授权终态结算。
- 未验证或范围外：Monitor 行缺失证明、其余不确定批次的成功完成、周期对账，以及完整 Linux/生产资格均为独立工作。
- 接口及迁移：不增加公共路由、schema 或协议字段。

设计：[English](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/yiliang114/qwen-code/blob/38e56932ec96b308f03db7212f5b65377e92e1c0/docs/design/2026-10-11-never-started-dispatch-reconcile.zh-CN.md)。两版保持同步。

Fixes #13937。上层计划：#12380。

prs.title: fix(channels/email): re-register on a channel_disconnected answer
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the control plane answers `submitInbound` or `claimDeliveries` with `409 channel_disconnected`, the email adapter now treats it as the same poll-level registration claim as `409 channel_generation_unregistered`: it forgets its registration, keeps the mail/delivery claimed, and lets the next poll's `ensureRegistered()` re-register — the only call that flips the instance back to `connected` — before the drive resumes. A `409 channel_generation_stale` stays out of the branch by design: the server holds a newer generation there, so re-registering cannot converge.

## Why it's needed

A `POST /disconnect` is keyed only on the channel identity, with no owner or generation fencing, so a co-owner's shutdown can flip the instance to `disconnected` under an adapter whose registration is still current. Before this fix, that answer fell into the per-message deterministic-refusal branch: every inbound mail was then dropped with only a stderr line (the mailbox's `lastUid` had already advanced, so nothing was left to re-drive), and every outbound pull re-threw from `pullOutbox()` while the claim lease kept proving aliveness — total, silent mail loss on the inbound side and a permanently stalled outbound side, both lifted only by restarting the process. Found by the review-bot's R3 round on the merged #13572 (thread `[Critical] R3-3`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run `npx vitest run src/managed-email-adapter.test.ts` in `packages/channels/email`. The two new witnesses pin one arm each:
- `re-registers when the control plane reports disconnected, keeping the mail (R3-3)`: a `submitInbound` rejection `{status: 409, code: 'channel_disconnected'}` leaves the event claimed, the next tick re-registers, and the mail is admitted — the deterministic-refusal log line never fires.
- `re-registers when the outbox claim reports disconnected, recovering the send (R3-3)`: a one-shot `claimDeliveries` rejection with the same shape skips the stuck pull (no throw, no drop), the next tick re-registers, and the delivery is sent.

Both were verified red before the fix (fail-first), and each stays green when only the other arm's condition is mutated — the acceptance criterion from the review thread holds per arm. Full package suite: 57/57 green; prettier/eslint/tsc clean on both touched files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — adapter internals only, no user-visible UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |  N/A   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: re-registering heals `connected` more aggressively; the branch deliberately excludes `channel_generation_stale`, which can never converge, and `400/403` deterministic refusals, whose semantics are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: no live IMAP run against the real control plane — the fault path is exercised against the package's fake control plane, which models the exact status/code payloads the server produces (`ManagedChannelService.submitInbound` / `claimDeliveries`).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; adapter-local classification change with no API or schema surface.

## Linked Issues

Addresses the `[Critical] R3-3` review thread on #13572 (merged).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

当控制面应答 `submitInbound` 或 `claimDeliveries` 返回 `409 channel_disconnected` 时，email 适配器现在把它当作与 `409 channel_generation_unregistered` 同类的 poll 级注册凭据处理：遗忘注册、保留邮件/投递的在途认领、让下一次轮询的 `ensureRegistered()` 先重新注册——唯一能把实例状态献回 `connected` 的调用——再恢复驱动。`409 channel_generation_stale` 刻意留在分支之外：服务器持有更新的 generation，重新注册不可能收敛。

动机：`POST /disconnect` 只按 channel 标识键控、无 owner/generation 栅栏，共同持有方的关闭动作会把实例在仍在运行的适配器脚下翻成 `disconnected`。修复前该应答落入逐条消息的确定性拒绝分支：每个入站邮件只留一行 stderr 便被丢弃（`lastUid` 已前进，无可重驱之物），而出站的每次拉取都从 `pullOutbox()` 重新抛出、claim 租约仍旧证明存活——入站全静默丢失、出站永久停滞，只有重启进程才能解除。来源为已合并 #13572 上 review-bot R3 轮的 `[Critical] R3-3` thread。

验证：`packages/channels/email` 下 `npx vitest run src/managed-email-adapter.test.ts`；两个新见证各自钉住一臂（inbound 保留邮件并在刷新后重新提交；outbound 跳过卡住的拉取、下一 tick 恢复发送），均 fail-first 验证为红、按臂变异各自变红；整包 57/57，prettier/eslint/tsc 干净。

</details>

prs.title: fix(sdk-java): Close Hosted Harness review criticals from #12654
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the fixes for the 11 Critical and 2 Minor findings from the post-merge review of #12654 (the Hosted Harness private Java client), **plus the closures for the second review round filed against this PR itself**. #12654 merged before its review round was processed (all 62 threads were still open); every finding in scope was re-verified against current `main` before fixing. The remaining 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round are dispositioned in their threads and tracked as a backlog in #13313; #13313 also tracks the deferred remainder of this PR's own review round.

### Second round (addressing the CHANGES_REQUESTED review of this PR)

The second round execution-proved one real regression in the first commit — CI's fault-gates lane agreed — and five more critical defects around it:

- **Wire/digest mismatch (CI-confirmed)**: the digest was canonicalized but the wire `prompt` member was not, and the hosted route re-derives the digest from the received bytes — every `addText` submission drew `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`. `toJson()` now emits the canonical form, the digest reuses the `JsonSupport.encode` facade over that same value (one serialization entry point), and the pinning test asserts the wire bytes and the digest are literally the same value (byte-literal expectation plus the canonical digest constant).
- **Idle watchdog vs. silent hosted route**: the 45s bound was inherited from the stdio transport, whose server writes heartbeat comments; the hosted events route wrote nothing while no event was committed, so healthy silent streams — long tool calls, slow model phases, the ten-minute approval wait — were aborted and re-dispatched forever. The hosted route now mirrors the primary route's keepalive comment every 15s, and `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` accepts `Duration.ZERO` for callers that own the deadline. A new test keeps a consumer parked in `next()` for three idle budgets while the peer stays alive on keepalive comments alone; the pre-existing idle-timeout test still goes red when the watchdog is removed.
- **Idle abort surfaced outside the `DaemonException` family**: when the watchdog fired while the consumer was between `next()` calls, the closed guard threw `IllegalStateException`, contradicting the new javadoc and invisible to consumers classifying by `DaemonException`. The guard now distinguishes who closed the stream: idle abort → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`, caller close → `IllegalStateException`.
- **Executor-rejection overreach**: the cause-chain scan certified any rejection-shaped `IOException` as "never dispatched", but response delivery also runs on the caller-supplied executor — a rejection surfacing after the server accepted a turn dropped the active-prompt marker for an admitted turn and reported it definitively not submitted. Now only a bare `RejectedExecutionException` (submit time) or a rejection with the executor already shut down classifies as saturated/known; mid-flight shapes stay outcome-unknown and keep the marker. This is pinned deterministically by staging a parked worker + a full queue + a delayed 202 answer through a package-private executor seam.
- **Boot-headerless 4xx misclassified as outcome-unknown**: the missing-header wrap treated the server's own pre-middleware refusals (413 body-too-large, 429) the same as a gateway's error page. All four mutation sites now re-derive: ambiguous (408/5xx) keeps outcome-unknown; a definitive unfenced refusal surfaces as `DaemonHttpException` with its status preserved.
- **Folded-in adjacent closures**: `detachSession` retires the local attachment on every definitive answer (not just 204/404), so a 403 after an auth revocation no longer leaks a heartbeat timer; a caller queued on `cursorLock` when the stream closes re-checks inside the lock and gets the closed-stream signal instead of a transport error; the `session_snapshot` comment now names the actual producer (the bridge's `withSnapshot` on the **primary** events route — the hosted route ignores the query parameter and stamps every frame with an id); the builder javadoc records the cursor-fallback precedence and that `snapshot(true)` is a primary-transport option; the README retry section and both design-doc languages now state the canonical digest as a cross-language wire contract and record that changing the digest algorithm requires quiescing (or rewriting) in-flight turn rows before upgrading; and two previously unpinned arms (an explicit cursor beating the ref watermark, and a definitive boot-headerless DELETE) got their own discriminating tests.

### First round (post-merge review of #12654)

- Stream lifecycle: `HarnessEventStream` no longer parks `close()` behind a consumer blocked in `next()` — the closed flag is atomic and the raw input is closed without any stream monitor, so `HostedHarnessClient.close()` always completes and a blocked `next()` fails with `DaemonTransportException` (the idle watchdog above completes this picture).
- Turn ledger correctness: a 409 rejection no longer retains an uncloseable marker keyed by the rejected promptId (it releases the slot and throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException`); a definitive non-409 failure on a same-identity retry releases the slot it retained for that retry; and `getStatus()` snapshots the active-prompt entry before the remote read and only ever removes that exact registration, so a stale `hasActivePrompt:false` can no longer delete a different prompt admitted while the read was in flight.
- Outcome classification (first-cut form, narrowed in the second round — see above): a response missing the `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence header on a mutation path is classified as outcome-unknown instead of a bare `DaemonProtocolException`, because a response that never passed the fencing middleware cannot prove the mutation did not execute; and a purely local executor rejection surfaces as `DaemonTransportException` instead of claiming the request may have reached the server.
- Lifecycle cleanup: `closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` treats a definitive 404 as already-done and tears down the attachment and the active-prompt ledger, and `detachSession` tolerates 404 the same way for the attachment (it does not clear the active-prompt ledger — that asymmetry stays, tracked in #13313), so the heartbeat timer no longer keeps posting to a session the server has already reclaimed.
- Protocol interop: `streamEvents` falls back to the session ref's validated watermark when the builder omits the resume pair, so the epoch fence the README promises is actually enforced (and `Last-Event-ID` resumes from the ref's cursor), while a ref carrying no watermark keeps today's unfenced fresh-stream shape; and the shared SSE parser accepts the id-less synthetic `session_snapshot` frame produced by the primary transport's snapshot subscription.
- Digest and model invariants: `computePayloadDigest` hashes a canonical form (object keys sorted recursively, array order preserved) instead of process-random `Map` iteration order, so the dedup key is reproducible across JVMs and across map implementations (fastjson2's `MapSortField` was ruled out by probe: it does not sort maps nested inside a collection); and `HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` enforces at construction that a `known` outcome carries its status map, instead of NPE-ing later inside `isContinuationReady()`.

Every finding is pinned by new tests whose mutation witnesses were run: reverting that finding's fix turns its test red (witness tables under "How to verify").

## Why it's needed

The Hosted Harness client is the Java control-plane transport for the private hosted profile, and its public contract promises fail-closed behaviour (bounded resources, outcome-unknown classification, single active prompt per session, epoch-fenced resume). The first review demonstrated each of these promises had a concrete violation; the second review then execution-proved that the first round's own fixes carried one cross-language regression (CI agreed) and four more fail-closed violations of the same class, in exactly the surfaces the stubs cannot see (the server re-deriving the digest, the hosted route's silence, the executor's dual dispatch/delivery role, and the closed guard's type). Working through both rounds before merge is cheaper than shipping the client with a broken prompt path and correcting it afterwards.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The behaviors are pinned by 23 new cases in `HostedHarnessClientTest`. Run:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 tests (19 pre-existing + 23 new)
mvn -o test                                    # full module: 189 tests, 9 env-gated skips
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 tests
```

All green locally on JDK 17; `clean test` green on JDK 11 (module targets release 11; two executor-rejection cases skip themselves on JDK 11, whose `HttpClient` parks a send to a struggling executor instead of surfacing the rejection — probed on 11/17/21).

Mutation witnesses, first round (revert the fix → the pinning test goes red):

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 (null guard) | drop `requireNonNull(status)` for `known` outcomes | RED |
| R1-6 (digest order) | hash raw `promptContent` again | RED |
| R1-4 (stale getStatus) | unconditional `activePrompts.remove(key)` | RED |
| R1-2 + F2 (409 / retry slot) | restore retain-on-409 / retry-keeps-slot | RED (both tests) |
| R1-5 ×3 sites | bare `validateGeneration` | RED ×3 |
| R1-3 (close 404) | tolerance limited to `clientId == null` | RED |
| R1-46 (detach 404) | detach requires 204 unconditionally | RED |
| R1-47 (snapshot frame) | `session_snapshot` out of the id-less set | RED |
| R1-44 (ref watermark) | fence/cursor from the request only | RED |
| R1-1 (shared monitor) | `next()`/`close()` on one monitor again | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-43 (watchdog) | watchdog disabled | RED (timeout arms the hang) |
| R1-45 (rejection type) | wrap as `IOException` again | RED |

Mutation witnesses, second round:

| Fix | Reverted shape | Mutant result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wire = digest | `toJson()` emits the raw list again | RED (byte-literal asserts the type-first wire) |
| Idle-abort type | closed guard always `IllegalStateException` | RED |
| In-lock re-check | queued caller never re-checks | RED |
| Rejection gate | unbounded cause walk again | RED (mid-flight rejection certified as saturated) |
| Boot-header narrow ×2 | blanket outcome-unknown at the prompt and DELETE sites | RED ×2 |
| Detach finally | cleanup after `requireMutationStatus` only | RED (heartbeats keep beating) |
| Watchdog/keepalive pair | watchdog removed | RED on the idle case, GREEN on the keepalive case |
| Explicit cursor wins | ref-only resume fallback | RED |

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI protocol/transport fix; the mutation tables above are the before/after. CI's `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` lane was green at the merge base and red at the first commit — it is the integration-level evidence for the wire/digest regression and should return to green on this head.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### Environment (optional)

Local: `JAVA_HOME=jdk17` (full suite) and `jdk11` (`mvn clean test`), Maven 3.9.11, in `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`; `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts` in `packages/cli`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the payload digest is now a canonical cross-language contract — digests computed by the previous release differ for the same content, which is the point of the fix (old values were JVM-random and could never be reproduced across processes). The design doc (both languages) now records that an upgrade altering the digest must quiesce or rewrite in-flight turn rows first; the coordinator-side one-time recompute fallback is deliberately not in this slice (it lives in the managed-agent-server module and is tracked in #13313). Consumers blocked in `next()` now also see `DaemonTransportException` on an idle abort — including the between-calls arm, which previously surfaced as `IllegalStateException`.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 49 Suggestion-level findings from the #12654 round (tracked in #13313). From this PR's own round: the code-carrying `Prompt*` exception redesign for per-`code` marker rules (needs route-semantics-level API work, tracked with the verified gate-order table), the coordinator's missing terminal escape for post-admission outcome-unknown (managed-agent-server slice, tracked), the remaining witness-table coverage items (three of six addressed here), and pinning the JDK-11 executor behavior rather than skipping it (the 11/17/21 difference is now disclosed in the tests, the builder javadoc, and the design doc). `closeSession(String)` still lacks its `ensureOpen()` guard (#13313's R1-50): the post-close executor-rejection test deliberately routes through that path on JDK 17+ and documents the coupling.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: digest change as above; `submitTurn` on a 409 now throws `PromptAlreadyActiveException` instead of `DaemonHttpException`; definitive unfenced 4xx on mutation paths now throw `DaemonHttpException` carrying the status instead of outcome-unknown types; `submitTurn`'s `toJson()` now emits key-sorted content blocks (the server accepts them — it validates shape and re-derives the digest).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12654 (post-merge review findings fixed here) and #13313 (backlog of the deferred remainder from both rounds).

<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地了 #12654(Hosted Harness 私有 Java 客户端)合入后评审的 11 条 Critical 与 2 条 Minor 修复,**以及针对本 PR 自身第二轮评审的闭环**。#12654 在评审处理前已合入(62 条 thread 全部开放);范围内每条发现都在当前 `main` 上重新核实后才修复。其余 49 条 Suggestion 级发现在各自 thread 中给出处置并汇总进 #13313;#13313 同时跟踪本 PR 评审轮次中推迟的剩余项。

### 第二轮(针对本 PR 的 CHANGES_REQUESTED 评审)

第二轮用执行证明了首个提交中的一处真回归——CI 的 fault-gates 车道结论一致——以及围绕它的另外 5 个关键缺陷:

- **线上字节与 digest 不一致(CI 实测确认)**:digest 被规范化而线上 `prompt` 字段没有,hosted 路由又按收到的字节重算 digest——每个 `addText` 提交都拿到 `400 invalid_hosted_prompt`。`toJson()` 现在输出规范形式,digest 经 `JsonSupport.encode` 门面处理同一个值(唯一序列化入口),钉住测试断言线上字节与 digest 是字面相等的同一个值(字节字面量断言 + 规范 digest 常量)。
- **空闲看门狗与静默 hosted 路由**:45s 上界继承自 stdio 传输,那一侧服务端每 15s 写心跳注释;hosted 事件路由在无新事件提交时一个字节都不写,于是健康的静默流——长工具调用、慢模型阶段、十分钟审批等待——被中止并无限重派。hosted 路由现在以与主路由相同的方式每 15s 写一次 keepalive 注释,且 `Builder.sseIdleTimeout` 接受 `Duration.ZERO` 供自管期限的调用方关闭。新测试让消费者停在 `next()` 里跨三个空闲预算、对端仅靠 keepalive 存活;既有空闲超时用例在移除看门狗后仍变红。
- **空闲中止的异常类型不属于 `DaemonException` 家族**:看门狗在消费者处于两次 `next()` 之间触发时, closed 守卫抛 `IllegalStateException`,与新增 javadoc 矛盾、且按 `DaemonException` 分类的消费者捕不到。守卫现在区分关闭由谁发起:空闲中止 → `DaemonTransportException('Hosted Harness SSE idle timeout')`,调用方主动 close → `IllegalStateException`。
- **执行器拒绝分类越界**:cause 链扫描把任何"拒绝形状"的 `IOException` 都认证为"从未派发",但响应投递也运行在调用方提供的执行器上——在服务端已受理之后才出现的拒绝,会把一个已被 admit 的轮次的活跃标记丢掉并报告为"确定未提交"。现在只有原始 `RejectedExecutionException`(提交时)或执行器已终止两种情形归为饱和/已知;中途形状一律保持 outcome-unknown 并保留标记。通过包级执行器测试缝以"停住 worker + 填满队列 + 延迟应答 202"的方式确定性钉住。
- **缺 boot 头的 4xx 被误分类为 outcome-unknown**:缺头 wrap 把服务端自身在中间件之前发出的确定性拒绝(413 body 过大、429)与网关错误页一视同仁。四个变更路径现在重新推导:歧义(408/5xx)保持 outcome-unknown;确定性无 fence 拒绝以携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 呈现。
- **顺带闭环的同簇项**:`detachSession` 对任何确定性应答都拆除本地 attachment(不再只有 204/404),认证吊销后的 403 不再泄漏心跳定时器;流关闭时排在 `cursorLock` 上的调用方在锁内重检并得到"流已关闭"信号而非传输错误;`session_snapshot` 注释现在写明真实生产者(主事件路由上 bridge 的 `withSnapshot`——hosted 路由从不读取该查询参数且每一帧都带 id);builder javadoc 记录游标兜底优先级与 `snapshot(true)` 是主传输选项;README 重试段落与两份设计文档现在把规范 digest 写成跨语言线上契约,并记录"改变 digest 算法的升级必须先排空(或重写)在途 turn 行";另有两个此前未钉住的分支(显式游标压过 ref 水印、确定性缺头 DELETE)获得了有判别力的用例。

### 第一轮(#12654 合入后评审)

- 流生命周期:`HarnessEventStream` 的 `close()` 不再停放在阻塞于 `next()` 的消费者之后——关闭标志为原子量,原始输入在不取任何流监视器的情况下关闭,`HostedHarnessClient.close()` 总能完成,被阻塞的 `next()` 以 `DaemonTransportException` 失败(上面的空闲看门狗补全了这一图景)。
- 轮次台账正确性:409 拒绝不再保留以被拒绝 promptId 为键、永远无法清除的标记(释放槽位并抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException`);同身份重试收到确定性非 409 失败时释放该重试保留的槽位;`getStatus()` 在远端读取前快照活跃 prompt 条目且只删除那一次注册,陈旧的 `hasActivePrompt:false` 不再能删掉读取在途期间准入的另一个 prompt 的登记。
- 结果分类(第一版形态,第二轮已收窄——见上):变更路径上缺少 `X-Qwen-Harness-Boot-Id` fence 头的响应被分类为结果未知而非裸 `DaemonProtocolException`,因为未经 fence 中间件的响应无法证明变更未执行;纯本地执行器拒绝以 `DaemonTransportException` 呈现,而不是谎称请求可能已到达服务端。
- 生命周期清理:`closeSession(HarnessSessionRef)` 把确定性 404 视为已完成并拆除 attachment 与活跃 prompt 台账,`detachSession` 对 attachment 同样容忍 404(它不清活跃 prompt 台账——该不对称保留,记入 #13313),心跳定时器不再向已被服务端回收的会话持续投递。
- 协议互操作:`streamEvents` 在 builder 省略续传对时回退到 session ref 上已校验的水印,README 承诺的 epoch fence 真正生效(`Last-Event-ID` 也从 ref 游标续传);不携带水印的 ref 保持无 fence 的全新流形态。共享 SSE 解析器现在接受主传输 snapshot 订阅产生的无 id 合成 `session_snapshot` 帧。
- digest 与模型不变量:`computePayloadDigest` 对规范形式(对象键递归排序、数组顺序保持)做哈希,而不是对进程随机的 `Map` 迭代序做哈希,去重键可跨 JVM、跨 map 实现复现(实测否决了 fastjson2 的 `MapSortField`:它不对集合内嵌套的 map 排序);`HarnessRuntimeExecutionRecovery` 在构造时强制 `known` outcome 必带 status map,而不是之后在 `isContinuationReady()` 里 NPE。

每条发现由新测试钉住,并已运行变异见证:单独还原该发现的修复,钉住它的测试即变红(见证表见“如何验证”)。

## 为什么需要

Hosted Harness 客户端是私有 hosted profile 的 Java 控制面传输,其公开契约承诺 fail-closed 行为(有界资源、结果未知分类、每会话单活跃 prompt、epoch-fenced 续传)。第一轮评审证明了每一项承诺都存在具体违例;第二轮又用执行证明第一轮自己的修复在 stub 看不到的那些面上带着一处跨语言回归(CI 结论一致)以及另外四处同类违例(服务端重算 digest、hosted 路由的静默、执行器的派发/投递双重角色、closed 守卫的异常类型)。在合入前处理完两轮评审,比带着断掉的 prompt 路径上线再返工便宜。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

这些行为由 `HostedHarnessClientTest` 的 23 个新用例钉住。运行:

```
cd packages/sdk-java/qwencode
mvn -o test -Dtest=HostedHarnessClientTest     # 42 个测试(19 既有 + 23 新增)
mvn -o test                                    # 全模块:189 个测试,9 个环境门控跳过
cd ../cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts   # 181 个测试
```

本机 JDK 17 全绿;JDK 11 上 `clean test` 绿(模块目标 release 11;两个执行器拒绝用例在 JDK 11 上自行跳过——JDK 11 的 `HttpClient` 对挣扎中的执行器表现为停放 send 而不是抛出拒绝,已在 11/17/21 上实测)。

变异见证:第一轮表格 13 行、第二轮表格 9 行(见英文部分),每行为"还原形态 → 变异结果(全部 RED)";第二轮"看门狗/keepalive 对"一行同时记录空闲用例 RED 与 keepalive 用例 GREEN 的双向判别。

### 证据(Before & After)

N/A —— 非 UI 的协议/传输修复;上方变异表即为前后对照。CI 的 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 车道在合并基为绿、在首个提交为红——它是线上字节/digest 回归的集成级证据,本 head 上应恢复为绿。

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   N/A (CI) |

### 环境(可选)

本机:`JAVA_HOME=jdk17`(全套件)与 `jdk11`(`mvn clean test`)、Maven 3.9.11,在 `packages/sdk-java/qwencode`;`packages/cli` 内 `npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts`。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡:payload digest 现在是跨语言规范契约——旧版本对同一内容算出的 digest 会不同,这正是修复的目的(旧值是 JVM 随机值,跨进程本就复现不出)。设计文档(中英)现在记录了改变 digest 的升级必须先排空或重写在途 turn 行;协调器侧的一次性重算兜底刻意不在本切片(在 managed-agent-server 模块,记入 #13313)。阻塞在 `next()` 的消费者现在也会在空闲中止时看到 `DaemonTransportException`——包括"两次调用之间"这一臂,此前表现为 `IllegalStateException`。
- 未验证/范围外:#12654 轮的 49 条 Suggestion(记入 #13313)。本 PR 自身轮次中推迟的:按 `code` 决定标记规则的 `Prompt*` 异常重新设计(需要路由语义级的 API 工作,连同已核实的路由门顺序表一并记账)、协调器在 outcome-unknown 之后缺少终态出口(managed-agent-server 切片,记账)、见证表剩余覆盖项(六项中本 PR 处理了另外三项)、以及把 JDK 11 的执行器行为钉住而不只是跳过(11/17/21 的差异现在同时披露在测试、builder javadoc 与设计文档中)。`closeSession(String)` 仍缺 `ensureOpen()` 守卫(#13313 的 R1-50):JDK 17+ 的执行器拒绝测试刻意流经该路径并在注释中写明耦合。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明:digest 变更见上;`submitTurn` 收到 409 时现在抛 `PromptAlreadyActiveException` 而不是 `DaemonHttpException`;变更路径上的确定性无 fence 4xx 现在抛携带状态码的 `DaemonHttpException` 而不是 outcome-unknown 类型;`submitTurn` 的 `toJson()` 现在输出按键排序的 content block(服务端接受——它只校验形状并重算 digest)。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #12654(本 PR 修复其合入后评审发现)与 #13313(两轮评审推迟剩余项的 backlog)。

prs.title: fix(cli): close post-merge takeover findings from the #13083 review
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR lands the three Critical findings from the [post-merge review on #13083](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826) (Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover), each pinned by a unit witness, plus the findings filed by several follow-up /review rounds (R1–R5) on this PR itself. All three gaps sit on the managed-agent takeover path:

1. **A takeover load left the Session indistinguishable from an idle one.** The load answered 200 and registered the Session while its recovered Turn was still unsettled, yet nothing on the Session marked that Turn as in flight and owned by the client. `/status` reported the exact pair the SDK's settlement check reads as a terminal Turn, a fresh `/prompt` was admitted over the checkpoint the load had just advertised, and a user cancel was a silent no-op while a Runtime Session was held. The Session now records the recovered-but-undriven Turn: `/status` reports it in flight, `/prompt` refuses a fresh Turn over it (logged for oncall), and the continue/cancel routes clear the marker when they drive the Turn to its terminal record — a retryable cancel failure keeps the marker so the coordinator's retry re-drives the same Turn. The marker is deliberately not aliased to the existing active/blocked state, since both refuse the coordinator's own continue/cancel.
2. **A failed continuation reconciliation used to settle the Turn terminally.** The inlined recovered-continuation called the committed-results resume with no error mapping; the follow-up review then established that blocked-for-recovery is worse here: the comment's promised re-drive does not exist (the Session stays registered, and the connector drops its recovery tracking on the 200 admission), and an already-registered Session can never be re-loaded. The shipped shape is therefore the honest terminal one again: a raw escape from the resume — a transient warmup failure or a retryable re-acquire refusal, which the tool turn rethrows as-is — settles the Turn as a terminal error, while only an already-wrapped recovery error still lands in the recovery-blocked handler, exactly like the sibling driver classifies them after admission. A pre-wrapped error is rethrown unwrapped so the block log names the real cause, and a Turn settling without completing drops its pending file-history marker with it — a failing retirement stays owed and is retried by the next settled prompt or by close, so one transient failure can neither brick a Session's file history nor record a completed Turn as an error. Separately, a cancel replay certified while the stop still ran is now recorded on the admission, so a later failure stops waiting for a retry that cannot arrive; a fallible step after the durable checkpoint moved (the marker retirement or the terminal record write) admits loudly — best-effort terminal, recovery-blocked, marker cleared — instead of a permanent identity-mismatch; a refused lease release owes the lease for the next terminal route on the correct runtime-session id, and a Runtime Session the Broker already forgot is treated as handed back so the obligation retires instead of retrying forever. Finally, a refused load-resume now logs its reconciliation root cause before answering a bare 503.
3. **An unknown execution read had no truthful representation.** The recovery-report status read mapped every `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` to "definitively unknown" (#13083 review R2-3). The H2 hooks rewrite on main (#13129) already replaced that fold with a first-class wire state whose only terminal consumer fails closed; this PR owns the terminal arm the Broker marks with `details.terminal` (an ABANDONED record, fenced on loss evidence alone). Such a record now reaches callers as the distinct `abandoned` state — never folded into the not-found sentinel — and the cancellation's stop step accepts it as cancellation-complete without a cancel or a poll that could never observe anything more, while a still-reconcilable unknown keeps failing closed (one shared predicate keeps the pre-cancel skip and the post-cancel poll in lockstep). The passive report keeps its fence too: a fenced record now arrives as known + `{ state: 'abandoned' }` instead of folding into the same unknown the coordinator cannot drive, since only a federated cancellation can retire it. The takeover arms its undriven marker only through the producer's own drivability call (`every outcome known`, and drive restricted to `results_ready`). The user-facing cancel route also refuses a user cancel in the undriven-takeover window with a scoped 409 instead of confirming a cancellation that never happened.

The review history is recorded honestly: R2-3's observed transient-unknown failure was already closed on main by #13129, so this PR's delta on that axis is the terminal arm plus its stop-step handling.

## Why it's needed

Each finding either wedges a shared resource or makes the durable journal lie: a second Turn over the advertised checkpoint pins the recovered Runtime lease on a dead owner; a terminally settled continuation can never be driven again and keeps the checkpoint's receipts unconsumed; a skipped cancel lets a possibly running execution outlive the Turn the journal claims was cancelled; a folded terminal record certifies a stop nobody observed while the Workspace lease is handed away; a certified-then-failed cancel leaves the Session claiming an in-flight Turn that will never settle; and a 204 user cancel claims a stoppage that never occurred. Every fixed branch goes red when its production hunk is reverted (mutation evidence below).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the three touched suites from `packages/cli`:

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts
```

What to confirm, one behavior per finding:

- After a takeover load and before any continue/cancel, `GET /session/:id/status` reports the Session in flight and `POST /session/:id/prompt` with a fresh prompt is refused with `409 hosted_turn_active`; the user cancel answers a scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required` in that window (and keeps 204 when idle or driving); after the continuation settles, a fresh prompt is admitted again. (Witness: *reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*.)
- When the continuation's reconciliation escapes `resumeCommittedResults()` raw, the route still answers 200 but the Turn settles as a terminal `turn_error` instead of blocking forever, and the Session reads idle and unblocked afterwards. (Witness: *settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*.)
- A pre-wrapped recovery error reaching the continuation keeps its cause visible in the block log: the logged line contains `Original file history snapshots changed.` rather than the wrapper boilerplate. (Witness: *logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*.)
- A cancel replay that was certified 200 while the stop still ran stops waiting for a retry after failure: `/status` reports `recoveryBlocked: true` with `hasActivePrompt: false`, a user cancel is refused `hosted_turn_recovery_required`, and a fresh prompt gets the truthful code too. (Witness: *reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*.) A failure after the durable checkpoint moved is admitted the same way — loudly, not armed-and-idle. (Witness: *admits the post-settle failure loudly once the checkpoint has moved*.)
- A completion-failing file-history retirement owes the marker and retires it through close: the cold load after detach stays 200; a completed continuation never pays that fallible round trip. (Witnesses: *retires the pending marker through close when the retirement write fails once*, *skips the file-history retirement read on a completed continuation*.)
- A lease release refused after a confirmed stop settles the Turn and owes the lease: the cancel answers 200 with the cancelled terminal record, and the replay's terminal route retries the release instead of the coordinator drowning in 503s and identity mismatches. (Witness: *settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*.)
- A 409 carrying `details.terminal` reads as `{ state: 'abandoned' }`, a marker-less 409 as `{ state: 'unknown' }`, a 404 as undefined; through the stop step, abandoned is accepted with no cancel issued while unknown still throws, and an execution fenced abandoned mid-poll still ends the stop. The passive report advertises `unknown` for both kinds. (Witnesses: *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records* at the wire; *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*, *breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*, and the extended *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown* at the recovery layer.)
- A cancel whose stop confirmation fails still answers 503, keeps the owned Turn refused, and the coordinator's retry drives the same cancellation to settlement. (Witness: *refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*.)

Mutation evidence recorded during development, all producing red: reinstating the blanket wrap makes the terminal-settle witness time out with no terminal event; removing the replay-certified failure branch leaves the Session armed and the fresh prompt answered `hosted_turn_active`; rethrowing the refused release turns the owed-lease witness into a 503; removing the terminal discriminator at the broker fails with `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`; removing the abandoned arm from the stop-step pre-check calls `cancel` once where zero is required; removing it from the poll spins past the test timeout instead of breaking; removing it from the passive fold reports `known` for an abandoned record.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — non-UI change; behavior is exercised by the unit witnesses above.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux Test lane green on the PR head commit; Windows covered by the same suite family. Local run: 256/256 across the three touched suites.

### Environment (optional)

Local `vitest run`; full `npm run build` and package typecheck green. The previously intermittent `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` was deflaked in this PR (synchronization on the stop step's first status read instead of polling `/status`, whose semantics the takeover change itself alters); 3/3 consecutive full-file runs green locally and green on CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the new `/prompt` refusal, `/status` reporting, and scoped user-cancel refusal apply only in the window between a takeover load and its continue/cancel; the Java coordinator does not poll `/status` in that window (it drives continue directly after load, and its HarnessCoordinator retry scheduler re-drives retryable failures including the 503 the daemon answers for an unconfirmed stop), and every changed branch is pinned by a unit witness.
- The accepted-abandoned cancellation asserts no observed stop; the journal's own wording for that turn is "cancelled with its owner", and the stop-step contract comment now records that the abandoned stop is accepted unproven because the Broker fenced the record permanently on loss evidence. A Session that goes recovery-blocked through the pre-wrapped class still has no re-drive, as at base — closing that gap needs the coordinator protocol to grow one, which is deliberately not this PR.
- Not validated / out of scope: the 36 Suggestions from the #13083 post-merge review, tracked in #13187.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the wire contract adds one refusal the takeover design already implied, `/status` becomes truthful where it previously read as terminal, and the user cancel stops promising a stoppage it did not perform in one bounded window.

## Linked Issues

Post-merge review on #13083: https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826
Deferred Suggestions: #13187

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

本 PR 落地 [#13083 合后 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13083#pullrequestreview-5383736826)（Hosted Turn takeover / G1 failover）的三条 Critical 与本 PR 多轮 /review 的后续发现，每条都有单元见证。三个缺口都在托管代理 takeover 路径上：

1. **takeover load 之后的 Session 与空闲会话无法区分。** 恢复出的轮次尚未结算时，load 就已回答 200 并注册 Session，但 Session 上没有任何状态表明该轮次在途且归属于客户端：`/status` 报告的键值对恰好被 SDK 的结算检查读作"轮次已终态"；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 会在刚通告的 checkpoint 之上被准入；用户取消在 Runtime Session 仍被持有时静默落空。现在 Session 会记录"已恢复但未驱动"的轮次：`/status` 报告其在途，`/prompt` 拒绝在其上开启新轮次（并落日志给 oncall），continue/cancel 路由把轮次驱动至终态记录时清除标记——可重试的取消失败会保留标记，让协调器的重试重新驱动同一轮次。该标记刻意不复用现有的 active/blocked 状态，因为这两者会拒绝协调器自己的 continue/cancel。
2. **续跑调和失败曾经把轮次结算为终态。** 内联的恢复续跑最初调用已提交结果续跑时没有任何错误映射；后续 review 进一步确认"为恢复而阻塞"在此处更糟：注释所承诺的重驱并不存在（Session 保持注册，协调器在 200 准入时就移除了恢复跟踪），而已注册的 Session 永远无法重新 load。因此交付的形态回归诚实的终态语义：从续跑中原始逃逸的失败——瞬态 warmup 失败或可重试的 re-acquire 拒绝（工具轮次原样重抛）——把轮次结算为终态 error，而只有已预包装的恢复错误仍进入恢复阻塞处理器，与兄弟驱动在准入后的分类完全一致。预包装错误原样重抛，使阻塞日志能看到真实原因。另外：仍在运行就被认证通过的 cancel replay 现在会记录在 admission 上，之后失败时不再等待永远不会来的重试，而是把 Session 如实报告为恢复阻塞而非"武装且空闲"；已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为欠账交下一终态路由重试，不再让 503 压在已结算的轮次上（此前会让协调器陷入身份不匹配死循环）。
3. **对 unknown 执行读取缺少如实的表达。** 恢复报告的 status 读取曾把所有 `409 runtime_broker_execution_unknown` 映射为"确定性未知"（#13083 review R2-3）。main 上的 H2 hooks 重写（#13129）已把这种折叠替换成一等公民的线上状态，其终态消费者 fail closed；本 PR 拥有的是 Broker 用 `details.terminal` 标记的终态分支（ABANDONED 记录，仅凭丢失证据封闭）。这类记录现在以独立的 `abandoned` 态到达调用方——不再折叠进 not-found 哨兵——取消路径的停止步骤在不发出取消或轮询（两者本就无法再观测到任何东西）的前提下接受它为"取消完成"，仍可调和的 unknown 继续 fail closed；一条共享谓词保证取消前跳过与取消后轮询两臂一致，被动报告仍对两者通告 `unknown`。用户侧取消路由在未驱动 takeover 窗口内对 user cancel 回答 scoped 409，不再确认一次从未发生的取消。

review 历史被如实记录：R2-3 观测到的瞬态 unknown 失败已由 main 上的 #13129 关闭，本 PR 在该轴的贡献是终态分支及其停止步骤处理。

## 为什么需要

每条发现要么钉死共享资源，要么让持久化日志说谎：在已通告的 checkpoint 上再开第二个轮次，会把恢复出的 Runtime 租约钉在已死的属主上；被结算为终态的续跑再也无法驱动，checkpoint 的回执永远无人消费；被跳过的取消会让一个可能仍在运行的执行，比日志声称已取消的轮次活得更久；被折叠的终态记录会把无人观测的停止说成事实，同时把 Workspace 租约递交给下一个获取者；先认证后失败的取消会让 Session 声称有一个永不结算的在途轮次；204 的用户取消会声称一次从未发生的停止。每个修复分支在生产代码被还原时都有见证变红（下文变异证据）。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

在 `packages/cli` 下运行三个受影响的套件：

```bash
cd packages/cli
npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts src/serve/hosted-runtime-recovery.test.ts src/serve/hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts
```

每条 finding 对应一个待确认行为：

- takeover load 之后、任何 continue/cancel 之前，`GET /session/:id/status` 报告会话在途；带新 promptId 的 `/prompt` 拒绝为 `409 hosted_turn_active`；该窗口内用户取消回答 scoped `409 hosted_turn_recovery_required`（空闲或驱动中仍为 204）；续跑结算后新 prompt 再次被准入。（见证：*reports the undriven recovered Turn as in flight until a terminal route drives it*。）
- 续跑调和以原始形态逃逸出 `resumeCommittedResults()` 时，路由仍回答 200，但轮次结算为终态 `turn_error` 而非永久阻塞，且 Session 事后读作空闲且未阻塞。（见证：*settles a raw reconciliation failure as a terminal error and keeps the Session usable*。）
- 预包装的恢复错误到达续跑路由时，其底层原因仍可在阻塞日志中看到：日志行包含 `Original file history snapshots changed.`，而不是包装器套话。（见证：*logs the root cause when the recovered continuation fails pre-wrapped*。）
- 仍在运行就被认证 200 的 cancel replay，在失败后不再等待重试：`/status` 报告 `recoveryBlocked: true` 与 `hasActivePrompt: false`，新 prompt 被如实地拒绝为 `hosted_turn_recovery_required`。（见证：*reports the failed stop loudly after a replay certified the cancel*。）
- 已确认停止后被拒绝的租约释放改为结算轮次并欠账：取消回答 200 并落已取消终态记录，replay 的终态路由重试该释放，而不是让协调器淹没在 503 与身份不匹配里。（见证：*settles the cancellation and owes the lease when its release is refused*。）
- 带 `details.terminal` 的 409 读作 `{ state: 'abandoned' }`，无标记的 409 读作 `{ state: 'unknown' }`，404 仍为 undefined；经停止步骤，abandoned 被接受且不发出取消，unknown 仍然抛错，取消后被废弃的执行也会让轮询准时结束。被动报告对两类都通告 `unknown`。（见证：wire 层 *distinguishes unknown outcomes from definitive not-found records*；恢复层 *accepts a terminally abandoned record as cancellation-complete*、*breaks the terminal poll when an execution is fenced abandoned after the cancel*，以及扩参后的 *reports an execution the Broker cannot account for as unknown*。）
- 停止确认失败的取消仍回答 503，持有的轮次继续保持拒绝，协调器的重试会把同一次取消驱动到结算。（见证：*refuses to settle a cancellation the Broker never confirmed*。）

开发过程记录的变异证据（均产生变红）：恢复全量包装让终态结算见证超时且无终态事件；删除 replay 认证后的失败分支会让 Session 处于武装态并把新 prompt 答为 `hosted_turn_active`；还原拒绝释放的重抛会把欠租用例变回 503；去掉 broker 的 terminal 判别得到 `expected { state: 'unknown' } to equal { state: 'abandoned' }`；去掉停止前检查的 abandoned 臂会在要求零次时调用一次 `cancel`；去掉轮询臂会在应结束时自旋至测试超时；去掉被动报告折叠臂会把废弃记录报告为 `known`。

### 前后对照证据

N/A——非 UI 变更，行为由上述单元见证覆盖。

### 已测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux Test lane 在 PR head 上已通过；Windows 由同族套件覆盖。本地：三个受影响套件 256/256。

### 环境（可选）

本地 `vitest run`；`npm run build` 与包级 typecheck 全绿。此前间歇失败的 `replays a lost cancel admission at its watermark while it runs` 已在 PR 内 deflake（改用停止步骤首次 status 读取做同步，替代语义被 takeover 改动本身改变的 `/status` 轮询）；本地连续 3 轮全文件通过，CI 亦通过。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：新增的 `/prompt` 拒绝、`/status` 报告与 scoped 用户取消拒绝，只作用于 takeover load 与其 continue/cancel 之间的窗口；Java 协调器在该窗口内不轮询 `/status`（load 后直接驱动 continue，且其 HarnessCoordinator 重试调度器会重驱包括 daemon 为未确认停止所答 503 在内的可重试失败），且每条改动分支都有单元见证钉住。
- 被接受的 abandoned 取消并未断言观测到停止；该轮次落在日志里的措辞是"cancelled with its owner"，停止步骤的契约注释也已写明：该停止未经证明而被接受，因为 Broker 仅凭丢失证据就把该记录永久封闭了。经由预包装类别进入恢复阻塞的 Session 仍无重驱（与基线一致）——关闭这个缺口需要协调器协议新增一条通道，刻意不在本 PR 内做。
- 未验证/范围外：#13083 合后 review 的 36 条 Suggestions，已在 #13187 跟踪。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无；线上契约只增加了 takeover 设计本就隐含的一个拒绝，`/status` 从"读作终态"变得如实，用户取消在一个有边界的窗口内不再承诺它未执行的停止。

prs.title: docs(cli): stop naming Terminal.app in the arrowKeysScrollTranscript description
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Replaces a false named example in the user-facing description of `ui.arrowKeysScrollTranscript`. The shipped text told users to turn the setting on for "terminals that cannot report the mouse wheel to the app — macOS Terminal.app is the common case". Terminal.app does report the wheel, so the advice sends the wrong people to the opt-in. The named example is replaced by the condition the setting actually targets: a terminal or multiplexer that does not pass mouse reporting through and turns wheel/trackpad scrolling into ↑/↓ key presses. No replacement terminal is named, because none was observed to behave that way.

Wording only. No behaviour change, and no change to the setting's default, type, label, `requiresRestart`, `showInDialog`, or to any code that reads the flag.

Four sites carry the sentence. Three are listed in the issue; the fourth is a scope correction:

1. `packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts` — the `description` string. Source of truth.
2. `packages/vscode-ide-companion/schemas/settings.schema.json` — generated from (1), never hand-edited.
3. `docs/users/configuration/settings.md` — **hand-maintained**, and this is the correction. Both the issue body and the existing thread comment state that this file does not mention the key. It does, at line 166, carrying the same sentence plus an extra trailing "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI." that the schema text does not have. That extra sentence is preserved verbatim. There is no generator for this file: `scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` has exactly one `writeFileSync`, targeting only `settings.schema.json`, and zero occurrences of `settings.md`. wenshao's own comment on #14016 does enumerate all four sites including this one.
4. `packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx` — the code comment above the derived flag. The `(#10749)` reference is kept, and the comment still explains why the opt-in exists; only the terminal attribution changes.

Verified out of scope — these mention the key but never name Terminal.app, so they are untouched: `docs/users/reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md`, `docs/users/support/troubleshooting.md`, `packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.ts`, and the two fallback comments inside `InputPrompt.tsx`'s arrow-key handlers. There is also no i18n mirror for this key (zero hits across all 9 locale files).

## Why it's needed

The named example is the load-bearing part of the advice, and it is measurably wrong. wenshao (COLLABORATOR) measured this directly on PR #14016, comment id `6139158687`, 2026-10-13T05:47:41Z, on Terminal.app 2.15 / macOS 26.6.2 (Apple Silicon), with qwen running directly in the window and no tmux:

- With `?1002h ?1006h` set — exactly what qwen writes — Terminal.app sends SGR wheel events (`ESC[<64;...M` up, `ESC[<65;...M` down). Identical on `main` (`21b78c55d5`), the PR head (`da1f4e6c3d`) and v0.22.3.
- Arrow-key bursts appear **only** when the app has *not* requested mouse reporting *and* has set application-cursor mode `?1h`. qwen never sets `?1h` on any of the three.
- With View —> Allow Mouse Reporting turned off, Terminal.app sends nothing at all.

So a Terminal.app user who follows the current advice gains nothing — their wheel already scrolls the transcript via SGR — and loses bare ↑/↓ input history from an empty composer. The advice actively makes things worse for exactly the audience it names.

Wording used is wenshao's, since he is the measurement source: "a terminal or multiplexer that does not pass mouse reporting through and turns wheel/trackpad scrolling into ↑/↓ key presses". doudouOUC's variant in the issue thread is equivalent; wenshao's is preferred because it comes from the person who ran the probe, and because the singular form reads correctly in the schema description. He explicitly found no terminal on his machine that behaves the way the text claimed, which is why no replacement example is invented.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. **The false example is gone.** `git grep -n 'Terminal.app is the common case'` returns nothing and exits 1. Before this PR it returns 3 matches (`settingsSchema.ts:1306`, `settings.schema.json:500`, `settings.md:166`). `git grep -n 'Terminal\.app' packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx` also returns nothing.
2. **Nothing else moved.** `git diff --stat origin/main` is 4 files, 7 insertions, 6 deletions. In `docs/users/configuration/settings.md` exactly one table row changed — no table reflow, and the trailing "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI." sentence is still present.
3. **Generated schema.** CI runs `npm run generate:settings-schema` and then fails if `packages/vscode-ide-companion/schemas/settings.schema.json` is dirty. **Please treat this PR's CI result as the authoritative check for that gate** — I could not run the generator locally, for the reason below.
4. **Runtime.** Open `/settings`, search "arrow", and confirm the *Arrow Keys Scroll Transcript (Virtualized History)* entry shows the new text. The toggle still behaves identically.

**Disclosure on step 3.** `generate:settings-schema` imports `@qwen-code/qwen-code-core` transitively through `packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts`, and this worktree's only lockfile-matching donor `packages/core/dist` predates `isValidAdvisorMaxUses`, so it aborts with `SyntaxError: The requested module '@qwen-code/qwen-code-core' does not provide an export named 'isValidAdvisorMaxUses'`. A core-only rebuild was attempted and failed on `tsc: command not found` from `scripts/build_package.js`. Rather than hand-edit the generated file blind, I applied the identical string substitution and then **asserted byte-equality** between the JSON `description` value and the TypeScript source string (604 characters, equal). Since the generator emits that string verbatim and the substituted text contains no characters requiring JSON escaping (only ASCII plus the ↑/↓ arrows, both already present in the original), the result is what the generator would produce. CI will confirm.

**Checks actually run** (all on the final commit `4447bdaf8f`):

| Check | Command | Result |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| Prettier (write, then CI-form check) | `npx prettier --check` on the 3 edited prose files | exit 0, "All matched files use Prettier code style!" |
| ESLint on the fix site | `npx eslint packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx` | exit 0, no output |
| Schema string equivalence | asserted `settings.schema.json` description == `settingsSchema.ts` string | equal, 604 chars |
| Entry freshness gate | `handoff.py freshness --remote origin --base main` | `{"status": "fresh"}`, exit 0 |

**Checks skipped, and why:**

- `npm run generate:settings-schema` — could not run; stale borrowed `packages/core/dist` (detail above). CI covers it.
- Typecheck — skipped deliberately. This worktree's `dist` is borrowed and stale, which produces hundreds of pre-existing TS6305/TS2305/TS2339 errors in `packages/cli` unrelated to this change, so a full `tsc` run here would not yield a trustworthy signal. A string-literal and comment change cannot alter types.
- Tests — none added, and none run. This is a docs/comment-only change with no behaviour change, so the red-first-reproduction requirement does not apply. For completeness: `packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.test.ts` asserts only that `arrowKeysScrollTranscript` is defined, boolean, default `false`, `showInDialog` true and `requiresRestart` false — it has **no** `.description` assertion, so this wording change breaks nothing there. `InputPrompt.test.tsx` references the key three times, all behavioural setup with no string or snapshot assertion. There is no vitest drift test comparing the schema to the TypeScript source; the only enforcement is the CI shell step.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Non-UI change to a string literal and a comment; no TUI screenshot taken (would require a working local build). Text before/after:

**Before** (`settingsSchema.ts:1306`, identical in the generated schema and in `settings.md:166`):

> Turn it on only for terminals that cannot report the mouse wheel to the app — macOS Terminal.app is the common case — where a wheel or trackpad scroll arrives as a burst of ↑/↓ key presses and would otherwise silently replace the composer with an older prompt.

**After:**

> Turn it on only for a terminal or multiplexer that does not pass mouse reporting through and turns wheel/trackpad scrolling into ↑/↓ key presses, where that burst of ↑/↓ would otherwise silently replace the composer with an older prompt.

The consequence clause, the "While it is on, use Ctrl+P / Ctrl+N for input history from an empty composer." sentence, and the `settings.md`-only "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI." sentence are all preserved.

**Before** (`InputPrompt.tsx` comment):

> Opt-in only: on a terminal that cannot report the wheel — macOS Terminal.app — the wheel arrives as a burst of ↑/↓ and would rewrite the composer with an older prompt (#10749), so

**After:**

> Opt-in only: on a terminal or multiplexer that does not pass mouse reporting through, the wheel arrives as a burst of ↑/↓ and would rewrite the composer with an older prompt (#10749), so

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux = prettier and eslint only, on the edited files. No runtime or TUI was exercised on any OS, because no local build was possible in this worktree. Nothing here is platform-dependent: the change is a string literal and a comment.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — no runtime executed. Static checks only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: none functional. The only CI-visible risk is the generated-schema drift gate, which I could not execute locally; equivalence was asserted programmatically instead and CI is the authority.
- Not validated / out of scope: no local build, no typecheck, no tests run (reasons above). No TUI screenshot. The two fallback comments inside `InputPrompt.tsx`'s arrow-key handlers still say "a terminal that cannot report the mouse wheel" without naming Terminal.app; they are factually fine and out of scope here, though a future pass could align their phrasing with this one.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No setting renamed, added, removed, or retyped. No default changed. Users who already set `arrowKeysScrollTranscript: true` are unaffected.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14040

Evidence: PR #14016 comment `6139158687` (wenshao, COLLABORATOR, 2026-10-13T05:47:41Z).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

替换 `ui.arrowKeysScrollTranscript` 面向用户的描述里一个错误的具名例子。原文案让用户为「无法把鼠标滚轮上报给应用的终端 — macOS Terminal.app 就是常见情况」打开这个设置。Terminal.app 确实会上报滚轮，所以这条建议把错误的人群引向了这个开关。具名例子被替换为该设置真正针对的条件：不透传鼠标上报、并把滚轮/触控板滚动转成 ↑/↓ 按键的终端或多路复用器。没有给出替代的具名终端，因为没有观测到任何终端是那样表现的。

只改文案。无行为变化，也没有改动该设置的默认值、类型、label、`requiresRestart`、`showInDialog`，或任何读取该标志的代码。

这句话出现在四处。issue 里只列了三处，第四处是范围修正：

1. `packages/cli/src/config/settingsSchema.ts` — `description` 字符串，唯一真源。
2. `packages/vscode-ide-companion/schemas/settings.schema.json` — 由 (1) 生成，不可手改。
3. `docs/users/configuration/settings.md` — **手工维护**，这就是修正点。issue 正文和已有线程评论都称该文件没有提到这个键。实际上第 166 行就有，携带同一句话，外加一句 schema 文案里没有的 "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI."。这句额外内容被原样保留。该文件没有生成器：`scripts/generate-settings-schema.ts` 只有一个 `writeFileSync`，只指向 `settings.schema.json`，且 `settings.md` 出现零次。wenshao 在 #14016 的评论本身就把这四处都列了出来，包含这一处。
4. `packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx` — 派生标志上方的代码注释。`(#10749)` 引用保留，注释仍然解释了这个开关为什么存在，只改终端归属。

已核实不在范围内 — 这些文件提到该键但从未点名 Terminal.app，因此未改动：`docs/users/reference/keyboard-shortcuts.md`、`docs/users/support/troubleshooting.md`、`packages/cli/src/serve/routes/workspace-settings.ts`，以及 `InputPrompt.tsx` 方向键处理内部的另两处 fallback 注释。该键也没有 i18n 镜像（9 个语言文件全部零命中）。

## 为什么需要

具名例子是这条建议的承重部分，而它是可测量地错的。wenshao（COLLABORATOR）在 PR #14016 上直接测量过，评论 id `6139158687`，2026-10-13T05:47:41Z，环境为 Terminal.app 2.15 / macOS 26.6.2（Apple Silicon），qwen 直接跑在窗口里、无 tmux：

- 设置了 `?1002h ?1006h`（正是 qwen 写入的内容）时，Terminal.app 发送 SGR 滚轮事件（`ESC[<64;...M` 上、`ESC[<65;...M` 下）。在 `main`（`21b78c55d5`）、PR head（`da1f4e6c3d`）和 v0.22.3 上表现完全一致。
- 方向键成串出现**只在**应用没有请求鼠标上报、**且**设置了应用光标模式 `?1h` 时。qwen 在这三个版本上都从不设置 `?1h`。
- 关闭 View —> Allow Mouse Reporting 后，Terminal.app 什么都不发。

所以照现有建议去做的 Terminal.app 用户什么也得不到 — 他们的滚轮本来就能通过 SGR 滚动记录 — 反而失去了在空输入框下用裸 ↑/↓ 翻历史的能力。这条建议恰好让它所点名的那批人体验变差。

采用的措辞来自 wenshao，因为他是测量来源。doudouOUC 在线程里给的变体等价；优先用 wenshao 的版本，因为它出自实际跑探针的人，而且单数形式在 schema 描述里读起来更顺。他明确说在自己机器上没有找到任何按文案所说那样表现的终端，这也是不编造替代例子的原因。

## 审阅验证计划

### 如何验证

1. **错误例子已消失。** `git grep -n 'Terminal.app is the common case'` 无输出、退出码 1。本 PR 之前是 3 处命中。`git grep -n 'Terminal\.app' packages/cli/src/ui/components/InputPrompt.tsx` 同样无输出。
2. **没有其他改动。** `git diff --stat origin/main` 为 4 文件、7 增 6 删。`docs/users/configuration/settings.md` 里恰好只有一行表格行变化 — 没有整表重排，末尾那句 "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI." 仍在。
3. **生成的 schema。** CI 会跑 `npm run generate:settings-schema`，若 `settings.schema.json` 变脏则失败。**请把本 PR 的 CI 结果当作该门禁的权威判定** — 我无法在本地运行生成器，原因见下。
4. **运行时。** 打开 `/settings`，搜索 "arrow"，确认 *Arrow Keys Scroll Transcript (Virtualized History)* 显示新文案。开关行为完全不变。

**关于第 3 步的说明。** `generate:settings-schema` 会经由 `packages/cli/src/config/settings.ts` 间接 import `@qwen-code/qwen-code-core`，而本 worktree 中唯一 lockfile 匹配的 donor `packages/core/dist` 早于 `isValidAdvisorMaxUses`，因此报 `SyntaxError` 中止。尝试单独重建 core 失败于 `scripts/build_package.js` 的 `tsc: command not found`。我没有盲改生成文件，而是做了同样的字符串替换，然后**断言字节相等**：JSON 的 `description` 值与 TypeScript 源字符串完全相同（604 字符）。生成器原样输出该字符串，且替换后的文本不含需要 JSON 转义的字符（只有 ASCII 加上原本就存在的 ↑/↓），因此结果与生成器产出一致。CI 会确认。

**实际运行的检查**（均在最终提交 `4447bdaf8f` 上）：prettier `--check` 三个改动文件退出 0；eslint 两个 TS 文件退出 0 无输出；schema 字符串等价断言通过（604 字符相等）；入口 freshness 门禁返回 `{"status": "fresh"}` 退出 0。

**跳过的检查及原因：** `npm run generate:settings-schema` 无法运行（借来的 core dist 过期），由 CI 覆盖；typecheck 主动跳过 — 本 worktree 的 dist 是借来且陈旧的，会在 `packages/cli` 产生数百个与本次改动无关的既存 TS6305/TS2305/TS2339 报错，跑完整 tsc 得不到可信信号，而字符串字面量与注释改动不可能改变类型；测试未新增也未运行 — 纯文档/注释改动无行为变化，不适用「先见红」要求，且 `settingsSchema.test.ts` 对该键只断言存在性/类型/默认值/showInDialog/requiresRestart，**没有** `.description` 断言，`InputPrompt.test.tsx` 三处引用都是行为准备、无字符串或快照断言，仓内也没有比较 schema 与 TS 源的 drift 测试。

### 证据（改动前后）

非 UI 改动，只涉及字符串字面量和注释，未截取 TUI 截图（需要可用的本地构建）。文案前后对照见英文版 Evidence 小节；四处均保留了后果从句、"While it is on, use Ctrl+P / Ctrl+N for input history from an empty composer." 一句，以及 `settings.md` 独有的 "Only applies in the interactive terminal UI." 一句。

### 已测试平台

macOS ⚠️ 未测；Windows ⚠️ 未测；Linux ✅（仅对改动文件跑 prettier 与 eslint）。任何平台上都没有执行运行时或 TUI，因为本 worktree 无法本地构建。本改动不依赖平台。

### 环境

N/A — 未执行运行时，仅静态检查。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：无功能性风险。唯一 CI 可见风险是生成 schema 的 drift 门禁，本地无法执行，改为程序化断言等价，以 CI 为准。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：无本地构建、无 typecheck、未跑测试（原因见上），无 TUI 截图。`InputPrompt.tsx` 方向键处理内部那两处 fallback 注释仍写「无法上报鼠标滚轮的终端」而未点名 Terminal.app，事实上没问题、本次不改，但后续可以统一措辞。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。未重命名、新增、删除或改类型任何设置项，未改默认值。已经设置 `arrowKeysScrollTranscript: true` 的用户不受影响。

Fixes #14040
