prs.title: fix(acp): persist embedded text resources for transcript replay
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Persists bounded, original ACP embedded text `resource` blocks with their owning user prompt and replays them as typed user chunks. The daemon UI SDK now exposes these blocks separately from `resource_link` and native attachments, including offline transcript projection. Native attachment expansions are identified by their input positions, so a separate direct resource remains replayable even when it shares the same URI.

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code already accepts embedded resources as model context, but refresh or restart previously restored only the prompt text. Clients therefore lost the original context selection while the assistant reply remained visible. This closes the persistence/replay gap tracked in #12538; it is separate from the `resource_link` fix in #12088.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Send an ACP prompt with text and a text resource, then a resource-only prompt and a later text-only prompt. Inspect the saved user records and load the transcript: each resource should appear as a typed user chunk on its original prompt with its URI, MIME type, text, metadata, prompt ID, and source-record identity; it must not migrate to the later turn or be fetched by URI. Also check rewind/active-branch replay, native attachments over 256 KiB, a direct resource sharing a native attachment URI, and rejection of an oversized direct text resource before the daemon peer echo. Focused bridge, CLI, persistence, and SDK tests cover these cases.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the new recording/replay regressions failed against the pre-fix source because typed resources were absent after replay. After: the focused tests pass, including resource-only, same-URI coexistence, and daemon pre-echo rejection. No running-daemon or browser recording is claimed here.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ build, bundle, typecheck, targeted lint and tests |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1; package-level test scripts and bundled `dist/cli.js` sanity check. A live ACP daemon session was not run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: directly supplied embedded text resources add bounded user content to durable transcripts; the aggregate serialized replay budget is 256 KiB per prompt. Oversized direct text resources are rejected before live echo. Native attachments use their existing separate storage path; current daemon requests exclude them by provenance. Legacy metadata without positions excludes only unambiguous URI matches; ambiguous blocks are retained and may hit the inline limit.
- Not validated / out of scope: running-daemon JSONL and `session/load` readback after restart, browser refresh acceptance, persistence of inline blob resources, and recovery of resources absent from historical records. Downstream clients must render the new typed SDK field to display a card.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no record migration is required; old records remain readable. A direct ACP prompt above the new text-resource replay limit now returns invalid parameters.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #12538.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将有大小上限的原始 ACP 嵌入式文本 `resource` 块与所属用户 Prompt 一同持久化，并在回放时恢复为带类型的用户消息块。Daemon UI SDK 将其与 `resource_link`、原生附件区分，并支持离线 transcript 投影。原生附件展开结果按输入位置识别，因此即使另一个直接资源与它使用相同 URI，也仍可独立回放。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 已能把嵌入式资源用作模型上下文，但刷新或重启后此前只恢复 Prompt 文字。客户端因此丢失原始上下文引用，尽管助手回复仍可见。本 PR 修复 #12538 的持久化与回放缺口；它不同于 #12088 的 `resource_link` 修复。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

依次发送包含文字和文本资源的 ACP Prompt、纯资源 Prompt、以及后续纯文字 Prompt。检查保存的用户记录与加载后的 transcript：每个资源都应作为带类型的用户消息块保留在原轮次，包含 URI、MIME 类型、文本、元数据、Prompt ID 和来源记录身份；不得迁移到后续轮次，也不得根据 URI 抓取内容。另需检查 rewind/有效分支回放、超过 256 KiB 的原生附件、与原生附件同 URI 的直接资源，以及超限直接文本资源在 Daemon 向其他客户端回显前被拒绝。定向桥接、CLI、持久化和 SDK 测试覆盖这些场景。

### 前后证据

修复前：新增的录制与回放回归测试在旧源码上失败，类型化资源在回放后缺失。修复后：定向测试通过，包括纯资源、同 URI 并存和 Daemon 回显前拒绝。本 PR 未声称完成运行中 Daemon 或浏览器录屏。

### 已测试系统

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 构建、打包、类型检查、定向 lint 与测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境（可选）

Node 22.23.1；包级测试脚本与打包后的 `dist/cli.js` 基础检查。未运行真实 ACP Daemon 会话。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：直接提供的嵌入式文本资源会作为有界的用户内容进入持久 transcript；每个 Prompt 的序列化资源回放预算为 256 KiB。超限直接文本资源在实时回显前被拒绝。原生附件沿用独立存储路径；新 Daemon 请求按来源排除。缺少位置字段的旧元数据只排除 URI 唯一对应的块；歧义块会保留，也可能触及内联限额。
- 未验证／范围外：运行中 Daemon 的 JSONL 与重启后 `session/load` 回读、浏览器刷新验收、内联 blob 资源持久化，以及从未保存资源的旧记录恢复。下游客户端需要渲染新的类型化 SDK 字段才能显示卡片。
- 破坏性变更／迁移：无需记录迁移，旧记录继续可读。超过新文本资源回放上限的直接 ACP Prompt 现在返回参数错误。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/issue-12538-embedded-resource-replay/docs/design/daemon-embedded-resource-replay.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #12538。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): enforce Flyway migration ordering
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Both Flyway CI gates now reject newly added migration versions that are not strictly greater than the highest published version across all scanned Maven modules and both SQL and Java locations. The per-PR gate reads a fetched base snapshot, while the open-PR recheck recomputes the maximum from the current main tree on every run. Existing historical paths remain exempt from the ordering check, and duplicate-version detection retains its existing diagnostics and status names.

Versions are compared numerically by normalized segments, including dot/underscore equivalence, leading zeros, trailing zero segments, and integers beyond JavaScript's safe-number range. An explicitly configured baseline that cannot be read fails the per-PR gate.

## Why it's needed

A unique V58 can currently pass both gates after V64 is already published. That leaves an upgraded database with an unapplied migration below its current version, violating the project's existing migration allocation rule. Uniqueness alone cannot catch this; the check must also compare new versions with the published maximum.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Put published V64 in a Java migration location in one module and add unique SQL V58 in another. Both gates should reject V58 and name V64 as the published maximum. Before this fix, both gates accepted that fixture.
2. Change the candidate to V65: both gates should pass. A duplicate V64 should still fail with the existing collision diagnostic. Unchanged historical migrations should remain valid.
3. Recheck the same V65 PR after main publishes V66: its status should change from success to failure. A known lower version should also fail when the PR file list is incomplete.
4. Confirm numeric segment ordering (V9 < V10, V10_2 < V10_10), large integer ordering, and rejection of normalized version reuse even when the published file is deleted.
5. Run `npm run test:scripts -- scripts/tests/check-flyway-migrations.test.js scripts/tests/check-flyway-open-prs.test.js scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`. The ordering cases can be selected with `-t ordering`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

prs.title: feat(workflow): discover saved workflows within monorepos
prs.body:
## What this PR does Saved workflows can now be shared from the top of a monorepo. A session started in a subdirectory of a Git repository also finds the saved workflows of its parent directories: from `repo/packages/a`, a workflow name resolves to the first match in `repo/packages/a/.qwen/workflows`, `repo/packages/.qwen/workflows`, `repo/.qwen/workflows`, and then `~/.qwen/workflows`. The slash-command list, `workflow('')` inside a script, the Workflow tool, headless and ACP sessions, and the daemon / Web Shell saved-workflow list, detail and run all use the same selection. The search is bounded. It stops at the nearest Git root, including the root of a linked worktree or submodule, so an outer checkout is never searched. It only enters a parent directory the session's host trusts, and it stops at the first parent that is not trusted rather than skipping over it. Trusting the session directory alone does not trust its parents; IDE trust can deny a parent but never grant one; with folder trust turned off every parent up to the repository root is searched. From a parent directory only the `.js` files directly inside its `.qwen/workflows` can be read: no subdirectories, no other files, no symlinked directories or scripts. Each lookup reads the directories and their trust once and uses that one result for listing, name resolution and path loads. When the nearest definition of a name cannot be read, the call fails instead of quietly running a farther copy. Approvals keep the existing name + content-digest rule, and the approval shows the real path the script was loaded from. Saving a workflow still writes to the session's own directory, never to a parent, including for derived configs that inherit a parent session's storage. Trust is always answered by the host. Local sessions (interactive, headless, direct ACP) read the folder-trust rules fresh on every lookup, so a rule revoked or restored by another process applies to the next lookup of a long-running session, and unreadable rules deny every parent. A daemon's ACP child asks its authenticated parent over the existing private channel; the daemon answers from the trust policy it last published for that runtime, so revoking only a parent folder's rule takes effect without a restart, and a removed runtime never falls back to the primary one. Until the parent proves its private capability, and after the connection closes, no parent is trusted. The Web Shell saved-workflow detail now takes the path, tier and script body from a single resolution, so they always describe the same file. The user documentation describes the search order, the trust requirement and the save location. ## Why it's needed In a monorepo, shared workflows naturally live at the repository root, but people usually start sessions inside a package. Until now only the session's own directory and the user directory were searched, so a root-level workflow was invisible from `packages/a` and a same-named user workflow ran instead. The usual fix of copying workflows into every package drifts quickly. This change makes the root definitions available while keeping untrusted directories, outer checkouts and links out of the read set. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. Create a Git repository with `repo/.qwen/workflows/root-only.js` and `repo/.qwen/workflows/shared.js`, a different `repo/packages/.qwen/workflows/shared.js`, and an empty `repo/packages/a`. Put another `shared.js` and a `user-only.js` in `~/.qwen/workflows`. Enable workflows, enable folder trust and trust `repo`. 2. Start a session in `repo/packages/a`. Type `/ro`: `root-only` appears as a project workflow and runs the root script. `/shared` runs the `packages` copy, not the user one. Add `repo/packages/a/.qwen/workflows/shared.js`; the next `/shared` runs that one. 3. Keep `repo/packages/a` trusted but mark `repo` as not trusted (or only trust `repo/packages/a`): `root-only` is gone and `shared` falls back to the user copy. With a long-running session (for example a direct ACP session), change the rule file from outside the session: the next lookup follows the new rule without a restart. 4. Linked worktree or submodule nested inside the repository: workflows that exist only in the outer checkout are not found from inside it. 5. Make `repo/packages/a/.qwen` a symlink to `../../.qwen` while `repo` is not trusted: the root workflows are still not found, and saving a project workflow is refused. A `.qwen` symlink that points inside `repo/packages/a` keeps working. 6. Daemon / Web Shell: run `qwen serve` with two workspaces in two repositories, open a session on the second one, and open Workflows → Saved: the list, the detail path and body, and Run all come from the second workspace's own repository. Revoke only that repository root's trust rule (the workspace stays trusted); after the daemon publishes the new policy the root workflows disappear, and they come back when the rule is restored. Expected: as described. Observed locally: matches. The local evidence includes a baseline bundle, the first fixed bundle and this head-equivalent bundle run through the same headless, direct ACP, TUI (PTY), daemon HTTP and Web Shell (headless Chromium) scenarios against a local mock OpenAI-compatible provider, plus unit tests that fail on the old logic and pass on this change. ### Evidence (Before & After) All captures use an isolated configuration and a local mock provider (no real model). TUI: real PTY rendered at 120×40. Web Shell: real daemon and UI in headless Chromium, 1440×900, light theme; the session is on the daemon's second workspace. Before = base bundle, After = this change. TUI, `/ro` completion from `repo/packages/a` (root trusted): | Before | After | | :-: | :-: | | | | TUI, `/sh` completion — `shared` comes from the user directory before and from the project's parent after: | Before | After | | :-: | :-: | | | | TUI, running `/shared` then `/root-only` (Before: `/root-only` is an unknown command): | Before | After | | :-: | :-: | | | | Web Shell, Workflows → Saved on the second workspace, with the `shared` detail open: | Before | After | | :-: | :-: | | | | Web Shell, after Run from the UI (History shows the completed run of the second workspace's `shared`): | Before | After | | :-: | :-: | | | | ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### Environment (optional) Linux, Node 24.21.0. `npm run build`, `npm run bundle`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and the affected packages' tests were run locally; end-to-end scenarios used the built bundle with an isolated `QWEN_HOME`, a local mock OpenAI-compatible provider, a real PTY for the TUI, a real `qwen serve` daemon, and headless Chromium for the Web Shell. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: with folder trust turned off (the default), every parent directory up to the repository root is searched, so a user whose whole home directory is a Git repository will see workflows from parent `.qwen/workflows` directories inside it. Each lookup in a daemon child makes one small private request to the daemon, bounded by a 2-second timeout that falls back to trusting no parent. - Not validated / out of scope: macOS and Windows; end-to-end runs of relocating a session to another directory and of resume/retry; real model providers; Web Shell in other themes or viewports. Saving to a parent directory (a "nearest existing directory" policy) is intentionally not added. Locally, a few existing tests in memory/sandbox and ACP output fail on the base commit as well and are unrelated to this change. - Breaking changes / migration notes: no settings, permission rule format, stored data or public routes change, and existing approvals keep working. Behavior that becomes stricter: a project `.qwen` that is a symlink to a directory outside the session directory is ignored for reading and refused for saving; a symlinked `.js` or a directory named `.js` is no longer run by name; and when the nearest definition of a name cannot be read the call fails instead of falling back to a farther definition. ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 这个 PR 做了什么 现在可以在 monorepo 的顶层共享 saved workflow。在 Git 仓库子目录里启动的会话，也会查找其上级目录的 saved workflow：从 `repo/packages/a` 启动时，workflow 名依次在 `repo/packages/a/.qwen/workflows`、`repo/packages/.qwen/workflows`、`repo/.qwen/workflows`、`~/.qwen/workflows` 中查找，取第一个匹配。斜杠命令列表、脚本里的 `workflow('')`、Workflow 工具、headless 和 ACP 会话，以及 daemon / Web Shell 的 saved workflow 列表、详情和运行，都使用同一套选择结果。 查找范围是有边界的。它停在最近的 Git 根（包括 linked worktree 或 submodule 自己的根），不会查找外层 checkout。只进入会话宿主信任的上级目录，遇到第一个不信任的上级就停止，不会越过它继续往上。只信任会话目录并不等于信任它的上级；IDE 的信任只能拒绝上级、不能授予；关闭 folder trust 时，会查找到仓库根为止的所有上级。上级目录里只读取其 `.qwen/workflows` 下直接存放的 `.js` 文件：不读子目录、不读其他文件，也不读符号链接的目录或脚本。 每次查找只读取一次目录和信任信息，列表、按名解析和按路径加载都用这一次的结果。如果某个名字最近的定义读不出来，调用直接失败，不会悄悄改跑更远处的同名文件。审批沿用现有的"名称 + 内容摘要"规则，审批界面会显示脚本实际加载的路径。保存 workflow 仍然写到会话自己的目录，不会写到上级目录；继承父会话 storage 的派生 config 也是如此。 信任始终由宿主判断。本地会话（交互式、headless、直接 ACP）每次查找都会重新读取 folder trust 规则，所以其他进程撤销或恢复规则后，长时间运行的会话在下一次查找时就会生效；规则读不出来时，所有上级都不被信任。daemon 的 ACP 子进程通过现有的私有通道向已认证的父进程询问；daemon 用它最近为该 runtime 发布的信任策略来回答，因此只撤销某个上级目录的规则也无需重启即可生效，已移除的 runtime 也不会回退到主 runtime。在父进程证明其私有凭证之前、以及连接关闭之后，不信任任何上级目录。 Web Shell 的 saved workflow 详情现在从同一次解析中取路径、来源层级和脚本内容，保证三者描述的是同一个文件。用户文档补充了查找顺序、信任要求和保存位置。 ## 为什么需要 在 monorepo 里，共享的 workflow 通常放在仓库根，但大家一般是在某个 package 里启动会话。此前只会查找会话自己的目录和用户目录，所以从 `packages/a` 看不到根目录的 workflow，反而会运行用户目录里的同名 workflow。把 workflow 复制到每个 package 的常见做法很快就会出现版本不一致。这个改动让根目录的定义可以直接使用，同时把不可信目录、外层 checkout 和链接都排除在读取范围之外。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 建一个 Git 仓库，放入 `repo/.qwen/workflows/root-only.js` 和 `repo/.qwen/workflows/shared.js`，另放一个内容不同的 `repo/packages/.qwen/workflows/shared.js`，以及一个空的 `repo/packages/a`。在 `~/.qwen/workflows` 里再放一个 `shared.js` 和一个 `user-only.js`。启用 workflows、启用 folder trust，并信任 `repo`。 2. 在 `repo/packages/a` 启动会话。输入 `/ro`：`root-only` 显示为项目 workflow，运行的是根目录的脚本。`/shared` 运行的是 `packages` 下的版本，而不是用户目录的版本。新增 `repo/packages/a/.qwen/workflows/shared.js` 后，下一次 `/shared` 运行的就是它。 3. 保持 `repo/packages/a` 被信任，但把 `repo` 设为不信任（或只信任 `repo/packages/a`）：`root-only` 消失，`shared` 回落到用户目录的版本。对一个长时间运行的会话（例如直接 ACP 会话），在会话外部修改规则文件：下一次查找即遵循新规则，无需重启。 4. 嵌套在仓库内的 linked worktree 或 submodule：只存在于外层 checkout 的 workflow，从内部找不到。 5. 在 `repo` 不被信任时，把 `repo/packages/a/.qwen` 做成指向 `../../.qwen` 的符号链接：根目录的 workflow 仍然找不到，保存项目 workflow 会被拒绝。指向 `repo/packages/a` 内部的 `.qwen` 符号链接仍然可用。 6. Daemon / Web Shell：用两个分属不同仓库的 workspace 运行 `qwen serve`，在第二个 workspace 上打开会话，进入 Workflows → Saved：列表、详情里的路径和内容、Run 都来自第二个 workspace 自己的仓库。只撤销该仓库根的信任规则（workspace 本身仍被信任）；daemon 发布新策略后，根目录的 workflow 消失，恢复规则后重新出现。 预期：如上所述。本地观察：一致。本地证据包括基线 bundle、第一版修复 bundle 和与本 head 等价的 bundle，三者跑同一组场景——headless、直接 ACP、TUI（PTY）、daemon HTTP 和 Web Shell（无头 Chromium），模型侧使用本地 mock 的 OpenAI 兼容服务；另外还有在旧逻辑上失败、在本改动上通过的单元测试。 ### 证据（改动前后对比） 所有截图都使用隔离配置和本地 mock 服务（没有真实模型）。TUI：真实 PTY，120×40 渲染。Web Shell：真实 daemon 和 UI，无头 Chromium，1440×900，浅色主题；会话位于 daemon 的第二个 workspace。改动前 = 基线 bundle，改动后 = 本改动。 TUI，从 `repo/packages/a`（根目录被信任）输入 `/ro` 的补全： | 改动前 | 改动后 | | :-: | :-: | | | | TUI，`/sh` 补全——改动前 `shared` 来自用户目录，改动后来自项目的上级目录： | 改动前 | 改动后 | | :-: | :-: | | | | TUI，依次运行 `/shared` 和 `/root-only`（改动前 `/root-only` 是未知命令）： | 改动前 | 改动后 | | :-: | :-: | | | | Web Shell，第二个 workspace 的 Workflows → Saved，展开 `shared` 详情： | 改动前 | 改动后 | | :-: | :-: | | | | Web Shell，从 UI 点击 Run 之后（History 显示第二个 workspace 的 `shared` 已完成）： | 改动前 | 改动后 | | :-: | :-: | | | | ### 测试平台 | OS | 状态 | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ | ### 环境（可选） Linux，Node 24.21.0。本地运行了 `npm run build`、`npm run bundle`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint` 以及受影响 package 的测试；端到端场景使用构建出的 bundle，配合隔离的 `QWEN_HOME`、本地 mock 的 OpenAI 兼容服务、TUI 用真实 PTY、真实的 `qwen serve` daemon，以及运行 Web Shell 的无头 Chromium。 ## 风险与范围 - 主要风险或取舍：关闭 folder trust（默认关闭）时，会查找到仓库根为止的所有上级目录，因此如果用户把整个 home 目录作为 Git 仓库，会看到其中各级上级 `.qwen/workflows` 的 workflow。daemon 子进程每次查找会向 daemon 发一个很小的私有请求，最多等待 2 秒，超时则不信任任何上级。 - 未验证 / 不在范围内：macOS 和 Windows；会话切换目录（relocate）以及 resume/retry 的端到端运行；真实模型服务；Web Shell 的其他主题和视口。有意不增加"保存到最近已有的上级目录"这类策略。本地有少量既有的 memory/sandbox 和 ACP output 测试在基线提交上同样失败，与本改动无关。 - 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：设置、权限规则格式、存储数据和公开路由都没有变化，已有审批继续有效。变得更严格的行为：项目 `.qwen` 如果是指向会话目录之外的符号链接，读取时忽略、保存时拒绝；符号链接的 `.js`，或名为 `.js` 的目录，不再能按名字运行；某个名字最近的定义读不出来时，调用直接失败，不再回落到更远的定义。 ## 关联 Issue 无。

prs.title: fix(ci): raise the Hosted MySQL fork and step budgets past the L4 class (#14125)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Raises the three linked CI budgets of the `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` job in the SDK Java workflow: the `hosted-harness-mysql` failsafe fork timeout goes from 1200 s to 1800 s, the `Verify Hosted Java, Spring and MySQL processes` step ceiling from 35 to 45 minutes, and the job ceiling from 210 to 220 minutes. The literal pins and explanatory comments in `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` move with them, keeping the deliberate-raise checkpoint the house style requires.

## Why it's needed

Main CI run 38484914390 failed that step on commit `163e4686191d` and the failure analyzer could not name a single failing test, so it filed the per-commit issue #14125. That signature means the run died before failsafe could report per-test results — a step or fork timeout kill. The fork's 1200 s budget was last sized for the FG7 channel classes (#13839); `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT` (#14039) then added four cuts to the same shared fork that each boot a real Spring, the packaged Harness and a durable worker, roughly 300 s of healthy wall-clock the FG7 sizing never covered. With the fork's healthy runtime at ≈ the cap, an ordinarily contended main runner crosses it and the kill leaves no per-test lines — the same undiagnosable pattern previously seen in #13503 and #13684. A deterministic build break is excluded because the identical tree passed this same job on PR #14108.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the three budgets form the pinned ordering: the fork is 1800 s in the `hosted-harness-mysql` profile of `packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml`, the Verify step is 45 min (45×60 ≥ 1800 + 600 wrap), the job is 220 min (step ceilings sum to 205, plus ~13 min of uncapped setup), and `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` passes: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`. The real gate is the next green `SDK Java` run on main after merge: the Verify step should complete with per-test results instead of dying silent.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI budget change, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Linux runner without Java/Maven/MySQL, so the hosted MySQL lane itself could not be re-run locally; verification is the repository's own CI-shape guard tests (102 passed across the three workflow-parsing suites), mutation probes on both budget values (each probe reddened the pins as required), plus `npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm run lint`, all green.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely hung fork now burns up to 30 minutes instead of 20 before failsafe kills it, and the job ceiling rises 10 minutes to match; healthy runtimes are unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: the hosted MySQL lane was not re-run locally (no Java/Maven/MySQL on the authoring runner); CI after merge is the final gate.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14125

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

上调 SDK Java 工作流中 `Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21` 作业的三个关联 CI 预算:`hosted-harness-mysql` 的 failsafe fork 超时从 1200 秒提到 1800 秒,`Verify Hosted Java, Spring and MySQL processes` 步骤上限从 35 分钟提到 45 分钟,作业上限从 210 分钟提到 220 分钟。`scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 中的字面钉值和说明注释同步更新,保留了仓库规范要求的"有意调整必须留痕"检查点。

## 为什么需要

main 上的 CI 运行 38484914390 在提交 `163e4686191d` 上失败了该步骤,失败分析器无法指出任何具体失败的测试,只能按提交登记 issue #14125。这个特征说明运行在 failsafe 报告逐条测试结果之前就被杀死——步骤或 fork 超时被杀。fork 的 1200 秒预算上一次是为 FG7 通道类校准的(#13839);此后 `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT`(#14039)向同一个共享 fork 增加了四个用例,每个都要启动真实的 Spring、打包的 Harness 和一个持久 worker,约 300 秒健康墙钟从未被 FG7 的校准覆盖。fork 的健康运行时间逼近上限后,普通负载的 main runner 就会越过它,而杀死不会留下任何逐条测试行——这正是 #13503 和 #13684 出现过的无法诊断的模式。确定性的构建失败可以排除,因为同一棵树在 PR #14108 上通过了同一个作业。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认三个预算构成被钉住的顺序关系:`packages/sdk-java/managed-agent-server/pom.xml` 的 `hosted-harness-mysql` profile 中 fork 为 1800 秒;Verify 步骤为 45 分钟(45×60 ≥ 1800 + 600 秒包装工作);作业为 220 分钟(步骤上限之和为 205,外加约 13 分钟不计上限的准备工作);并且 `scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js` 通过:`npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/hosted-process-ci.test.js`。真正的关卡是合并后 main 上下一次绿色的 `SDK Java` 运行:Verify 步骤应当正常跑完并报告逐条测试结果,而不是无声无息地被杀。

### 前后对比证据

N/A —— CI 预算调整,无用户可见行为变化。

### 测试平台

|     操作系统     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境(可选)

编写所用的 Linux runner 没有 Java/Maven/MySQL,因此无法在本地重跑 Hosted MySQL 通道;验证依赖仓库自带的 CI 结构守卫测试(三个工作流解析套件共 102 个通过)、对两个预算值的变异探针(每个探针都按要求让钉值变红),以及 `npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint`,全部为绿。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:真正挂死的 fork 现在最长会消耗 30 分钟(原来 20 分钟)才会被 failsafe 杀死,作业上限相应提高 10 分钟;健康运行时间不变。
- 未验证 / 范围外:Hosted MySQL 通道未在本地重跑(编写 runner 上没有 Java/Maven/MySQL);合并后的 CI 是最终关卡。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14125

prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(cli): show Goal objectives in session names
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Goal-only sessions use their current objective as a fallback name in Web Shell catalogs and Goals links, ACP session lists, `@session:` completion, and the human CLI session table. Custom titles and ordinary prompts keep their existing priority. Editing or clearing a Goal refreshes the browser's name, and older refresh responses cannot restore an obsolete objective.

## Why it's needed

Starting a new chat with `/goal Write release notes` does not send an ordinary prompt. The earlier fix for #10265 made these sessions recognizable in `/resume`, but intentionally deferred the other name consumers. Those consumers still showed a short ID, a full UUID, or a blank title. This completes that documented follow-up without writing synthetic prompts or persisting the objective as a custom title.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start a fresh Web Shell chat with `/goal Write release notes`. Confirm the sidebar, current chat heading, and Goals page session link display the objective automatically.
2. Edit the objective, then clear the Goal. Confirm the labels update and the old objective disappears; a delayed edit-name response must not restore it after clear.
3. In separate chats, send an ordinary prompt first or manually rename a Goal session. Confirm those names survive Goal edits and clear.
4. Restart the daemon against the same runtime directory. Confirm persisted Goal-only sessions remain recognizable. Confirm the CLI table, ACP list, and `@session:` suggestions use the same fallback priority.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Surface | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Goal-only sidebar | Short session ID | Current objective |
| Goals session link | Full session UUID | Current objective |
| Human CLI TITLE | Blank | Current objective |
| Goal edit/clear | Old objective can remain in browser | Name updates; clear removes the fallback |

After (final local bundle, same fixture):

![After sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/83f54568c618596660a45a9d87eea9e91ab55854/goal-session-names/after-sidebar.jpg)

</details>

<details>
<summary>Goals session link: before / after</summary>

After (final local bundle, same fixture):

![After goals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/83f54568c618596660a45a9d87eea9e91ab55854/goal-session-names/after-goals.jpg)

</details>

The same isolated session was captured before and after; all shown content is synthetic test data. Final browser E2E passed creation, editing, clearing, prompt/manual precedence, persistence and offline CLI listing. The full E2E report is posted separately below.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.22.2, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, isolated home/workspace/runtime, and a deterministic local OpenAI-compatible provider. Focused package regressions cover persisted/live catalog merges, precedence, clear, ACP preview preservation, completion search, terminal sanitization, runtime-generation closure, catalog revision updates, browser headers, and out-of-order reads.

Validation: build, full typecheck, format and strict lint passed. Focused checks passed 1,092 test cases, and the full Web Shell suite passed 11,702 tests. The full `npm run preflight` completed with exit 1: workspace suites recorded 102,521 passed, 10 failed and 181 skipped tests, plus one cleanup-suite failure and six CLI worker RPC errors. Supplemental scripts recorded 2,962 passed / 3 failed / 75 skipped; the separately completed serve fast-path bundle gate passed.

An independently built, unmodified checkout at the same upstream base reproduced the background-publication 409, macOS worktree-path ENOENT, and Windows-style Git commit-tracking failures, plus other HTTP-server failures. Other full-run failures passed the isolated baseline reruns, including all three failing script cases. The full local gate remains marked failed; the separate E2E report records the exact comparison rather than treating it as green.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Goals without a live title use a bounded persisted title/prompt lookup in their existing live Goal probe; the captured runtime-generation guard remains in place. Goal name changes refresh the active browser title and catalog.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows/Linux manual UI verification; first ordinary prompts arriving after the session catalog's existing ten-record scan window; branch-generated titles. This PR preserves the current bounded prompt extraction rather than expanding transcript reads.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Session transcript and JSON list formats are unchanged; the human table alone gains the Goal fallback.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #10265 and #10295, specifically the [deferred name-consumer discussion](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/10295#discussion_r3873484491). The original issue is already closed by the `/resume` fix; this PR completes its documented follow-up.

验证：构建、全仓类型检查、格式化和严格 lint 通过。定向检查通过 1,092 项测试，Web Shell 全量通过 11,702 项测试。完整 `npm run preflight` 已执行结束，退出码为 1：workspace 测试共 102,521 通过、10 失败、181 跳过，另有一项清理 suite 失败和六项 CLI worker RPC 错误。补充 scripts 检查为 2,962 通过 / 3 失败 / 75 跳过；单独补跑的 serve 快速路径 bundle 检查通过。

prs.title: fix(ci): distinguish missing logs from missing test results
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Makes main-branch CI failure reports distinguish missing evidence from a failure that happened before tests ran. New reports include the number of available failed-job logs, and reports grouped by test refresh that count when a recurrence is recorded.

## Why it's needed

A failed log download removes the log file before analysis. When no test identity can be extracted, the report currently asserts that the run failed before any test result was reported. That assertion is unsupported when the logs are unavailable, and is also wrong when downloaded output contains test results without a recognized failure identifier. This can send maintainers and the autofix worker toward the wrong diagnosis. This addresses the log-availability finding in #11115.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Give the report helper one known failed job and no downloaded logs, then generate the issue plan. Expect the job, failing step and run link to remain, a `0 of 1` incomplete-coverage note, and no claim that tests never ran. Repeat with a downloaded log that contains test results but no recognized failure: expect `1 of 1` coverage and the same diagnostic uncertainty.

With a recognized failure and one missing matrix-job log, expect `1 of 2` coverage while retaining the exact failing-test identity and dedupe marker. Record a later test-keyed recurrence with both logs available: expect one refreshed coverage line, preserved investigation notes and both run records.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI reporting only, no product UI change. Verification uses real child Node processes, input files and the production analysis-to-plan CLI, with no mocks added.

- Before: all five new regression checks fail against the unmodified production helper.
- After: all five pass; independent reproduction and four CLI scenarios also pass.
- Existing workflow contract tests: 17 passed.
- Full helper suite on Windows: 53 passed, 4 failed, 4 skipped. The same four Flyway Windows path-encoding failures occurred before and after the fix; skipped cases are existing Linux-only coverage. This suite is not reported as fully passing.
- Full `npm run preflight`: **not green**. Clean, frozen install, format, lint, build and typecheck completed. Workspace tests reported Windows `EPERM` symlink errors in ACP bridge and Chrome extension, a CLI `ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED` rejection, and failures in core, Node REPL and Live. Remaining workspace tests were stopped after those failures; the script-test and final fast-path stages were not reached. The full monorepo failures were not all rechecked on an unmodified baseline. These workspace modules are unchanged by this patch.
- Hosted CI currently requires maintainer action (`action_required`). This PR remains a draft pending CI validation.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ |
| Windows | ✅ |
| Linux | ⚠️ |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node.js 24.15.0, pinned pnpm 11.24.0. Auxiliary CLI verification only; no provider credentials, actual failed network download or GitHub-hosted reporting run was exercised.

## Risk & Scope

- Test identities, issue matching and recurrence limits keep their existing behavior. Log coverage describes available evidence, not whether a test was executed.
- Existing per-commit bodies retain their preservation contract; rerunning that commit does not rewrite old issue prose or its original coverage snapshot.
- The separate latency-guard finding in #11115 is outside this patch. No dependency or permission change.

## AI Assistance

Codex assisted investigation, implementation and validation. Two separate Codex agents reproduced the issue and reviewed the change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #11115 (log-availability finding only; the umbrella issue remains open).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

让主分支 CI 失败报告区分日志缺失与测试运行前失败。新报告记录实际拿到多少份失败任务日志；按测试分组的报告在记录再次失败时更新这个数量。

## 为什么需要

日志下载失败后，工作流会删除对应文件。目前分析没有识别出失败测试时，报告会声称任务在输出测试结果前失败。日志不可用时没有证据支持这个判断；如果日志中已有测试结果但没有可识别的失败标识，这个判断同样不正确。这会误导维护者和自动修复程序。本次解决 #11115 中的日志可用性问题。

## 审查者验证计划

### 如何验证

向报告工具提供一个已知失败任务，不提供下载日志，然后生成 issue 计划。预期保留任务、失败步骤和运行链接，显示 `0 of 1` 日志覆盖不完整，并且不声称测试没有运行。再提供包含测试结果但没有可识别失败标识的日志，预期显示 `1 of 1`，仍明确不能据此判断测试是否运行。

提供一个可识别的失败及另一个缺少日志的矩阵任务，预期显示 `1 of 2`，保留准确的测试身份和去重标记。随后为同一个失败提供两份日志并记录再次失败，预期覆盖数量只出现一次且已更新，人工调查备注和两次运行记录均保留。

### 前后证据

不适用——仅修改 CI 报告，没有产品界面变化。验证调用真实 Node 子进程、输入文件和生产分析到计划生成命令，没有新增 mock。

- 修复前：五项新增回归检查在未修改的生产辅助脚本上全部失败。
- 修复后：五项全部通过；独立复现和四种 CLI 输入情况也均通过。
- 原有工作流契约测试：17 项通过。
- Windows 完整辅助脚本测试：53 项通过、4 项失败、4 项跳过。相同的四项 Flyway Windows 路径编码失败在修复前后均出现；跳过项是原有仅在 Linux 运行的覆盖。没有把这个测试集报告为全部通过。
- 完整 `npm run preflight` **未通过**。清理、锁定依赖安装、格式、lint、构建和类型检查均已完成。工作区测试报告了 ACP bridge 和 Chrome extension 的 Windows `EPERM` 符号链接错误、CLI 的 `ERR_IPC_CHANNEL_CLOSED` 错误，以及 core、Node REPL、Live 的失败。确认这些失败后停止了剩余工作区测试；脚本测试和最后的 fast-path 检查没有执行。没有逐项在未修改的基线上复核所有全仓库失败。这些工作区模块没有被本次补丁修改。
- 托管 CI 当前需要维护者操作（`action_required`）。PR 保持草稿，等待 CI 验证。

### 测试系统

Windows 已验证；macOS 和 Linux 未在本地验证。

### 环境

Windows、Node.js 24.15.0、锁定的 pnpm 11.24.0。只验证辅助 CLI；没有使用模型凭据，没有实际触发网络下载失败，也没有运行 GitHub 托管的报告工作流。

## 风险与范围

- 测试身份、issue 匹配和再次失败记录的数量限制保持原有行为。日志覆盖数量描述可用证据，不代表测试是否执行。
- 原有按 commit 跟踪的正文保留规则仍有效；同一个 commit 再次运行不会改写旧正文或最初的覆盖数量。
- #11115 中独立的延迟保护问题不属于本次补丁。不改依赖或权限。

## AI 辅助

Codex 协助调查、实现和验证；另两个 Codex Agent 分别复现问题和审查代码。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #11115 的日志可用性问题；保留该汇总 issue 为开放状态。

</details>

prs.title: test(serve): widen hosted recovery waitFor windows for CI contention (#14101)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Widens the state-polling windows in two Hosted Harness no-tool session tests from vitest's implicit 1000 ms `vi.waitFor` default to an explicit 10 s, with a comment on each naming the issue and the mechanism. No assertions were added, removed, or weakened, and no production code changed.

## Why it's needed

Main-branch CI failed on these two tests in run 38410683888 (`Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`). Both tests wait for recovery state that settles across fsync-backed journal commits — parking an admitted prompt after a model-request-preparation failure, and settling an interrupted channel turn while retaining cleanup debt — with a supertest HTTP round-trip per poll. Vitest's default `waitFor` window is only 1 s, which a loaded shared runner running the main-branch coverage-instrumented job can exhaust before the state lands, producing a `Timed out in waitFor!` flake rather than a real defect. This is the same contention class fixed the same day in #14084/#14091, which widened a sibling hosted wait from 5 s to 10 s for the same reason; this change brings the two remaining bare waits in line with that precedent and with the other waits in the same file that already use explicit 10 s windows.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the diff touches only the two failing tests' `vi.waitFor` calls and only adds `{ timeout: 10_000 }` plus a comment — every assertion is unchanged. Then run the tests: `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t "Hosted Harness no-tool session"` should pass all 284 tests, and the two named tests (`parks an admitted prompt when model request preparation fails`, `retains cleanup debt after interrupted channel settlement until original-owner release succeeds`) pass individually. Expected: green before and after locally — the flake is contention-dependent and did not reproduce on an unloaded machine, even with `CI=true QWEN_CI_COVERAGE=1`; the fix removes the narrow window instead of changing observable behavior. The CI rerun on this PR is the meaningful gate.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — test-only timing change, no user-visible behavior.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

<!-- ✅ tested · ⚠️ not tested · N/A -->

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only (`npm run build`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, and focused Vitest runs all pass).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a genuinely stuck recovery path now takes up to 10 s instead of 1 s to fail these two tests; that matches the explicit windows already used throughout the rest of the file.
- Not validated / out of scope: the other bare `vi.waitFor` calls in the file were left as-is; only the two tests observed failing in CI were widened, keeping the change minimal. CI, Docker, and platform-specific behavior beyond the Linux unit-test job is out of scope.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14101

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

将两个 Hosted Harness no-tool session 测试中的状态轮询窗口,从 vitest 默认的隐式 1000 毫秒 `vi.waitFor` 超时放宽为显式的 10 秒,并在每处添加注释注明对应 issue 和机制。未新增、删除或削弱任何断言,也未改动任何生产代码。

## 为什么需要

主分支 CI 在 run 38410683888(`Test (ubuntu-latest, Node 22.x)`)中这两个测试失败。两个测试等待的恢复状态需要跨越基于 fsync 的 journal 提交才能就绪——模型请求准备失败后挂起已准入的 prompt,以及在保留清理债务的同时结算被中断的 channel turn——且每次轮询都包含一次 supertest HTTP 往返。vitest 的 `waitFor` 默认窗口只有 1 秒,在负载较高、且运行主分支覆盖率插桩任务的共享 runner 上,状态可能还未就绪窗口就已耗尽,从而产生 `Timed out in waitFor!` 的偶发失败,而非真实缺陷。这与当天 #14084/#14091 修复的问题同属一类,该修复出于同样原因把同类 hosted 等待从 5 秒放宽到 10 秒;本改动让文件中仅剩的两处裸等待与该先例以及同文件中其他已使用显式 10 秒窗口的等待保持一致。

## 评审者测试计划

### 如何验证

确认 diff 只触及两个失败测试的 `vi.waitFor` 调用,且仅添加了 `{ timeout: 10_000 }` 和注释——所有断言均未改动。然后运行测试:`cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/hosted-harness-session.test.ts -t "Hosted Harness no-tool session"` 应通过全部 284 个测试,且两个具名测试(`parks an admitted prompt when model request preparation fails`、`retains cleanup debt after interrupted channel settlement until original-owner release succeeds`)单独运行也通过。预期:本地在修复前后均为绿色——该偶发故障依赖负载争抢,即使在 `CI=true QWEN_CI_COVERAGE=1` 下也无法在空载机器上复现;本修复收窄的是超时窗口本身,不改变可观察行为。本 PR 的 CI 重跑才是有意义的门禁。

### 前后对比证据

N/A —— 仅测试超时时长改动,无用户可见行为。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS   |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux   |  ✅  |

### 环境(可选)

N/A —— 仅单元测试(`npm run build`、`npm run typecheck`、`npm run lint` 及相关 Vitest 运行均已通过)。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍:若恢复路径真的卡死,这两个测试现在需要最多 10 秒(而非 1 秒)才会失败;这与文件中其余地方已使用的显式窗口一致。
- 未验证 / 超出范围:文件中其余裸 `vi.waitFor` 调用保持不变;只放宽了 CI 中实际观测到失败的两个测试,以保持改动最小。Linux 单元测试任务之外的 CI、Docker 和平台特定行为超出范围。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明:无。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #14101

</details>

## What this PR does Condenses the README evaluation section to a short benchmark summary, a compact purple line chart, and a link to complete results and configuration in English and Chinese. All reported scores and evaluation settings remain unchanged. The chart retains release order and exact score labels, supports system light/dark themes, and explicitly labels its wider 70%–80% vertical axis. ## Why it's needed The expanded configuration table, score table, and tall chart dominate the README. The original 76%–78% axis also makes a 1.40 percentage point spread look much larger. The new presentation keeps the overview readable and preserves detailed evidence one click away. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify - Read the evaluation section: it should contain one summary, one compact line chart, and a details link, with no expanded tables. - Follow the details link and switch languages: both versions should retain the same seven releases, all 28 metric values, and every original evaluation setting. - Check the chart at desktop and narrow widths and with system light/dark themes: all seven points, scores, and version labels should be present, with a clearly stated 70%–80% scale. The full table is available for exact lookup. ### Evidence (Before & After) Local Chrome Markdown previews at 960px and 390px in light/dark themes showed no page overflow; SVG text bounds showed no overlap or clipping. At 960px, the evaluation section decreased from about 1,204px to 391px (about 68%). These measurements are from a local GitHub-style preview, not a capture of GitHub's rendered README. | Previous chart | Updated chart | | --- | --- | | | | Source-to-document checks confirmed every metric and configuration value was preserved. Source-to-SVG checks confirmed all seven plotted coordinates and labels. Local relative links, SVG XML, scoped Prettier 3.5.3 formatting, and `git diff --check` passed. Two full-diff self-audit passes were clean. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :---: | --- | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local Chrome rendering and documentation/data checks | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested | ### Environment (optional) Local Chrome with bundled Node.js tooling. Build and typecheck were attempted but could not start: checkout dependencies (`cross-env`) and `npm` are unavailable. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the line chart uses a focused axis; its 70%–80% range is explicit in the subtitle and tick labels. - Not validated / out of scope: no new benchmark runs, CLI behavior changes, or CLI E2E testing. GitHub's hosted rendering was not captured locally. - Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing evaluation heading and chart path are retained. prs.title: feat(web-shell): open context details in the side panel from the ring
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Clicking the context ring in the Web Shell composer used to post a "Context Usage" card into the conversation, and the detail action on that card posted a second one. This PR points both at the details surface the app already has: the context usage tab in the right panel, which is keyed per session and replaces itself rather than stacking.

Hover is unchanged and still shows the summary. The popover keeps its own detail action, because keyboard and touch users have no hover. Typing `/context` or `/context detail` still prints into the transcript, since that is an explicit request to put it there.

One composer keeps the old behavior on purpose: the embedded side-task pane already lives inside the right panel and has nowhere to open a tab, so its ring still posts a snapshot into its own conversation. That is also the only case where the hover popover still says a click will show the breakdown in the conversation — everywhere else that sentence would now be false, so it is suppressed rather than reworded, and no new copy was needed.

## Why it's needed

Context usage is a status check, not conversation content. Posting it into the transcript interleaves near-identical cards with real conversation, each frozen at a different moment, so older cards keep showing numbers that are no longer true. Each click also pulled the view back to the tail, which is disruptive when the user is reading earlier output. And because hover already showed the summary, the click was repeating it in a second place instead of going one level deeper.

An anchored popover or dialog was considered and rejected. A full breakdown in a toolbar-anchored popover needs collision, scroll and focus-trap work, and a dialog has to go through the portal root. Either way the app would carry two details surfaces for the same data unless the existing panel were removed as well.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open a Web Shell session whose model reports context usage, and wait for the ring to appear next to the send button.
2. Hover the ring. Expect the same summary as before — percentage, used, context window, remaining, plus Compress and View details — and expect the line "Click to view the breakdown in the conversation." to be gone.
3. Click the ring. Expect the right panel to open on a Context Usage tab with the full per-category breakdown, and expect no card in the conversation.
4. Click the ring two or three more times. Expect exactly one Context Usage tab and still no cards.
5. Expand and collapse categories in the panel, and use its Refresh and Compress context controls.
6. Type `/context` and send. Expect a snapshot card in the transcript, as before.
7. Type `/context detail` and send. Expect a card with the per-item breakdown.
8. On the card from step 6, click View details. Expect the panel to open and no second card to appear.
9. Open a side task from the right panel and hover its own ring. Expect the conversation hint to still be there, and a click to still post a snapshot inside that pane.
10. On a phone-width viewport, tap the ring. Expect the panel directly, since there is no hover.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a ring click appended one "Context Usage" card, and View details on it appended a second. The existing browser spec pinned that literally — one card after the click, two after View details, with the context reads going summary then detail. That assertion is what this PR rewrites.

After: the same click opens the side panel, the transcript card count stays at zero, and a second click reuses the one existing tab instead of stacking a copy, with a single detail read across both clicks. The rewritten spec asserts all of that.

Before and after screenshots are produced by running the same browser spec on the base commit and on this branch. Their local paths are listed in the E2E report comment on this PR; the GitHub CLI cannot upload images, so they still need to be dragged into the thread manually.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment

macOS, Node v22.22.2, base `d28bc60d73`. Local gates: build pass, typecheck pass, lint pass, prettier check pass on every changed file, 438 unit tests pass for the composer / popover / pane, 1157 pass for the app, and both context browser specs pass under the repository's own Playwright config, unmodified — 7 tests, 31.5s.

One local caveat, recorded for provenance and now resolved: the pinned Playwright initially wanted `chromium_headless_shell-1228` and `ffmpeg-1011`, which this machine's cache lacked, and the network was too slow to refill it synchronously. The first browser runs therefore went through a throwaway git-ignored config that changed only the browser channel to the installed Google Chrome and disabled video and trace. The pinned browsers finished downloading in the background afterwards, and both specs were then re-run under the repository's own config with no override at all. That unmodified run is the one this PR rests on; the earlier channel-substituted runs found the same results, including the race described below.

The browser run caught one real defect in my first attempt, which is worth recording. It opened the panel, closed it, and then measured the transcript card's overflow. Light failed with a 133px overflow while dark passed — same code, different outcome, so a race against the chat column animating back to full width. Fixed by restoring the original ordering, so every card measurement happens before the panel is ever opened.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a host that supplies its own context-usage open callback now also receives ring clicks and transcript card detail clicks, where before those produced a local snapshot. The package README and the callback design doc both stated the opposite, and both are updated here in English and Chinese.
- Known limitation, deliberately not fixed here: reopening an already-open panel does not refetch. The panel is a persistent surface with its own Refresh control, like a file preview, so clicking its opener again focuses it rather than reloading it. A follow-up could refresh on reopen, or make the click toggle the panel closed.
- Not validated / out of scope: the compact status bar's own context indicator still posts a card, but the app renders that bar compact, which hides the button, so it is not reachable from the surface this issue is about. Touch has no automated coverage — the mobile projects only run mobile specs, and no context ring mobile spec exists.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for the default app. For embedding hosts, see the first bullet.

Design doc: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-context-ring-opens-panel/docs/design/2026-10-13-web-shell-context-ring-details.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-context-ring-opens-panel/docs/design/2026-10-13-web-shell-context-ring-details.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #14051

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

在 Web Shell 输入框里点击上下文圆环，原本会往对话中插入一张「Context Usage」卡片，而卡片上的详情入口又会插入第二张。本 PR 把这两个入口都指向应用里已经存在的详情界面：右侧面板的上下文用量标签页。它按会话区分，遇到同 id 是替换而不是追加。

悬停行为不变，仍然展示摘要。弹层保留自己的详情入口，因为键盘和触屏用户没有悬停。手动输入 `/context` 或 `/context detail` 仍然输出到对话记录，因为那是用户明确要求放在那里的。

有一处是有意保留旧行为的：内嵌的 side-task 面板本身就在右侧面板里，没有地方再开一个标签页，所以它的圆环仍会在自己的对话中生成快照。也只有这种情况，悬停弹层才会继续提示「点击在对话中查看上下文组成」——在别处这句话现在是不成立的，所以直接不显示，而不是改写文案，因此不需要新增任何文案。

## 为什么需要

上下文用量是状态查询，不是对话内容。把它插进对话记录，会让几乎相同的卡片和真正的对话穿插在一起，每张都冻结在不同时刻，于是旧卡片会一直显示已经不对的数字。每次点击还会把视图拉回末尾，用户正在看前面的输出时会被打断。而且悬停已经展示了摘要，点击只是把同样的内容换个地方再说一遍，没有进入下一层。

也考虑过锚定弹层和对话框，最后否决了：把完整明细放进锚定在工具栏上的弹层，需要处理碰撞、滚动和焦点陷阱；做成对话框则必须走 portal root。两种方式都会让同一份数据存在两个详情界面，除非把现有面板也删掉。

## 审查测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 打开一个模型会上报上下文用量的 Web Shell 会话，等发送按钮旁边出现圆环。
2. 悬停圆环。预期和以前一样的摘要——百分比、已用、上下文窗口、剩余，外加压缩和查看明细——并且「Click to view the breakdown in the conversation.」这行消失。
3. 点击圆环。预期右侧面板打开一个 Context Usage 标签页，展示完整的逐分类明细，并且对话中不出现卡片。
4. 再点两三次圆环。预期始终只有一个 Context Usage 标签页，仍然没有卡片。
5. 在面板里展开和收起各分类，使用它的刷新和压缩上下文控件。
6. 输入 `/context` 并发送。预期和以前一样在对话中出现快照卡片。
7. 输入 `/context detail` 并发送。预期出现带逐项明细的卡片。
8. 在第 6 步的卡片上点击查看明细。预期面板打开，并且不出现第二张卡片。
9. 从右侧面板打开一个 side task，悬停它自己的圆环。预期关于对话的提示仍然存在，点击仍会在该面板内生成快照。
10. 在手机宽度的视口下轻点圆环。预期直接打开面板，因为没有悬停。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前：点一次圆环追加一张「Context Usage」卡片，再点卡片上的查看明细追加第二张。原有的浏览器 spec 就是这样钉死的——点击后 1 张，查看明细后 2 张，上下文读取顺序是先摘要后明细。本 PR 改写的正是这组断言。

改动后：同样一次点击打开侧边面板，对话卡片数保持为 0，再点一次复用已有的那个标签页而不是叠出副本，两次点击合计只有一次明细读取。改写后的 spec 断言了以上全部。

前后对比截图来自同一个浏览器 spec 分别在基线提交和本分支上的运行。本地路径列在本 PR 的 E2E 报告评论里；gh CLI 无法上传图片，所以还需要手动拖进线程。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### 环境

macOS，Node v22.22.2，基线 `d28bc60d73`。本地关卡：构建通过、类型检查通过、lint 通过、每个改动文件的 prettier 检查通过，composer / popover / pane 的 438 个单元测试通过，应用的 1157 个通过，两个上下文浏览器 spec 在**仓库自带、未做任何修改的 Playwright 配置**下通过——7 个用例，31.5s。

有一点本地情况需要如实记录，现已解决：锁定的 Playwright 起初需要 `chromium_headless_shell-1228` 和 `ffmpeg-1011`，而本机缓存里没有，网速又慢到无法同步补齐。所以最早那几次浏览器测试是通过一份一次性的、不进版本库的配置跑的，它只把浏览器通道改成本机已安装的 Google Chrome，并关闭录像和 trace。之后锁定版本的浏览器在后台下载完成，两个 spec 又在仓库自带配置下、没有任何覆盖地重跑了一遍。本 PR 依据的是这次未修改的运行；早先换通道的运行得到了相同结论，包括下面提到的那个竞态。

浏览器测试抓到了我第一版写法里的一个真问题，值得记录：它先打开面板、再关闭面板，然后测量对话卡片的溢出。light 主题以 133px 溢出失败，dark 主题却通过——同样的代码不同的结果，说明是竞态，撞上了聊天列宽度回到全宽的动画。修法是恢复原有顺序，让所有卡片测量都发生在面板从未打开过的前提下。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：自带上下文详情打开回调的宿主，现在也会收到圆环点击和对话卡片详情点击，而这两者以前产生的是本地快照。包 README 和回调设计文档原本写的是相反的结论，两者都在本 PR 中同步更新了中英文。
- 已知限制，本 PR 有意不修：面板已经打开时再次打开不会重新读取。面板是一个带自己刷新控件的持久界面，和文件预览一样，再点一次入口是聚焦而不是重新加载。后续可以改成重新打开时刷新，或者让点击变成开合切换。
- 未验证 / 范围外：compact 状态栏自己的上下文指示器仍会生成卡片，但应用是以 compact 渲染那个状态栏的，按钮因此不显示，所以从本 issue 涉及的界面上碰不到。触屏没有自动化覆盖——移动端 project 只跑移动端 spec，而上下文圆环没有移动端 spec。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：默认应用没有。对接入宿主见第一条。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-context-ring-opens-panel/docs/design/2026-10-13-web-shell-context-ring-details.md) | [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/feat/web-shell-context-ring-opens-panel/docs/design/2026-10-13-web-shell-context-ring-details.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #14051

prs.title: feat(mods): support selected Claude tool input contracts (PR3b)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an explicit per-plugin `toolDialect: "claude"` setting for Mods in trusted headless main sessions. Both `tool.call` and `tool.check` expose the selected Claude input contract, and native/Claude plugins can coexist in either order. Inputs return to Qwen names and arguments before native validation, permissions and execution.

| Native tool | Claude view | Supported arguments |
| --- | --- | --- |
| run_shell_command | Bash | command |
| edit | Edit | file_path, old_string, new_string, replace_all |
| write_file | Write | file_path, content |

Native-only parameters and execution identity stay host-owned. Results remain Qwen-native, including existing reference, artifact and execution-fact behavior. The default is `native`, including for Claude-format installations; workspace settings cannot select a dialect.

## Why it's needed

PR3a added tool middleware using Qwen's native contracts, so a Mod matching Claude's `Bash`, `Edit` or `Write` cannot intercept the corresponding Qwen tool. This stage makes selected input guards, observers and rewrites usable without changing their matchers or silently changing existing installations.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Enable experimental Mods and set `pluginConfigs.<installed-plugin-name>.toolDialect` to `claude` in user settings. A Bash matcher should deny its chosen harmless marker command; Edit/Write rewrites should change only the intended file bytes and reach native validation.
- Omit the setting, choose `native`, or put `claude` only in workspace settings. The same installation should retain Qwen names. An invalid operator dialect should stop initialization before any Mod registration or model request, even without userConfig.
- Run native and Claude plugins in both orders. Each should see its own tool name and arguments, and their content rewrites should compose in order. The recorder should keep Qwen tool names and actual execution status.
- Verify that Mod allow cannot bypass native deny/ask, that a catch replay does not repeat a completed shell effect, and that interruption leaves no delayed effect while a later healthy turn still succeeds.
- Add an unsupported continuation field or omit a required supported field. The former should enter the existing catch/fallback path with a diagnostic; the latter should reach native validation. Other tools, including MCP tools named Bash, should bypass Claude tool frames.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | PR3a baseline | Candidate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Explicit Claude Write/Edit fixture | Receives Qwen names; Write stays unchanged and a multi-match Edit fails | Receives Write/Edit; path/content and replace_all rewrites take effect |
| Bash guard | Matcher does not run; harmless marker is written | Matching call is denied; marker is absent |
| Invalid dialect without userConfig | Continues to model and native execution | Fails preflight with zero model requests and effects |
| Mixed native/Claude order | Only native matcher contributes | File bytes are ORIGINAL\|NATIVE\|CLAUDE or ORIGINAL\|CLAUDE\|NATIVE, matching the configured order |

On submitted commit e204cc5d0f, full build, typecheck and bundle passed, along with 286 focused tests (183 core, 103 CLI) and all 13 fixed-fixture headless cases. Changed-file lint/format and two clean self-audit passes passed; independent local review found no actionable defects. Ten supplemental lifecycle/media/MCP probes passed before the main sync; the rebuilt Mod worker is byte-identical, and the separate report distinguishes those earlier probes from the 13 rerun on this commit.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ Local build, unit checks and isolated headless CLI probes |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

macOS arm64, Node 25.9.0, Qwen Code 0.25.1 development bundle, isolated HOME/QWEN_HOME/workspaces, and a deterministic localhost fake OpenAI provider. Native shell, files, MCP, approvals and persisted records were exercised. These are self-authored contract fixtures informed by pinned CC 2.1.296 evidence, not full official Mods or a live Claude differential test. A separate comment provides the E2E report.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the Claude view intentionally exposes only the arguments listed above. Native timeout, directory, background and artifact parameters are preserved but hidden. Unsupported continuation fields raise a hook error; existing uncaught-error fallback can still execute the original request, so a guard must return a denial to block it.
- Not validated / out of scope: TUI, active guest tool APIs, Read/MultiEdit compatibility, Claude result schemas, full official Mods, real-provider testing and native Claude differential testing. The image probe checks native Read bypass, not Claude Read support.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing installations keep native behavior until an operator opts in. Results retain Qwen semantics, including combined shell output and existing execution/approval budgets; this does not synthesize Claude stdout/stderr.

## Linked Issues

PR3b follow-up to #13950. No tracking issue is closed.

## 审查者测试计划

### 如何验证

- 开启 experimental Mods，并在用户设置中将 `pluginConfigs.<已安装插件名>.toolDialect` 设为 `claude`。Bash matcher 应拒绝选定的无害标记命令；Edit/Write 改写应只改变目标文件内容，并进入原生校验。

- 添加不支持的 continuation 字段或删除受支持的必需字段。前者应带诊断进入既有 catch/fallback 路径，后者应进入原生校验。其他工具，包括名为 Bash 的 MCP 工具，应绕过 Claude 工具 frame。

### 前后对比证据

| 场景 | PR3a 基线 | 候选实现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 显式 Claude Write/Edit fixture | 收到 Qwen 名称；Write 未改写，多处匹配的 Edit 失败 | 收到 Write/Edit；路径、内容和 replace_all 改写生效 |
| Bash 拦截 | matcher 未运行，无害标记被写入 | 匹配调用被拒绝，无标记文件 |
| 无 userConfig 的非法方言 | 继续调用模型并原生执行 | 启动前拒绝，模型请求和副作用为零 |
| native/Claude 混合顺序 | 只有 native matcher 生效 | 文件内容按配置顺序为 ORIGINAL\|NATIVE\|CLAUDE 或 ORIGINAL\|CLAUDE\|NATIVE |

在提交 e204cc5d0f 上，全仓构建、类型检查和 bundle 通过，286 项聚焦测试（核心 183、CLI 103）及全部 13 项固定 fixture 的 headless 用例通过。变更文件 lint/format 和两轮干净自查通过，独立本地审查未发现待修复问题。另有 10 项生命周期/媒体/MCP 补充探针在同步 main 前通过；重新构建的 Mod worker 字节完全相同，独立报告明确区分这些较早探针与本提交重跑的 13 项用例。

### 测试平台

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ 本地构建、单测检查与隔离 headless CLI 探针 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |
| Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地测试 |

### 环境

macOS arm64、Node 25.9.0、Qwen Code 0.25.1 开发 bundle、隔离的 HOME/QWEN_HOME/工作区，以及确定性的本地假 OpenAI provider。实际执行了原生 shell、文件、MCP、审批和持久记录路径。测试使用依据固定 CC 2.1.296 证据编写的契约 fixture，不是完整官方 Mod 或 Claude 实机差分。独立评论中附 E2E 报告。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：Claude 视图仅公开上述参数；原生 timeout、directory、后台及制品参数保留但隐藏。不支持的 continuation 字段触发 hook 错误；既有未捕获错误回退仍可能执行原请求，因此拦截器应返回拒绝来阻止调用。
- 未验证或不在范围内：TUI、主动 guest 工具 API、Read/MultiEdit 兼容、Claude 结果 schema、完整官方 Mod、真实 provider 和 Claude 实机差分。图片探针验证原生 Read 绕过，不代表支持 Claude Read。
- 兼容性和迁移：已有安装在操作员显式开启前保持原生行为。结果保留 Qwen 语义，包括合并的 shell 输出和既有执行/审批预算；不会伪造 Claude stdout/stderr。

## 关联 Issue

PR3b 承接 #13950，不关闭跟踪 issue。

prs.title: feat(core): shrink tool results to the headroom left before auto-compaction
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When a session is close to auto-compaction, shrink the next request's tool results to its remaining headroom. Use only the same chat's last successful usage report for the current provider route and unchanged history prefix. System instructions, session context and tool declarations must match that report; equivalent refreshes preserve it, while changed inputs and obsolete in-flight responses invalidate it without clearing usage counters. Explicit truncation settings take priority.

Measure headroom against auto-compaction and share the selected budget across the batch, charging protected text, media and framing first. Keep the tighter aggregate budget and avoid cutting results twice. If an allocation cannot fit a complete truncation notice, preserve the batch for normal compaction and hard-limit admission. When an artifact path cannot fit, use a complete pointerless notice. Save full originals through the existing best-effort persistence path whenever results are shortened. Before persistence, resolve any read that the selected preview would shorten. If a regular-chat read cannot be traced to a path in model history, preserve the entire batch for normal compaction and overflow handling so worker cache residency still matches the full content the model receives.

Defaults stay at 25,000 characters / 1,000 lines. Result-size accounting moved to #13652. Design: [English](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/pressure-aware-tool-output.zh-CN.md).

## Why it is needed

#2566: static tool budgets can push a long session over the compaction trigger prematurely. A hard-ceiling anchor cuts too late; an obsolete usage anchor cuts against the wrong context. At the other extreme, sub-notice allocations erased failure diagnostics and could advertise a nonexistent partial artifact path. A supported PreToolUse repair can supply a read path while recorded model arguments remain `{}`; shortening that result without notifying the worker could then make a later read incorrectly omit the full body.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Near the auto trigger, return a large result: it should shrink to available headroom. Far from or past auto, or after restore/route change/explicit settings, it should keep the static behavior.
- Change fixed inputs, including during a held response: stale usage should not reanchor. Equivalent refreshes should retain the headroom anchor and usage counters.
- Leave only enough headroom for an empty or incomplete notice: original output and error should reach normal compaction admission. A larger but path-insufficient preview should contain a complete notice, a nonempty error indication and no partial recovery path.
- Check the complete persisted original after a meaningful cut and verify user/protected text and previous file-read rights survive.
- Repair an empty-argument read through PreToolUse: the full result should remain in request/history before persistence, and a later unchanged-file placeholder should be valid. With a resolvable original path, normal shortening should notify the worker, preserve prior-read rights and allow a subsequent full reread.

### Evidence (Before & After)

[Current before/after report and actual tmux excerpts](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13599#issuecomment-6080873864). The current repair passed 35 focused pressure cases, affected Core build/typecheck and static checks. The first full-file run passed 589/590; a media fixture lacking its recorded read call was corrected, and its original media headroom assertions plus inode invalidation passed in the final pressure group. No fresh all-590 pass is claimed.

Actual compiled-Core API/tmux controls exercise the hook and separate worker cache: repaired original `{}` preserves 20,033 characters, while resolvable original path still shortens to 2,576 characters, notifies the worker and rereads the full body. Each makes two controlled generation calls; all 11 watched compiled modules loaded with matching hashes. The generator and compaction boundary are controlled (NOOP), with observer loader/assertion failures retained. The resolved-control mutable cache receipt reflects a later reread, not a frozen after-cut snapshot. Earlier tiny-budget and CLI/TUI evidence stays tied to its tested commit.

### Tested on

macOS, Node 22.22.0, current commit `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859`. Current necessary CI is tracked separately.

## Risk & Scope

The tiny-budget fallback and unresolved-read whole-batch preservation can require normal compaction instead of suppressing text. The latter deliberately may exceed the selected finite character budget; existing compaction, hard admission and overflow handling apply, potentially adding text or compaction. It does not guarantee exact token admission. A pointerless preview omits detailed content when it cannot fit; persistence remains best effort under existing disk limits. Shortened file reads disarm quote-back residency while retaining prior-read rights; uniquely correlated shell shortening leaves file-read residency intact. Existing fork ownership remains unchanged. Unresolved would-cut reads in regular chat now preserve the full batch before persistence; there is no worker API change or blanket cache clear that revokes prior-read rights. The current controlled-Core fixture does not establish a new CLI, browser, real-model or cross-platform result. Line caps and defaults do not adapt.

## Linked Issues

Closes #2566
Result-size accounting split to #13652 (#11536).

<details><summary>中文说明</summary>

接近自动压缩时，根据同一聊天、同一路由且固定输入和历史仍有效的成功用量报告缩小下一请求的工具结果；等价刷新保留依据，内容变化或在途旧响应不重建过期依据，也不清空用量计数。保护文本、媒体和结构先计入余量，与聚合预算取较紧值且不重复裁剪。放不下完整提示时保留原文交给压缩/硬上限准入；完整路径放不下时只发送完整无指针提示，正常裁剪仍尽力保存完整原文。默认25k字符/1000行保持不变，结果统计另在#13652。

本次修复 PreToolUse 补齐实际读取路径、历史原始参数仍为 `{}` 的缓存缺口。落盘前先检查最终预览将裁剪的读取，普通聊天无法定位路径时保留整个批次，确保 worker 驻留状态与模型实际收到的内容一致；可定位读取仍正常裁剪、通知 worker 并保留先读权限，没有新增 worker API。例外批次可能超过有限字符预算，交由正常压缩、硬准入或溢出处理，可能增加文本和压缩，不能声称精确 token 准入。双语设计同步记录。

当前提交 `6579f3c3ec543c4da693dfc2548aa4752d206859` 的35项压力测试及Core构建/类型/静态检查通过。首次全文件589/590通过，媒体fixture未记录读取调用；补齐路径关联后，原媒体预算断言和inode解除断言在最终压力组通过，未冒称全590重新通过。实际编译Core API/tmux中，修正读取保留20,033字符；可定位读取仍裁到2,576字符、通知worker，随后完整重读。每种两次受控生成调用、11个加载模块散列匹配；generator/NOOP压缩是控制边界。保留loader和观察断言失败及修正后的结果。控制中二次读取会更新缓存对象，不能将序列化结果视为裁剪后的冻结快照。历史极小预算及CLI/TUI证据保留原提交，本轮不冒称新CLI、Docker、浏览器、真实模型或真实压缩验收。CI、人工批准、合并和发布独立判断。

</details>
